name: Itranox 200Mg Capsule 7's
introduction:
Introduction About ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE

ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE Works

ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.
usageInstructions: Take this medicine as advised by your physician.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Side Effects Of ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE
Common Side Effects of ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE:
Stomach pain, nausea
Headache

Stop taking ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Tingling, numbness, and weakness in the limbs
Liver problems (singles include severe lack of appetite, nausea, vomiting, tiredness, stomach pain, muscle weakness, yellowing of skin and eyes (jaundice), dark urine, pale stools, and hair loss)

warnings.details: ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor. You should use contraception to make sure that you do not become pregnant during management with this medicine.
ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women as a small amount of this medicine passes into breast milk.
Do not drive or handle heavy machines if you experience dizziness, blurred/double vision, or hearing loss while taking ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE.
Consumption of alcohol is not recommended during management with ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE.
ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems.
ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with liver problems such as jaundice.
Do not take ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to itraconazole or any other ingredients of this medicine.
ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with heart problems such as heart failure.
ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age. However, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases.
ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in elderly patients. However, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases.

Others

ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you:

Have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS) or your immune system is not functioning well

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage allergies or hay fever, Ex. terfenadine, astemizole, ebastine, mizolastine
Medicines used to lower blood cholesterol levels Ex. atorvastatin, lovastatin, simvastatin
Medicines used to manage irregular heartbeat Ex. quinidine, disopyramide, dronedarone, or dofetilide
Medicines used to manage chest pain and high blood pressure Ex. bepridil, lercanidipine, ivabradine, ranolazine, nisoldipine, aliskiren, nadolol, digoxin, cilostazol dihydropyridines such as amlodipine, felodipine, and verapamil
Medicines used to manage migraine headaches Ex. dihydroergotamine, eletriptan, ergotamine
Medicines used to manage drug abuse Ex. levacetylmethadol and methadone
Medicines used to manage digestive problems Ex. cisapride
Colchicine (used to manage gout)
Medicines used to manage fluid accumulation, Ex. Eplerenone
Medicines used after labour Ex. ergometrine, methylergometrine
Medicine used to manage malaria Ex. halofantrine
Medicines used to manage cancer Ex. irinotecan, bortezomib, busulphan, docetaxel, erlotinib, ixabepilone, trimetrexate, axitinib, dabrafenib, dasatinib, ibrutinib, lapatinib, nilotinib, sunitinib, and trabectedin
Medicines used as blood thinners Ex. dabigatran, ticagrelor, rivaroxaban, warfarin
Medicines used to manage mental illness Ex. quetiapine, pimozide, lurasidone, aripiprazole, haloperidol, perospirone, ramelteon, risperidone, reboxetine, and sertindole
Medicines used to manage urinary bladder disorders Ex. darifenacin, tamsulosin, fesoterodine, imidafenacin, solifenacin, and tolterodine
Medicines used to manage anxiety Ex. midazolam, triazolam, buspirone, alprazolam, brotizolam
Medicines used after an organ transplant Ex. everolimus, ciclesonide, temsirolimus, ciclosporin, tacrolimus, sirolimus
Medicines used to relive pain Ex. fentanyl, alfentanil, buprenorphine, oxycodone
Medicines used to manage inflammation or asthma Ex. salmeterol, methylprednisolone, fluticasone, budesonide, dexamethasone
Medicines used to manage erection problems Ex. vardenafil, sildenafil and tadalafil
Medicines used to manage indigestion, stomach ulcers, or heartburn Ex. Pantoprazole, omeprazole
Medicines used to manage HIV infection Ex. ritonavir, darunavir, indinavir, fosamprenavir, saquinivir
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections Ex. ciprofloxacin, clarithromycin, erythromycin
Medicines used to manage tuberculosis Ex. rifampicin, rifabutin, or isoniazid
Medicines used to manage epilepsy Ex. phenytoin, carbamazepine, or phenobarbital
St. John’s Wort (used to manage depression)
Medicines used to manage eczema Ex. alitretinoin
Medicines used to manage vomiting Ex. aprepitant, domperidone
Medicines used to manage excess thyroid hormone secretion Ex. cinacalcet
Medicines used to manage low sodium blood levels Ex. mozavaptan or tolvaptan
Medicines used to manage worms Ex. praziquantel
Medicines used to manage high blood sugar Ex. Repaglinide, saxagliptin
Medicines used to relive inflammation and pain Ex. meloxicam

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital.

name: Ketofly 2% Soap 75gm
introduction:
Introduction About KETOFLY 2% SOAP

KETOFLY 2% SOAP contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used to manage various fungal infections of the skin such as ringworm, athlete’s foot and dermatitis associated with such infections.

KETOFLY 2% SOAP can also be used to manage other fungal infections like candida paronychia (fungal infection around nails), cutaneous candidiasis (fungal infection of the skin), and pityriasis versicolor (characterized by the development of hyper-pigmented patches on the trunk that may/may not spread to arms and shoulders).

Before using KETOFLY 2% SOAP, inform your doctor if you have any allergies or pre-existing conditions, or if you are taking any other medicines. KETOFLY 2% SOAP should be used cautiously in pregnant and breastfeeding women. The safety and effectiveness of KETOFLY 2% SOAP in children (less than 12 years of age) have not been established so, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

The most common side effects associated with KETOFLY 2% SOAP are skin dryness, itching, redness or burning sensation. It is recommended to consult the doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Ringworm, athlete’s foot and dermatitis associated with such infections
usesDetails:
Uses Of KETOFLY 2% SOAP

Manages various fungal infections of the skin such as:

Ringworm, athlete’s foot and dermatitis associated with such infections
Candida paronychia
Cutaneous candidiasis
Pityriasis versicolor
mechanismOfAction:
How KETOFLY 2% SOAP Works

KETOFLY 2% SOAP clears the infection by causing holes in the fungal cell membranes, thus killing the fungi.
usageDetails:
How to use KETOFLY 2% SOAP

Always apply KETOFLY 2% SOAP as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply KETOFLY 2% SOAP on the affected area. It can be applied on the body and scalp. Wash and rinse thoroughly with water after applying KETOFLY 2% SOAP. Avoid contact of KETOFLY 2% SOAP with the nose, mouth or eyes.

If KETOFLY 2% SOAP accidentally gets in your eye, gently rinse your eyes with cold water. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Skin dryness, itching, redness or burning sensation
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of KETOFLY 2% SOAP
Common
Skin dryness, itching, redness or burning sensation

warnings.details: KETOFLY 2% SOAP should be used with caution in pregnant women as it is not known if this medicine will harm your unborn baby. Consult your doctor before using it.
KETOFLY 2% SOAP should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into your breast milk. Consult your doctor before using it.
Do not use KETOFLY 2% SOAP if you are allergic to Ketoconazole or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

Use in pediatrics:

The safety and effectiveness of KETOFLY 2% SOAP in children (less than 12 years of age) have not been established. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

There is no proper information about the use of KETOFLY 2% SOAP in elderly patients (older than 65 years of age). Consult your doctor before using it.

introduction:
Introduction About AF 150MG TABLET

AF 150MG TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking AF 150MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

AF 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. AF 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking AF 150MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

AF 150MG TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Medicines used to use to manage rejection of organ transplants (Ex. cyclosporine, tacrolimus, sirolimus)

Medicines used to control seizures /fits (Ex. phenytoin or carbamazepine)

Medicines used to manage heart diseases (Ex. quinidine, amiodarone)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. amitriptyline, nortriptyline)
Pimozide (used to control motor or verbal tics)

Erythromycin (used for managing bacterial infections)
Cyclosphosphamide, medicines used for management of cancer (Ex. vincristine or vinblastine)
Alfentanil, fentanyl (used as general anesthetic)
Halofantrine (for managing malaria)
Medicines used to manage high cholesterol levels (Ex. atorvastatin, simvastatin, and fluvastatin)
Medicines used to manage painful conditions with inflammation (Ex. celecoxib, ibuprofen, and naproxen)
Prednisone (used to manage inflammatory disorders)
Antiviral medications used to manage HIV infection (Ex.  saquinavir, zidovudine)
Tofacitinib (used to manage rheumatoid arthritis)
Ivacaftor (medicine used for managing cystic fibrosis)
Ibrutinib (used for managing blood cancer)
Midazolam, triazolam or similar medicines (used to induce sleep and manages anxiety)
Olaparib (used for managing ovarian cancer)
Methadone (used to manage chronic pain and also opioid dependance)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of AF 150MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of AF 150MG TABLET are hearing, seeing, feeling and thinking things that are not real (hallucination and paranoid behaviour).

introduction:
Introduction About FLUKA 150MG TABLET

Fluka 150mg Tablet contains fluconazole, a powerful antifungal compound that supports the management of fungal infections across various parts of the body, as directed by your healthcare professional. Belonging to the triazole antifungal class, Fluka 150mg Tablet is widely recommended for controlling infections caused by sensitive yeast and fungal organisms affecting the mouth, throat, genital region, skin, and internal organs.

Fluka 150 Tablet is commonly prescribed for fungal concerns involving the oral cavity, throat, vaginal area, and even nail infections such as fingernail and toenail fungal issues. It works by disrupting the fungal cell membrane, helping stop the growth and spread of fungi at the source.

Known for its reliability and broad-spectrum action, Fluka 150mg Tablet is frequently chosen by healthcare providers for managing persistent or recurring fungal problems where effective antifungal support is required.

Fluka 150 Tablet should be taken exactly in the dosage and duration recommended by your healthcare professional. Swallow the tablet whole, and it may be consumed with or without food. Your prescribed schedule will vary based on your specific fungal concern and your doctor’s guidance. In some cases, it may be suggested in planned cycles of use and intervals of non-use.

For the best results, try to take each dose at consistent, evenly spaced times. Make sure to continue using the medication until the full course is completed, even if you begin noticing improvements earlier. Stopping the course midway can allow the fungal issue to return, and missing doses may contribute to reduced effectiveness over time.

If you notice that your condition is not improving or seems to be getting worse, inform your doctor promptly. It is also advisable to avoid antacid products one hour before or two hours after taking Fluka 150 Tablet, as they may interfere with how well the medicine works.

The most common Fluka 150 Tablet side effects include stomach discomfort, vomiting, loose stools, skin rash, headache, nausea, diarrhoea, change in taste, dizziness and skin rash. You may consult your healthcare professional for guidance on minimizing or managing these unwanted effects.

Stop using the medication and seek medical advice immediately if you experience any signs that may indicate an allergic response such as skin rash, swelling of the lips, throat, or face, difficulty swallowing or breathing, dizziness, or severe nausea.

Avoid using Fluka 150 Tablet during pregnancy unless your healthcare professional has specifically advised otherwise. Make sure to inform your doctor if you have a history of heart related issues, reduced immune function (including conditions such as HIV/AIDS), kidney concerns, or liver conditions such as jaundice. In such situations, this medication may not be the most suitable option.

If your prescribed course extends beyond one month, your doctor may recommend regular liver-function monitoring to ensure safe ongoing use. Fluka 150 Tablet can sometimes cause dizziness, so it is best to avoid driving or operating heavy machinery until you feel fully alert and stable.

mechanismOfAction:
How FLUKA 150MG TABLET Works
Fluka 150mg Tablet: How Fluconazole Acts on Fungal Cells

Fluka 150mg Tablet contains fluconazole, a triazole antifungal molecule that works by disrupting essential biochemical processes inside fungal cells. It interferes with the pathway responsible for producing the cell membrane, weakening fungal structure and slowing further growth. By selectively targeting fungal enzymes, fluconazole helps control fungal activity across different body areas.

Role of Ergosterol and Why Fluka 150mg Targets It

Ergosterol is a key structural component of fungal cell membranes, similar to cholesterol in human cells. Fluka 150mg targets ergosterol synthesis because fungi cannot survive or maintain cell integrity without it. When ergosterol levels drop, the cell membrane becomes unstable, leading to increased permeability and impaired fungal function. This selective targeting makes ergosterol a primary point of action for high-efficacy antifungal support.

Fluconazole and 14-α Lanosterol Demethylase Inhibition

Fluconazole works by inhibiting the fungal enzyme 14-α lanosterol demethylase, which is essential for converting lanosterol into ergosterol. Blocking this enzyme disrupts the ergosterol synthesis pathway, resulting in defective membrane formation. This key mechanism is central to fluconazole’s action and is widely recognized for its reliability in managing fungal overgrowth.

What Happens to the Fungal Cell Membrane with Fluka 150mg Tablet

Once Fluka 150mg interferes with ergosterol production, the fungal cell membrane becomes weak, porous, and functionally unstable. This impaired membrane cannot regulate nutrients or maintain internal balance, causing fungal cells to lose structural integrity. Over time, this disruption slows fungal proliferation and limits the organism’s ability to survive.

Fungistatic Action of Fluka 150mg Tablet: Slowing Fungal Growth

Fluka 150mg primarily shows a fungistatic effect, meaning it slows down fungal multiplication rather than destroying fungi outright. By reducing ergosterol and compromising membrane function, fluconazole controls fungi from replicating effectively. This controlled slowdown helps the body and immune system regain balance and manage fungal presence more efficiently.

When Fluconazole May Show Dose-Dependent Fungicidal Activity

Although mainly fungistatic, fluconazole can exhibit fungicidal (fungus-killing) action at higher concentrations, particularly against certain strains of Candida and Cryptococcus. This dose-dependent effect usually appears when drug levels at the infection site are sufficiently high or in infections involving highly susceptible fungal organisms. Clinical guidance determines when such dosing strategies are appropriate.

Why Human Cells Are Less Affected Than Fungal Cells

Human cells are minimally affected by fluconazole because they do not contain ergosterol. Instead, human cell membranes rely on cholesterol, which the drug does not target. Additionally, the enzyme 14-α lanosterol demethylase in human cells is structurally different, making fluconazole far less active against human biochemical pathways. This selective targeting ensures higher safety while focusing action on fungal organisms.

Introduction About FUMYCIN 150MG CAPSULE

FUMYCIN 150MG CAPSULE contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking FUMYCIN 150MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

FUMYCIN 150MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. FUMYCIN 150MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking FUMYCIN 150MG CAPSULE are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

name: Forcan 200mg Tablet 4'S
introduction:
Introduction About FORCAN 200MG TABLET

FORCAN 200MG TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).   

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.

Before taking FORCAN 200MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.

FORCAN 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. FORCAN 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking FORCAN 200MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

name: Ceastra XL 200mg Capsule 7'S
introduction:
Introduction About CEASTRA XL 200MG CAPSULE

CEASTRA XL 200MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use CEASTRA XL 200MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with CEASTRA XL 200MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with CEASTRA XL 200MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. CEASTRA XL 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

CEASTRA XL 200MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking CEASTRA XL 200MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CEASTRA XL 200MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How CEASTRA XL 200MG CAPSULE Works

CEASTRA XL 200MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of CEASTRA XL 200MG CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Do not drive or handle heavy machines if you experience dizziness, blurred/double vision, or hearing loss while taking CEASTRA XL 200MG CAPSULE.
Consumption of alcohol is not recommended during management with CEASTRA XL 200MG CAPSULE.
CEASTRA XL 200MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems.
CEASTRA XL 200MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with liver problems such as jaundice.
Do not take CEASTRA XL 200MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to itraconazole or any other ingredients of this medicine.
CEASTRA XL 200MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with heart problems such as heart failure.
CEASTRA XL 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age. However, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases.
CEASTRA XL 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in elderly patients. However, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases.

Others

CEASTRA XL 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you:

Have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS) or your immune system is not functioning well

name: Flucos 400mg Tablet 1'S
introduction:
Introduction About FLUCOS 400MG TABLET

FLUCOS 400MG TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).      

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking FLUCOS 400MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

FLUCOS 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. FLUCOS 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking FLUCOS 400MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

Uses Of FLUCOS 400MG TABLET

mechanismOfAction:
How FLUCOS 400MG TABLET Works

FLUCOS 400MG TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.
usageDetails:
How to use FLUCOS 400MG TABLET

Take FLUCOS 400MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow FLUCOS 400MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. The correct dose and duration for you will be decide by the doctor depending upon your age, body weight and type of infection.

warnings.details: FLUCOS 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking FLUCOS 400MG TABLET.

FLUCOS 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women after repeated use or after high dose of this medicine. You may continue breast-feeding after single dose of FLUCOS 400MG TABLET. Consult your doctor before taking FLUCOS 400MG TABLET.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience dizziness or fits after taking FLUCOS 400MG TABLET.
FLUCOS 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney dysfunction. Consult your doctor before taking FLUCOS 400MG TABLET.
FLUCOS 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver dysfunction. Consult your doctor before taking FLUCOS 400MG TABLET.
FLUCOS 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to fluconazole or other azole anti-fungals (such as itraconazole or posaconazole).

FLUCOS 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). Consult child’s doctor for advice before administration of FLUCOS 400MG TABLET to your child.

FLUCOS 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment. Your doctor may adjust the dose depending upon kidney function. Consult your doctor for advice before taking FLUCOS 400MG TABLET.

Others

FLUCOS 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Rare hereditary problems of galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption

Before taking FLUCOS 400MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood
Are prone to develop severe skin reactions (itching, reddening of the skin or difficulty in breathing)
Have history of adrenal insufficiency
Have no improvement in fungal infection

name: CLOTIGEM Dusting Powder 100gm
introduction:
Introduction About CLOTIGEM DUSTING POWDER

CLOTIGEM DUSTING POWDER contains Clotrimazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of skin infections such as athlete’s foot, jock itch, ringworm, and infections resulting from excessive sweating. It also relives symptoms such as burning, itching, skin cracking, and discomfort caused by the skin infections. Ringworm is a fungal infection affecting the skin, causing redness and itching. An athlete’s foot is a fungal infection affecting the spaces between the toes.

Clotrimazole works by blocking the fungal growth and managing the further occurrence of fungal infections. CLOTIGEM DUSTING POWDER is intended to manage fungal skin infections; hence, it should not be used for other infections of internal organs. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids and mouth. Consult your doctor immediately if the infection does not recover within seven days of management with CLOTIGEM DUSTING POWDER.

CLOTIGEM DUSTING POWDER is not recommended for patients allergic to clotrimazole. CLOTIGEM DUSTING POWDER is not recommended for use in deep wounds and severe burns. CLOTIGEM DUSTING POWDER should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Before taking CLOTIGEM DUSTING POWDER, inform your doctor if you’re under any medications.

mechanismOfAction:
How CLOTIGEM DUSTING POWDER Works

CLOTIGEM DUSTING POWDER works by managing the fungal growth. Clotrimazole works by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. It further manages the occurrence of fungal infections. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.
usageDetails:
How to use CLOTIGEM DUSTING POWDER

Always apply CLOTIGEM DUSTING POWDER as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Do not take CLOTIGEM DUSTING POWDER orally. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids and mouth. Consult your doctor immediately if the infection does not recover within seven days of management with CLOTIGEM DUSTING POWDER. Before using the CLOTIGEM DUSTING POWDER on the affected area, wash it thoroughly and make sure it is dry before using CLOTIGEM DUSTING POWDER.

introduction:
Introduction About ECOVIN 500MG TABLET

ECOVIN 500MG TABLET contains Griseofulvin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal drugs. It is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, scalp, hair, groin, feet, or nails where topical therapy is not suitable or has failed to manage the condition.

Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving ECOVIN 500MG TABLET management. Before taking ECOVIN 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have skin, liver, or kidney problems or porphyria (which results from an increase in certain chemicals related to red blood cell proteins).

ECOVIN 500MG TABLET is not recommended for pregnant or breastfeeding women; therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking ECOVIN 500MG TABLET are headache, diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, or stomach discomfort. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, scalp, hair, groin, feet, and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of ECOVIN 500MG TABLET
Manage fungal infections of the skin, scalp, hair, groin, feet, and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How ECOVIN 500MG TABLET Works

ECOVIN 500MG TABLET inhibits the growth of fungi by binding to a part of the fungus causing the infection in the body. This stops the fungus from multiplying. It also manages fungus from spreading to new cells. These actions cause the fungal infection to shed completely.
usageDetails:
How to use ECOVIN 500MG TABLET

Take ECOVIN 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ITROMED 200 CAPSULE

ITROMED 200 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITROMED 200 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITROMED 200 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITROMED 200 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITROMED 200 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITROMED 200 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITROMED 200 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITROMED 200 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITROMED 200 CAPSULE Works

ITROMED 200 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.
usageInstructions: Take this medicine as advised by your physician.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ITROMED 200 CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About SYNTRAN 100MG CAPSULE

SYNTRAN 100MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use SYNTRAN 100MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with SYNTRAN 100MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with SYNTRAN 100MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. SYNTRAN 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

SYNTRAN 100MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking SYNTRAN 100MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SYNTRAN 100MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How SYNTRAN 100MG CAPSULE Works

SYNTRAN 100MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of SYNTRAN 100MG CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: Terfin 250mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TERFIN 250MG TABLET

TERFIN 250MG TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take TERFIN 250MG TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking TERFIN 250MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take TERFIN 250MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of TERFIN 250MG TABLET
Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How TERFIN 250MG TABLET Works

TERFIN 250MG TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: Take TERFIN 250MG TABLET as advised by your physician.
For Tablet: Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. But in children younger than 6 years, the medicine should be crushed before swallowing.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse TERFIN 250MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

TERFIN 250MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems.

Do not take TERFIN 250MG TABLET if you are allergic to Terbinafine.

TERFIN 250MG TABLET can be used with caution in elderly patients.

introduction:
Introduction About ITRAFIX 200MG CAPSULE

ITRAFIX 200MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRAFIX 200MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITRAFIX 200MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITRAFIX 200MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITRAFIX 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITRAFIX 200MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITRAFIX 200MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITRAFIX 200MG CAPSULE Works

ITRAFIX 200MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About AF 400MG TABLET

AF 400MG TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).      

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking AF 400MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

AF 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. AF 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking AF 400MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

name: Itralase 100mg Capsule 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About ITRALASE 100MG CAPSULE

ITRALASE 100MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRALASE 100MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITRALASE 100MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITRALASE 100MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITRALASE 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITRALASE 100MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITRALASE 100MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITRALASE 100MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITRALASE 100MG CAPSULE Works

ITRALASE 100MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ITRALASE 100MG CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

ITRALASE 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women as a small amount of this medicine passes into breast milk.
Do not drive or handle heavy machines if you experience dizziness, blurred/double vision, or hearing loss while taking ITRALASE 100MG CAPSULE.
Consumption of alcohol is not recommended during management with ITRALASE 100MG CAPSULE.
ITRALASE 100MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems.

introduction:
Introduction About ITZHH 100MG CAPSULE

ITZHH 100MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITZHH 100MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITZHH 100MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITZHH 100MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITZHH 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITZHH 100MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITZHH 100MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITZHH 100MG CAPSULE Works

ITZHH 100MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About ITASPOR 100MG CAPSULE

ITASPOR 100MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITASPOR 100MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITASPOR 100MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITASPOR 100MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITASPOR 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITASPOR 100MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITASPOR 100MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITASPOR 100MG CAPSULE Works

ITASPOR 100MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About VORITROL 200MG TABLET

VORITROL 200MG TABLET contains Voriconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections (such as invasive aspergillosis, candidaemia, invasive Candida sp. infections) in both adults and in children (aged 2 years or above). It can also be used to manage fungal infections in high-risk bone marrow transplant recipients.

VORITROL 200MG TABLET should be taken at least 1 hour before or after meals. It is highly intended for patients with worsening or life-threatening fungal infections. It is important to complete the full course of therapy with VORITROL 200MG TABLET to achieve better control over infection.

Before taking VORITROL 200MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or heart problems. Do not take VORITROL 200MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breast-feeding without consulting your doctor.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with VORITROL 200MG TABLET. During management with VORITROL 200MG TABLET, avoid exposing your skin towards direct sunlight. Wear protective loose-fitting clothes and apply sunscreen while going outdoors.

The most common side-effects of taking VORITROL 200MG TABLET are visual impairment, fever, rash, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, headache, swelling of the extremities, stomach pain and breathing difficulties. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Manage and manage severe fungal infections

Manage and manage severe fungal infections
mechanismOfAction:
How VORITROL 200MG TABLET Works

VORITROL 200MG TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

Take VORITROL 200MG TABLET 1 hour before or after meals or as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking VORITROL 200MG TABLET without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About FUNGISET 400 TABLET

FUNGISET 400 TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).      

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking FUNGISET 400 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

FUNGISET 400 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. FUNGISET 400 TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking FUNGISET 400 TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

introduction:
Introduction About AMFY GEL(TOPICAL)

AMFY GEL(TOPICAL) contains Amphotericin B which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. AMFY GEL(TOPICAL) is used to manage acute, chronic & recurrent fungal infections, vaginal candidiasis, diaper rash, and bed sores in affected individuals.

AMFY GEL(TOPICAL) is also used in dressing after wound debridement and burns which is also applied around tube and catheters during intubation in intensive care unit.

AMFY GEL(TOPICAL) is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Amphotericin B. Before applying AMFY GEL(TOPICAL), inform your doctor if you have kidney problems (such as renal impairment).

AMFY GEL(TOPICAL) should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. The medicine is also advised to be used with caution in children & adolescents (aged below 18 years) and in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side-effects of applying AMFY GEL(TOPICAL) are ulceration and induration (thickened and hardened skin), scarring, and/or swelling at the applied site. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How AMFY GEL(TOPICAL) Works

AMFY GEL(TOPICAL) binds to ergosterol (steroid present on the cell membranes of fungi) which leads to the formation of pores and ion leakage on the cell membrane resulting in fungal cell death thus managing invasive fungal infections in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use AMFY GEL(TOPICAL)

Always apply AMFY GEL(TOPICAL) as directed by your physician. Clean and dry the affected area before application of AMFY GEL(TOPICAL). It is for external use only. A thin layer of medicine has to be applied on the affected area. Managed areas need not be covered with a plaster/bandage. Wash hands before and after the application AMFY GEL(TOPICAL). Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids, nose, and mouth.

introduction:
Introduction About LZHH CREAM

LZHH CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LZHH CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LZHH CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LZHH CREAM

LZHH CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LZHH CREAM Works

LZHH CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LZHH CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About FLUMET 400 TABLET

FLUMET 400 TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).      

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking FLUMET 400 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

FLUMET 400 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. FLUMET 400 TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking FLUMET 400 TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

introduction:
Introduction About SYSCAN 150MG CAPSULE

SYSCAN 150MG CAPSULE contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking SYSCAN 150MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

SYSCAN 150MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. SYSCAN 150MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking SYSCAN 150MG CAPSULE are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How SYSCAN 150MG CAPSULE Works

SYSCAN 150MG CAPSULE works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.

introduction:
Introduction About TERBICIP 250 TABLET

TERBICIP 250 TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take TERBICIP 250 TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking TERBICIP 250 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take TERBICIP 250 TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of TERBICIP 250 TABLET
Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How TERBICIP 250 TABLET Works

TERBICIP 250 TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: Take TERBICIP 250 TABLET as advised by your physician.
For Tablet: Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. But in children younger than 6 years, the medicine should be crushed before swallowing.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse TERBICIP 250 TABLET in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Itralin 100Mg Capsule 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ITRALIN 100MG CAPSULE

ITRALIN 100MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRALIN 100MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITRALIN 100MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITRALIN 100MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITRALIN 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITRALIN 100MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITRALIN 100MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITRALIN 100MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITRALIN 100MG CAPSULE Works

ITRALIN 100MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.
usageInstructions: Take this medicine as advised by your physician.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ITRALIN 100MG CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Introduction About TERBINAFORCE 250MG TABLET

TERBINAFORCE 250MG TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take TERBINAFORCE 250MG TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking TERBINAFORCE 250MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take TERBINAFORCE 250MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
usesDetails:

Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How TERBINAFORCE 250MG TABLET Works

TERBINAFORCE 250MG TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse TERBINAFORCE 250MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ITROMED 100 CAPSULE

ITROMED 100 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITROMED 100 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITROMED 100 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITROMED 100 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITROMED 100 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITROMED 100 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITROMED 100 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITROMED 100 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITROMED 100 CAPSULE Works

ITROMED 100 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ITROMED 100 CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use SYNTRAN 200MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS).

introduction:
Introduction About ZITRAN 100 CAPSULE

ZITRAN 100 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ZITRAN 100 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ZITRAN 100 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ZITRAN 100 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ZITRAN 100 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ZITRAN 100 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ZITRAN 100 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Uses Of ZITRAN 100 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ZITRAN 100 CAPSULE Works

ZITRAN 100 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ZITRAN 100 CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About FLUTAS 150MG TABLET

FLUTAS 150MG TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking FLUTAS 150MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

FLUTAS 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. FLUTAS 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking FLUTAS 150MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

How FLUTAS 150MG TABLET Works

FLUTAS 150MG TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability.
