Introduction About IBINATOR 100 CAPSULE

IBINATOR 100 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use IBINATOR 100 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with IBINATOR 100 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with IBINATOR 100 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. IBINATOR 100 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

IBINATOR 100 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking IBINATOR 100 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:

IBINATOR 100 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About JIMLIG 200 CAPSULE

JIMLIG 200 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use JIMLIG 200 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with JIMLIG 200 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with JIMLIG 200 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. JIMLIG 200 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

JIMLIG 200 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking JIMLIG 200 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of JIMLIG 200 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How JIMLIG 200 CAPSULE Works

JIMLIG 200 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.
usageInstructions: Take this medicine as advised by your physician.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of JIMLIG 200 CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TEBINA 500MG TABLET

TEBINA 500MG TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take TEBINA 500MG TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking TEBINA 500MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take TEBINA 500MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of TEBINA 500MG TABLET
Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How TEBINA 500MG TABLET Works

TEBINA 500MG TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: Take TEBINA 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician.
For Tablet: Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. But in children younger than 6 years, the medicine should be crushed before swallowing.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse TEBINA 500MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About KAPITZ 200 CAPSULE

KAPITZ 200 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use KAPITZ 200 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with KAPITZ 200 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with KAPITZ 200 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. KAPITZ 200 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

KAPITZ 200 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking KAPITZ 200 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Uses Of KAPITZ 200 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How KAPITZ 200 CAPSULE Works

KAPITZ 200 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

name: LULIACT Powder 50gm
introduction:
Introduction About LULIACT POWDER

LULIACT POWDER is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection). Fungal infections can be contagious and spread from one person to another.

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal Agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIACT POWDER is not recommended for use among women who are pregnant and should be used with caution in breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary.

LULIACT POWDER is not recommended for use in children below 12 years of age unless clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIACT POWDER to the eyes, mouth, or nose. The most common side effects of this medicine are dry skin, blisters on the skin, application site reactions (burning, irritation, itching, and redness), and skin peeling. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULIACT POWDER

LULIACT POWDER is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULIACT POWDER Works

LULIACT POWDER works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and killing fungi. As a result, LULIACT POWDER relieves discomfort, itching, and irritation on the skin.

name: Fungicip 150mg Tablet 1'S
introduction:
Introduction About FUNGICIP 150MG TABLET

FUNGICIP 150MG TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking FUNGICIP 150MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

FUNGICIP 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. FUNGICIP 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking FUNGICIP 150MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How FUNGICIP 150MG TABLET Works

FUNGICIP 150MG TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.

Take FUNGICIP 150MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow FUNGICIP 150MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. The correct dose and duration for you will be decide by the doctor depending upon your age, body weight and type of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About PANITRA 100MG CAPSULE

PANITRA 100MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use PANITRA 100MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with PANITRA 100MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with PANITRA 100MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. PANITRA 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

PANITRA 100MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking PANITRA 100MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of PANITRA 100MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How PANITRA 100MG CAPSULE Works

PANITRA 100MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About ITRABOND 100MG CAPSULE

ITRABOND 100MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRABOND 100MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITRABOND 100MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITRABOND 100MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITRABOND 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITRABOND 100MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITRABOND 100MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITRABOND 100MG CAPSULE Works

ITRABOND 100MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About KETOCLASS 2% SOAP

KETOCLASS 2% SOAP contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used to manage various fungal infections of the skin such as ringworm, athlete’s foot and dermatitis associated with such infections.

KETOCLASS 2% SOAP can also be used to manage other fungal infections like candida paronychia (fungal infection around nails), cutaneous candidiasis (fungal infection of the skin), and pityriasis versicolor (characterized by the development of hyper-pigmented patches on the trunk that may/may not spread to arms and shoulders).

Before using KETOCLASS 2% SOAP, inform your doctor if you have any allergies or pre-existing conditions, or if you are taking any other medicines. KETOCLASS 2% SOAP should be used cautiously in pregnant and breastfeeding women. The safety and effectiveness of KETOCLASS 2% SOAP in children (less than 12 years of age) have not been established so, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

The most common side effects associated with KETOCLASS 2% SOAP are skin dryness, itching, redness or burning sensation. It is recommended to consult the doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

If KETOCLASS 2% SOAP accidentally gets in your eye, gently rinse your eyes with cold water. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About FLUCOS 0.5%W/W GEL

FLUCOS 0.5%W/W GEL contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage dermal fungal infections (dermatomycosis) caused by dermatophytes, yeasts, and moulds such as tinea pedis (athlete's foot), tinea corporis (ring worm), tinea cruris (fungal sweat rash), and tinea versicolor.

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot) is a fungal infection that begins between toes generally in people whose feet remain sweaty. It is characterized by symptoms such as scaly rashes, itching, stinging, and burning between toes. Tinea corporis (ring worm) is a fungal infection causing circular itchy rashes with clearer skin in the middle, resembling a ring.

Tinea cruris (fungal sweat rash) or jock itch is a fungal infection characterized by red and itchy rashes in the moist areas of the body such as groin. Tinea versicolor is a fungal infection that is characterized by abnormal skin pigmentation such as light and dark patches at the affected area.

Before using FLUCOS 0.5%W/W GEL inform your doctor if you have kidney, liver, heart, and lung problems. FLUCOS 0.5%W/W GEL is not recommended to use among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding. FLUCOS 0.5%W/W GEL can be used in children and adolescents. Consult with your child’s doctor before using it for your child.

There is no information on the use of FLUCOS 0.5%W/W GEL in elderly patients. Consult with your doctor before using. The most common side effects of using FLUCOS 0.5%W/W GEL are skin rash, irritation, dryness or cracking of the surrounding area, itchiness and burning sensation at the site of application. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen or persists.

How FLUCOS 0.5%W/W GEL Works

FLUCOS 0.5%W/W GEL helps in manage fungal infection where Fluconazole inhibits the synthesis of certain compounds that are essential components of the fungal cell membrane. Moreover, it also impairs various important biological processes inside the fungal cell body required for its survival, thereby killing the killing the fungal cell bodies.

Always apply FLUCOS 0.5%W/W GEL as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Clean and dry the affected area and apply a thin layer of FLUCOS 0.5%W/W GEL to the affected area. Wash your hands before and after application. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of FLUCOS 0.5%W/W GEL for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About FORCAN 150MG TABLET

FORCAN 150MG TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking FORCAN 150MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

FORCAN 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. FORCAN 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking FORCAN 150MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

How FORCAN 150MG TABLET Works

FORCAN 150MG TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.

introduction:
Introduction About LIVAFIN O 100MG CAPSULE

LIVAFIN O 100MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use LIVAFIN O 100MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with LIVAFIN O 100MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with LIVAFIN O 100MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. LIVAFIN O 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

LIVAFIN O 100MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking LIVAFIN O 100MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LIVAFIN O 100MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How LIVAFIN O 100MG CAPSULE Works

LIVAFIN O 100MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About SEBIFIN 250MG TABLET

SEBIFIN 250MG TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take SEBIFIN 250MG TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking SEBIFIN 250MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take SEBIFIN 250MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of SEBIFIN 250MG TABLET
Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How SEBIFIN 250MG TABLET Works

SEBIFIN 250MG TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: Take SEBIFIN 250MG TABLET as advised by your physician.
For Tablet: Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. But in children younger than 6 years, the medicine should be crushed before swallowing.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse SEBIFIN 250MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ITRAGREAT 100 CAPSULE

ITRAGREAT 100 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRAGREAT 100 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITRAGREAT 100 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITRAGREAT 100 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITRAGREAT 100 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITRAGREAT 100 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITRAGREAT 100 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About FLUTAS 400MG TABLET

FLUTAS 400MG TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).      

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking FLUTAS 400MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

FLUTAS 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. FLUTAS 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking FLUTAS 400MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How FLUTAS 400MG TABLET Works

FLUTAS 400MG TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.

introduction:
Introduction About ZITRAN 200 CAPSULE

ZITRAN 200 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ZITRAN 200 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ZITRAN 200 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ZITRAN 200 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ZITRAN 200 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ZITRAN 200 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ZITRAN 200 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How ZITRAN 200 CAPSULE Works

ZITRAN 200 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About ZORBAX 500MG TABLET

ZORBAX 500MG TABLET contains Griseofulvin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal drugs. It is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, scalp, hair, groin, feet, or nails where topical therapy is not suitable or has failed to manage the condition.

Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving ZORBAX 500MG TABLET management. Before taking ZORBAX 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have skin, liver, or kidney problems or porphyria (which results from an increase in certain chemicals related to red blood cell proteins).

ZORBAX 500MG TABLET is not recommended for pregnant or breastfeeding women; therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking ZORBAX 500MG TABLET are headache, diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, or stomach discomfort. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, scalp, hair, groin, feet, and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZORBAX 500MG TABLET
Manage fungal infections of the skin, scalp, hair, groin, feet, and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How ZORBAX 500MG TABLET Works

ZORBAX 500MG TABLET inhibits the growth of fungi by binding to a part of the fungus causing the infection in the body. This stops the fungus from multiplying. It also manages fungus from spreading to new cells. These actions cause the fungal infection to shed completely.
usageDetails:
How to use ZORBAX 500MG TABLET

Take ZORBAX 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About FUNGICIDE 200MG TABLET

FUNGICIDE 200MG TABLET contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used in adults to manage systemic fungal infections, chronic mucocutaneous and vaginal candidiasis, oral rush candiduric (fungal infection of mouth), etc.

Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving FUNGICIDE 200MG TABLET management. Before taking FUNGICIDE 200MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or adrenal problems.

FUNGICIDE 200MG TABLET should be used during pregnancy only if the potential benefit justifies the potential risk to the baby. FUNGICIDE 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women. FUNGICIDE 200MG TABLET is not for use in children (especially under 2 years of age), so consult your doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of taking FUNGICIDE 200MG TABLET are nausea, headache, diarrhoea, stomach pain, etc. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of FUNGICIDE 200MG TABLET

Manages

Systemic fungal infections
Candidiasis (chronic mucocutaneous and vaginal)
Oral rush candiduric
mechanismOfAction:
How FUNGICIDE 200MG TABLET Works

FUNGICIDE 200MG TABLET works by blocking the synthesis of ergosterol (a key component of the fungal cell membrane) thus weakening the structure and function of the fungal cell membrane.
usageDetails:
How to use FUNGICIDE 200MG TABLET

Take FUNGICIDE 200MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not crush or chew it. Swallow FUNGICIDE 200MG TABLET as whole with a glass of water. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking FUNGICIDE 200MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

Adrenal insufficiency (tiredness, dizziness, weakness, nausea, vomiting)
Serious allergic reaction (rash, itching, hives, fever, swollen lips or tongue, chest pain, or trouble breathing)

warnings.details: FUNGICIDE 200MG TABLET should be used during pregnancy only if the potential benefit justifies the potential risk to the baby. Consult your doctor before taking it.
FUNGICIDE 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it can pass into the breastmilk. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy or sleepy after taking FUNGICIDE 200MG TABLET.
Do not consume alcohol while taking FUNGICIDE 200MG TABLET as it can lead to disulfiram-like reaction (a very uncomfortable reaction characterized by severe flushing). Consult your doctor for advice.
FUNGICIDE 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take FUNGICIDE 200MG TABLET if you are allergic to Ketoconazole or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

FUNGICIDE 200MG TABLET should be used with caution if you or any of your family members had an abnormal heart rhythm tracing (ECG) or a heart problem called “congenital long QT syndrome”. Consult your doctor before taking it.
FUNGICIDE 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (especially under 2 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.
FUNGICIDE 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients to avoid the risk of fracture. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

Before taking FUNGICIDE 200MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have adrenal insufficiency

introduction:
Introduction About FUNGISET 150MG TABLET

FUNGISET 150MG TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking FUNGISET 150MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

FUNGISET 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. FUNGISET 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking FUNGISET 150MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

How FUNGISET 150MG TABLET Works

FUNGISET 150MG TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.

introduction:
Introduction About FIXTRAL SB CAPSULE

FIXTRAL SB CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use FIXTRAL SB CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with FIXTRAL SB CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with FIXTRAL SB CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. FIXTRAL SB CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

FIXTRAL SB CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking FIXTRAL SB CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of FIXTRAL SB CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How FIXTRAL SB CAPSULE Works

FIXTRAL SB CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.
usageInstructions: Take this medicine as advised by your physician.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of FIXTRAL SB CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About AF 50MG TABLET

AF 50MG TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).      

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking AF 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

AF 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. AF 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking AF 50MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

How AF 50MG TABLET Works

AF 50MG TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.

introduction:
Introduction About ITROSTRED 200MG CAPSULE

ITROSTRED 200MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITROSTRED 200MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITROSTRED 200MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITROSTRED 200MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITROSTRED 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITROSTRED 200MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITROSTRED 200MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITROSTRED 200MG CAPSULE Works

ITROSTRED 200MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About IT MAC ORAL SOLUTION

IT MAC ORAL SOLUTION contains Itraconazole which belongs to a group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used to manage fungal infections in patients (with poor immune systems), which include yeast infections of the mouth, throat, or gullet. It is also used to manage fungal infections in patients with poor immunity systems that occur due to major blood disorders or bone marrow transplantation.

Yeast infection is a type of fungal infection that occurs when excess yeast (fungi) grows on the skin or other areas. It is generally characterized by symptoms such as white patches on the tongue, redness, soreness, or difficulty swallowing. 

IT MAC ORAL SOLUTION is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to Itraconazole. Before taking IT MAC ORAL SOLUTION, inform your doctor if you have heart problems (including congestive heart failure), kidney disorders, or liver problems (such as jaundice).

IT MAC ORAL SOLUTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless it is clearly advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) or elderly patients unless it is clearly advised by the doctor. 

The most common side effects of taking IT MAC ORAL SOLUTION are headache, stomachache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, unpleasant taste, and rash. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About FLUFUNG 400MG TABLET

FLUFUNG 400MG TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).      

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking FLUFUNG 400MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

FLUFUNG 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. FLUFUNG 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking FLUFUNG 400MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How FLUFUNG 400MG TABLET Works

FLUFUNG 400MG TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.

introduction:
Introduction About CANDITRAL 100MG CAPSULE

CANDITRAL 100MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use CANDITRAL 100MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with CANDITRAL 100MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with CANDITRAL 100MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. CANDITRAL 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

CANDITRAL 100MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking CANDITRAL 100MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How CANDITRAL 100MG CAPSULE Works

CANDITRAL 100MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About FUSYS 150MG TABLET

FUSYS 150MG TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking FUSYS 150MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

FUSYS 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. FUSYS 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking FUSYS 150MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

How FUSYS 150MG TABLET Works

FUSYS 150MG TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.

introduction:
Introduction About ITROMED POWDER

ITROMED POWDER is used to manage fungal skin infections such as tinea corporis (ring worm of the body), tinea cruris (fungal infection in the skin of the genitals, inner thighs, and buttocks), tinea pedis (fungal infection that usually begins between the toes), tinea versicolor (fungal infection that causes small, discoloured skin patches), and onychomycosis (nail infection) in affected individuals. It is also used to soothe irritated skin and provide relief from fungal itch in affected individuals. 

It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Patients allergic to itraconazole should not use ITROMED POWDER. It is not recommended for use in pregnant women, and this medicine should be used with caution in breast-feeding women only if advised by the doctor. 

The most common side effects associated with the use of ITROMED POWDER are skin irritation, rashes, burning sensation, redness, or itching at the application site. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITROMED POWDER
Fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How ITROMED POWDER Works

ITROMED POWDER works by inhibiting ergosterol synthesis (an organic compound responsible for maintaining cell membrane integrity of fungi cells) that leads to fungal cell membrane abnormalities (marked with increased permeability and disruption of fungi cells), thus causing destruction to the fungi cell and managing the occurrence of fungal infections in affected individuals.
usageInstructions: Use this medicine as advised by your physician.
It is for external use only.
Clean and wipe to dry the affected area before applying the medicine.
Sprinkle enough powder over the infected area.
Avoid rubbing it and avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, nose, and ears.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose, frequency, and duration of ITROMED POWDER for you depending upon your age and type or severity of the infection.

Introduction About ICA 100MG CAPSULE

ICA 100MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ICA 100MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ICA 100MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ICA 100MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ICA 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ICA 100MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ICA 100MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Uses Of ICA 100MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ICA 100MG CAPSULE Works

ICA 100MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About FUSYS DT 50MG TABLET

FUSYS DT 50MG TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).      

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking FUSYS DT 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

FUSYS DT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. FUSYS DT 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking FUSYS DT 50MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How FUSYS DT 50MG TABLET Works

FUSYS DT 50MG TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow FUSYS DT 50MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse FUSYS DT 50MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take FUSYS DT 50MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About LANTRAZ 200MG CAPSULE

LANTRAZ 200MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use LANTRAZ 200MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with LANTRAZ 200MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with LANTRAZ 200MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. LANTRAZ 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

LANTRAZ 200MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking LANTRAZ 200MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:

Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How LANTRAZ 200MG CAPSULE Works

LANTRAZ 200MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking ZOCON 400MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

ZOCON 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. ZOCON 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking ZOCON 400MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How ZOCON 400MG TABLET Works

ZOCON 400MG TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.

Introduction About TERBEST 500MG TABLET

TERBEST 500MG TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take TERBEST 500MG TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking TERBEST 500MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take TERBEST 500MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How TERBEST 500MG TABLET Works

TERBEST 500MG TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

Introduction About KENZ 200MG TABLET

KENZ 200MG TABLET contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used in adults to manage systemic fungal infections, chronic mucocutaneous and vaginal candidiasis, oral rush candiduric (fungal infection of mouth), etc.

Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving KENZ 200MG TABLET management. Before taking KENZ 200MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or adrenal problems.

KENZ 200MG TABLET should be used during pregnancy only if the potential benefit justifies the potential risk to the baby. KENZ 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women. KENZ 200MG TABLET is not for use in children (especially under 2 years of age), so consult your doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of taking KENZ 200MG TABLET are nausea, headache, diarrhoea, stomach pain, etc. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About ITRAFUNG 200 CAPSULE

ITRAFUNG 200 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRAFUNG 200 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITRAFUNG 200 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITRAFUNG 200 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITRAFUNG 200 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITRAFUNG 200 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITRAFUNG 200 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITRAFUNG 200 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITRAFUNG 200 CAPSULE Works

ITRAFUNG 200 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About FUNGISET 200 TABLET

FUNGISET 200 TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).   

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.

Before taking FUNGISET 200 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.

FUNGISET 200 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. FUNGISET 200 TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking FUNGISET 200 TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

introduction:
Introduction About NUFORCE 50 TABLET

NUFORCE 50 TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).      

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking NUFORCE 50 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

NUFORCE 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. NUFORCE 50 TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking NUFORCE 50 TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

How NUFORCE 50 TABLET Works

NUFORCE 50 TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse NUFORCE 50 TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take NUFORCE 50 TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About LIVAFIN O 200MG CAPSULE

LIVAFIN O 200MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use LIVAFIN O 200MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with LIVAFIN O 200MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with LIVAFIN O 200MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. LIVAFIN O 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

LIVAFIN O 200MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking LIVAFIN O 200MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LIVAFIN O 200MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How LIVAFIN O 200MG CAPSULE Works

LIVAFIN O 200MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About LAMIFIN DUSTING POWDER

LAMIFIN DUSTING POWDER is used topically to manage fungal skin infections. It contains Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

LAMIFIN DUSTING POWDER is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas. Use for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2 weeks of therapy.

Do not use LAMIFIN DUSTING POWDER if you are allergic to terbinafine. It is not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using LAMIFIN DUSTING POWDER are skin peeling, itching, skin color changes and burning sensation at the side effects. These side effects are usually harmless.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LAMIFIN DUSTING POWDER
Manage fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How LAMIFIN DUSTING POWDER Works

LAMIFIN DUSTING POWDER is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: LAMIFIN DUSTING POWDER is for external use only.
Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas.
Avoid contact of this medicine with your face, eyes, ears, nose or any other mucous membranes.
Wash your hands before and after application.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the infection.
Do not stop using LAMIFIN DUSTING POWDER without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About FORCAN 50MG TABLET

FORCAN 50MG TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).      

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking FORCAN 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

FORCAN 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. FORCAN 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking FORCAN 50MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

How FORCAN 50MG TABLET Works

FORCAN 50MG TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow FORCAN 50MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse FORCAN 50MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take FORCAN 50MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.
