introduction:
Introduction About ZOTINEA 200 CAPSULE

ZOTINEA 200 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ZOTINEA 200 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ZOTINEA 200 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ZOTINEA 200 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ZOTINEA 200 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ZOTINEA 200 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ZOTINEA 200 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZOTINEA 200 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ZOTINEA 200 CAPSULE Works

ZOTINEA 200 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About LULICAN XL CREAM

LULICAN XL CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULICAN XL CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULICAN XL CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULICAN XL CREAM

LULICAN XL CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULICAN XL CREAM Works

LULICAN XL CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, LULICAN XL CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.
usageInstructions: Apply this medicine as directed by your physician.
It is for external use only.
Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About CONAFORCE 200 CAPSULE

CONAFORCE 200 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use CONAFORCE 200 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with CONAFORCE 200 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with CONAFORCE 200 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. CONAFORCE 200 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

CONAFORCE 200 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking CONAFORCE 200 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CONAFORCE 200 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How CONAFORCE 200 CAPSULE Works

CONAFORCE 200 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About IT MAC 100MG CAPSULE

IT MAC 100MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use IT MAC 100MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with IT MAC 100MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with IT MAC 100MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. IT MAC 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

IT MAC 100MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking IT MAC 100MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How IT MAC 100MG CAPSULE Works

IT MAC 100MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About FLUMET 200MG TABLET

FLUMET 200MG TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).   

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.

Before taking FLUMET 200MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.

FLUMET 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. FLUMET 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking FLUMET 200MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

How FLUMET 200MG TABLET Works

FLUMET 200MG TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.

Introduction About ZOCON 150 TABLET

ZOCON 150 TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking ZOCON 150 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

ZOCON 150 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. ZOCON 150 TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking ZOCON 150 TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

introduction:
Introduction About METROLYN GEL

METROLYN GEL contains Metronidazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiprotozoal drugs. It helps to control infection and inflammation in certain skin problems, such as rosacea (skin redness and flushing with or without small red pus-filled pustules on the skin) and acne. It is also helpful in the management of wound infections, diabetic foot ulcers and vaginal infections.

METROLYN GEL is for external use only. Cleanse and dry the affected areas before applying the medicine. Do not expose the managed areas in direct sunlight. Wear protective clothing and consult your doctor for a suitable sunscreen while going outdoors.

Before using METROLYN GEL, inform your doctor if you are suffering from any kind of blood disorders (Ex. blood dyscrasias) or neurological disorders (such as nerve damage). You must also inform your doctor if you suffer from any allergic skin conditions (such as contact dermatitis) as a precaution.

Do not use METROLYN GEL without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of using METROLYN GEL are skin dryness, redness, itching and/or irritation at the site of application. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you.

How METROLYN GEL Works

METROLYN GEL is an antiprotozoal agent with antibacterial properties. It works by killing the susceptible germs that cause infections in the body. When applied on the skin, it destroys the infection causing germs and manages their further growth and multiplication which therefore reduces the severity of the infection.

Always apply METROLYN GEL as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Clean and dry the affected area before application. Apply a thin layer of METROLYN GEL on the affected areas. Wash your hands before and after application.

Avoid contact of METROLYN GEL with eyes, ears, mouth, or nose. In case of accidental contact, rinse it with plenty of warm water. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your skin condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ITROSTRED SB 65 CAPSULE

ITROSTRED SB 65 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITROSTRED SB 65 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITROSTRED SB 65 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITROSTRED SB 65 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITROSTRED SB 65 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITROSTRED SB 65 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITROSTRED SB 65 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITROSTRED SB 65 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITROSTRED SB 65 CAPSULE Works

ITROSTRED SB 65 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ITROSTRED SB 65 CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TERBINAFORCE 500MG TABLET

TERBINAFORCE 500MG TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take TERBINAFORCE 500MG TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking TERBINAFORCE 500MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take TERBINAFORCE 500MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails

Uses Of TERBINAFORCE 500MG TABLET
Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How TERBINAFORCE 500MG TABLET Works

TERBINAFORCE 500MG TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

name: ITROSTRED Dusting Powder 75gm
introduction:
Introduction About ITROSTRED DUSTING POWDER

ITROSTRED DUSTING POWDER is used to manage fungal skin infections such as tinea corporis (ring worm of the body), tinea cruris (fungal infection in the skin of the genitals, inner thighs, and buttocks), tinea pedis (fungal infection that usually begins between the toes), tinea versicolor (fungal infection that causes small, discoloured skin patches), and onychomycosis (nail infection) in affected individuals. It is also used to soothe irritated skin and provide relief from fungal itch in affected individuals. 

It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Patients allergic to itraconazole should not use ITROSTRED DUSTING POWDER. It is not recommended for use in pregnant women, and this medicine should be used with caution in breast-feeding women only if advised by the doctor. 

The most common side effects associated with the use of ITROSTRED DUSTING POWDER are skin irritation, rashes, burning sensation, redness, or itching at the application site. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITROSTRED DUSTING POWDER
Fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How ITROSTRED DUSTING POWDER Works

ITROSTRED DUSTING POWDER works by inhibiting ergosterol synthesis (an organic compound responsible for maintaining cell membrane integrity of fungi cells) that leads to fungal cell membrane abnormalities (marked with increased permeability and disruption of fungi cells), thus causing destruction to the fungi cell and managing the occurrence of fungal infections in affected individuals.
usageInstructions: Use this medicine as advised by your physician.
It is for external use only.
Clean and wipe to dry the affected area before applying the medicine.
Sprinkle enough powder over the infected area.
Avoid rubbing it and avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, nose, and ears.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose, frequency, and duration of ITROSTRED DUSTING POWDER for you depending upon your age and type or severity of the infection.

introduction:
Introduction About ALCROS 100MG CAPSULE

ALCROS 100MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ALCROS 100MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ALCROS 100MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ALCROS 100MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ALCROS 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ALCROS 100MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ALCROS 100MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ALCROS 100MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ALCROS 100MG CAPSULE Works

ALCROS 100MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ALCROS 100MG CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About JIMLIG 100 CAPSULE

JIMLIG 100 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use JIMLIG 100 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with JIMLIG 100 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with JIMLIG 100 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. JIMLIG 100 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

JIMLIG 100 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking JIMLIG 100 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of JIMLIG 100 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How JIMLIG 100 CAPSULE Works

JIMLIG 100 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of JIMLIG 100 CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

IT MAC 200MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking IT MAC 200MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About NUFORCE 150MG TABLET

NUFORCE 150MG TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking NUFORCE 150MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

NUFORCE 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. NUFORCE 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking NUFORCE 150MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How NUFORCE 150MG TABLET Works

NUFORCE 150MG TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.

introduction:
Introduction About ONITRAZ FORTE CAPSULE

ONITRAZ FORTE CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ONITRAZ FORTE CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ONITRAZ FORTE CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ONITRAZ FORTE CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ONITRAZ FORTE CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ONITRAZ FORTE CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ONITRAZ FORTE CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ONITRAZ FORTE CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ONITRAZ FORTE CAPSULE Works

ONITRAZ FORTE CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About NUFLUCON 150MG TABLET

NUFLUCON 150MG TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking NUFLUCON 150MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

NUFLUCON 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. NUFLUCON 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking NUFLUCON 150MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How NUFLUCON 150MG TABLET Works

NUFLUCON 150MG TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking NUFLUCON 150MG TABLET, inform your doctor, if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage diabetes medicines (Ex. glyburide, tolbutamide, glipizide, chlorpropamide)
Medicines used to manage high blood pressure (Ex. hydrochlorothiazide, nifedipine, isradipine, amlodipine, felodipine and losartan)
Medicines used as blood thinners (Ex. warfarin)
Medicines used to use to manage rejection of organ transplants (Ex. cyclosporine, tacrolimus, sirolimus)
Rifampicin or rifabutin (used to manage tuberculosis)
Astemizole, terfenadine (used to manage certain type of allergies)
Medicines used to control seizures /fits (Ex. phenytoin or carbamazepine)
Theophylline (used to control asthma)
Cisapride (used to manage heartburn)
Medicines used to manage heart diseases (Ex. quinidine, amiodarone)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. amitriptyline, nortriptyline)
Pimozide (used to control motor or verbal tics)
Amphotericin B, voriconazole (medicine for managing various fungal infections)
Erythromycin (used for managing bacterial infections)
Cyclosphosphamide, medicines used for management of cancer (Ex. vincristine or vinblastine)
Alfentanil, fentanyl (used as general anesthetic)
Halofantrine (for managing malaria)
Medicines used to manage high cholesterol levels (Ex. atorvastatin, simvastatin, and fluvastatin)
Medicines used to manage painful conditions with inflammation (Ex. celecoxib, ibuprofen, and naproxen)
Prednisone (used to manage inflammatory disorders)
Antiviral medications used to manage HIV infection (Ex.  saquinavir, zidovudine)
Tofacitinib (used to manage rheumatoid arthritis)
Ivacaftor (medicine used for managing cystic fibrosis)
Ibrutinib (used for managing blood cancer)
Midazolam, triazolam or similar medicines (used to induce sleep and manages anxiety)
Olaparib (used for managing ovarian cancer)
Methadone (used to manage chronic pain and also opioid dependance)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of NUFLUCON 150MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of NUFLUCON 150MG TABLET are hearing, seeing, feeling and thinking things that are not real (hallucination and paranoid behaviour).

Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.

introduction:
Introduction About ITRUF CAPSULE

ITRUF CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRUF CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITRUF CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITRUF CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITRUF CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITRUF CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITRUF CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITRUF CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITRUF CAPSULE Works

ITRUF CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About ALTISPOR 200 CAPSULE

ALTISPOR 200 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ALTISPOR 200 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ALTISPOR 200 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ALTISPOR 200 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ALTISPOR 200 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ALTISPOR 200 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ALTISPOR 200 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ALTISPOR 200 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ALTISPOR 200 CAPSULE Works

ALTISPOR 200 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ALTISPOR 200 CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TYZA TABLET

TYZA TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take TYZA TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking TYZA TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take TYZA TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of TYZA TABLET
Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How TYZA TABLET Works

TYZA TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse TYZA TABLET in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About KETOVATE TABLET

KETOVATE TABLET contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used in adults to manage systemic fungal infections, chronic mucocutaneous and vaginal candidiasis, oral rush candiduric (fungal infection of mouth), etc.

Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving KETOVATE TABLET management. Before taking KETOVATE TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or adrenal problems.

KETOVATE TABLET should be used during pregnancy only if the potential benefit justifies the potential risk to the baby. KETOVATE TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women. KETOVATE TABLET is not for use in children (especially under 2 years of age), so consult your doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of taking KETOVATE TABLET are nausea, headache, diarrhoea, stomach pain, etc. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.

Manages

Systemic fungal infections
Candidiasis (chronic mucocutaneous and vaginal)
Oral rush candiduric
mechanismOfAction:
How KETOVATE TABLET Works

KETOVATE TABLET works by blocking the synthesis of ergosterol (a key component of the fungal cell membrane) thus weakening the structure and function of the fungal cell membrane.

Take KETOVATE TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not crush or chew it. Swallow KETOVATE TABLET as whole with a glass of water. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking KETOVATE TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy or sleepy after taking KETOVATE TABLET.
Do not consume alcohol while taking KETOVATE TABLET as it can lead to disulfiram-like reaction (a very uncomfortable reaction characterized by severe flushing). Consult your doctor for advice.

Do not take KETOVATE TABLET if you are allergic to Ketoconazole or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

KETOVATE TABLET should be used with caution if you or any of your family members had an abnormal heart rhythm tracing (ECG) or a heart problem called “congenital long QT syndrome”. Consult your doctor before taking it.
KETOVATE TABLET is not recommended for use in children (especially under 2 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.
KETOVATE TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients to avoid the risk of fracture. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

Before taking KETOVATE TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have adrenal insufficiency

introduction:
Introduction About ITROSTRED SB 130 CAPSULE

ITROSTRED SB 130 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITROSTRED SB 130 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITROSTRED SB 130 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITROSTRED SB 130 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITROSTRED SB 130 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITROSTRED SB 130 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITROSTRED SB 130 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

name: JIMLIG SB 65 Capsule 10's
introduction:
Introduction About JIMLIG SB 65 CAPSULE

JIMLIG SB 65 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use JIMLIG SB 65 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with JIMLIG SB 65 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with JIMLIG SB 65 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. JIMLIG SB 65 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

JIMLIG SB 65 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking JIMLIG SB 65 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of JIMLIG SB 65 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How JIMLIG SB 65 CAPSULE Works

JIMLIG SB 65 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About MICOGERM F OINTMENT

MICOGERM F OINTMENT is a combination of Fluocinolone and Miconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids and Antifungals respectively. It is used to manage various skin infections athlete’s foot (Tinea pedis), ringworm (Tinea corporis), vaginal thrush, and sweat rash.

A fungal infection (also called mycosis) is a skin disease that is caused by a fungus when it enters the tissue. Fungal infections can be contagious and spread from one person to another person.

Avoid MICOGERM F OINTMENT contact with eyes. MICOGERM F OINTMENT is not recommended for use in patients having rosacea (a skin condition that causes blushing or flushing and visible blood vessels in the face), acne, perioral dermatitis, anogenital pruritus, and napkin eruptions.

MICOGERM F OINTMENT is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary.

MICOGERM F OINTMENT is not recommended in children and adolescents (below 12 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor for advice before taking the medicine.

The most common side effects of MICOGERM F OINTMENT are application site reactions (like burning, irritation, itching, and redness). If any of these symptoms worsen, consult your physician.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MICOGERM F OINTMENT

It is used to manage skin infections such as:

Athlete’s foot (Tinea pedis)
Ringworm (Tinea corporis)
Vaginal thrush
Sweat rash
mechanismOfAction:
How MICOGERM F OINTMENT Works

MICOGERM F OINTMENT is a combination of Fluocinolone and Miconazole. Fluocinolone works by blocking the production of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) that make the skin red, swollen, and itchy. Miconazole is an antifungal which stops the growth of fungi on the skin by managing them from forming their own protective covering. Thus, both together Fluocinolone and Miconazole help to manage various skin infections.
usageDetails:
How to use MICOGERM F OINTMENT

Apply MICOGERM F OINTMENT as directed by your physician. Clean and dry the area which is affected before the application. It is for external use only. Wash hands before and after the application MICOGERM F OINTMENT. Your doctor will decide the right dose depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About FUNGEEHEAL SB 130 CAPSULE

FUNGEEHEAL SB 130 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use FUNGEEHEAL SB 130 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with FUNGEEHEAL SB 130 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with FUNGEEHEAL SB 130 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. FUNGEEHEAL SB 130 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

FUNGEEHEAL SB 130 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking FUNGEEHEAL SB 130 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of FUNGEEHEAL SB 130 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How FUNGEEHEAL SB 130 CAPSULE Works

FUNGEEHEAL SB 130 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of FUNGEEHEAL SB 130 CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About IFIN 500MG TABLET

IFIN 500MG TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take IFIN 500MG TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking IFIN 500MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take IFIN 500MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of IFIN 500MG TABLET
Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How IFIN 500MG TABLET Works

IFIN 500MG TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: Take IFIN 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician.
For Tablet: Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. But in children younger than 6 years, the medicine should be crushed before swallowing.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse IFIN 500MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About GLOSPOR DS CAPSULE

GLOSPOR DS CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use GLOSPOR DS CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with GLOSPOR DS CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with GLOSPOR DS CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. GLOSPOR DS CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

GLOSPOR DS CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking GLOSPOR DS CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How GLOSPOR DS CAPSULE Works

GLOSPOR DS CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About ITRATUF ORAL SOLUTION

ITRATUF ORAL SOLUTION contains Itraconazole which belongs to a group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used to manage fungal infections in patients (with poor immune systems), which include yeast infections of the mouth, throat, or gullet. It is also used to manage fungal infections in patients with poor immunity systems that occur due to major blood disorders or bone marrow transplantation.

Yeast infection is a type of fungal infection that occurs when excess yeast (fungi) grows on the skin or other areas. It is generally characterized by symptoms such as white patches on the tongue, redness, soreness, or difficulty swallowing. 

ITRATUF ORAL SOLUTION is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to Itraconazole. Before taking ITRATUF ORAL SOLUTION, inform your doctor if you have heart problems (including congestive heart failure), kidney disorders, or liver problems (such as jaundice).

ITRATUF ORAL SOLUTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless it is clearly advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) or elderly patients unless it is clearly advised by the doctor. 

The most common side effects of taking ITRATUF ORAL SOLUTION are headache, stomachache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, unpleasant taste, and rash. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About FLUMET 150MG TABLET

FLUMET 150MG TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking FLUMET 150MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

FLUMET 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. FLUMET 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking FLUMET 150MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

FLUMET 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart rhythm problems. Consult your doctor for advice before taking FLUMET 150MG TABLET.

Others

Rare hereditary problems of galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption

Before taking FLUMET 150MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood
Are prone to develop severe skin reactions (itching, reddening of the skin or difficulty in breathing)
Have history of adrenal insufficiency
Have no improvement in fungal infection

Use in Pediatrics:

FLUMET 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). Consult child’s doctor for advice before administration of FLUMET 150MG TABLET to your child.

FLUMET 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment. Your doctor may adjust the dose depending upon kidney function. Consult your doctor for advice before taking FLUMET 150MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About ITRASYS SB 130 CAPSULE

ITRASYS SB 130 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRASYS SB 130 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITRASYS SB 130 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITRASYS SB 130 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITRASYS SB 130 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITRASYS SB 130 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITRASYS SB 130 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITRASYS SB 130 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITRASYS SB 130 CAPSULE Works

ITRASYS SB 130 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ITRASYS SB 130 CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About MYCOSOL TABLET

MYCOSOL TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take MYCOSOL TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking MYCOSOL TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take MYCOSOL TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of MYCOSOL TABLET
Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How MYCOSOL TABLET Works

MYCOSOL TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse MYCOSOL TABLET in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ZOCON L CREAM

ZOCON L CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

ZOCON L CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying ZOCON L CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZOCON L CREAM

ZOCON L CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How ZOCON L CREAM Works

ZOCON L CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, ZOCON L CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.

introduction:
Introduction About FLUFUNG 50MG TABLET

FLUFUNG 50MG TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).      

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking FLUFUNG 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

FLUFUNG 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. FLUFUNG 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking FLUFUNG 50MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

How FLUFUNG 50MG TABLET Works

FLUFUNG 50MG TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take FLUFUNG 50MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About NIXITRAL 200MG CAPSULE

NIXITRAL 200MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use NIXITRAL 200MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with NIXITRAL 200MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with NIXITRAL 200MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. NIXITRAL 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

NIXITRAL 200MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking NIXITRAL 200MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NIXITRAL 200MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How NIXITRAL 200MG CAPSULE Works

NIXITRAL 200MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

name: TEXIFEN 500mg Tablet 7's
introduction:
Introduction About TEXIFEN 500MG TABLET

TEXIFEN 500MG TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take TEXIFEN 500MG TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking TEXIFEN 500MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take TEXIFEN 500MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of TEXIFEN 500MG TABLET
Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How TEXIFEN 500MG TABLET Works

TEXIFEN 500MG TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: Take TEXIFEN 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician.
For Tablet: Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. But in children younger than 6 years, the medicine should be crushed before swallowing.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse TEXIFEN 500MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Take TEXIFEN 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician.
For Tablet: Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. But in children younger than 6 years, the medicine should be crushed before swallowing.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse TEXIFEN 500MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Signs of liver problems (such as unexplained persistent nausea, stomach problems, loss of appetite, unusual tiredness or weakness with yellowing of your skin or eyes, dark urine and pale faeces)
Inflammation of blood vessels causing purple spots under the skin
Inflammation of the pancreas causing severe stomach pain which radiates towards the back side
Signs of muscle breakdown (such as unexplained muscle weakness and dark or red urine)
Signs of low blood count (such as weakness, unusual bleeding, bruising, abnormal pale skin, unusual tiredness, or weakness or breathlessness on exertion or frequent infections)

Headache
Nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, indigestion, bloating
Diarrhea
Muscle pain, joint pain
Skin rash, itching and swelling

Stop taking TEXIFEN 500MG TABLET and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Signs of liver problems (such as unexplained persistent nausea, stomach problems, loss of appetite, unusual tiredness or weakness with yellowing of your skin or eyes, dark urine and pale faeces)
Inflammation of blood vessels causing purple spots under the skin
Inflammation of the pancreas causing severe stomach pain which radiates towards the back side
Signs of muscle breakdown (such as unexplained muscle weakness and dark or red urine)
Signs of low blood count (such as weakness, unusual bleeding, bruising, abnormal pale skin, unusual tiredness, or weakness or breathlessness on exertion or frequent infections)

TEXIFEN 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience dizziness after taking TEXIFEN 500MG TABLET.
TEXIFEN 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems.
TEXIFEN 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with an active or a previous history of liver problems.
Do not take TEXIFEN 500MG TABLET if you are allergic to Terbinafine.
TEXIFEN 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years).
TEXIFEN 500MG TABLET can be used with caution in elderly patients.

Have psoriasis (scaly white patches on the skin)
Have systemic lupus erythematosus (a serious skin condition)

introduction:
Introduction About FLUCOS 150 TABLET

FLUCOS 150 TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking FLUCOS 150 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

FLUCOS 150 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. FLUCOS 150 TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking FLUCOS 150 TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

How FLUCOS 150 TABLET Works

FLUCOS 150 TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.

introduction:
Introduction About ITASPOR SB FORTE CAPSULE

ITASPOR SB FORTE CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITASPOR SB FORTE CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITASPOR SB FORTE CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITASPOR SB FORTE CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITASPOR SB FORTE CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITASPOR SB FORTE CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITASPOR SB FORTE CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITASPOR SB FORTE CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITASPOR SB FORTE CAPSULE Works

ITASPOR SB FORTE CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.
