introduction:
Introduction About LULIPORUS CREAM

LULIPORUS CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

LULIPORUS CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying LULIPORUS CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

name: AMROBRUT Cream 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About AMROBRUT CREAM

Amrobrut Cream is an antifungal cream used for fungal skin infections caused by dermatophytes. It contains Amorolfine which is indicated in the management of dermatomycoses caused by dermatophytes, that is tinea pedis (athlete’s foot), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the groin and inner thighs), tinea corporis (ringworm), and tinea manuum (fungal infection on both hands). It is also indicated used for cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

Amorolfine acts by inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol (an essential component of fungal cell membranes) which leads to alternation in fungal cell membrane permeability, disruption of key fungal metabolic processes, and cell death.  

Always use Amrobrut Cream as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. It has to be applied to the affected area once daily. Do not use Amrobrut cream if you are allergic to any of its ingredients. Avoid contact with eyes, ears, and mucous membranes.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of AMROBRUT CREAM

Amrobrut Cream may cause side effects such as burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. If you experience any unusual side effects, stop using it and contact your healthcare professional immediately.

introduction:
Introduction About APEXITRA 100MG CAPSULE

APEXITRA 100MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use APEXITRA 100MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with APEXITRA 100MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with APEXITRA 100MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. APEXITRA 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

APEXITRA 100MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking APEXITRA 100MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of APEXITRA 100MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How APEXITRA 100MG CAPSULE Works

APEXITRA 100MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

Introduction About TEXIFORD 250 TABLET

TEXIFORD 250 TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take TEXIFORD 250 TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking TEXIFORD 250 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take TEXIFORD 250 TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

How TEXIFORD 250 TABLET Works

It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About CURAFUNG CAPSULE

CURAFUNG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use CURAFUNG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with CURAFUNG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with CURAFUNG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. CURAFUNG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

CURAFUNG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking CURAFUNG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CURAFUNG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How CURAFUNG CAPSULE Works

CURAFUNG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About ZOCON T KIT

ZOCON T KIT is a combination of Fluconazole and Tinidazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal and Antiprotozoal agents respectively. It is used to manage vaginal infections caused by fungus.

Avoid alcohol consumption while taking this medicine because it may cause abdominal cramps, nausea, vomiting, headache, flushing and tachycardia.

Before taking ZOCON T KIT inform your doctor if you have lung, liver or kidney disease or heart rhythm disorders.

ZOCON T KIT is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking.

ZOCON T KIT is not recommended for use in breast feeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking.

ZOCON T KIT is not recommended for use in children. Contact your doctor before taking. ZOCON T KIT should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years or above. Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are nausea, vomiting, headache, stomach discomfort, indigestion, diarrhoea, constipation, anorexia, change in taste, rashes, dizziness, weakness etc. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZOCON T KIT
Used to manage vaginal infections
mechanismOfAction:
How ZOCON T KIT Works

ZOCON T KIT helps to manage vaginal infections, where Fluconazole works by inhibiting the formation of ergosterol which is essential for fungal cell wall synthesis, leading to death of fungal cells and Tinidazole works by damaging the DNA. Together, reduces the infection.

GRIS ODT 250MG TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take GRIS ODT 250MG TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking GRIS ODT 250MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take GRIS ODT 250MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

How GRIS ODT 250MG TABLET Works

GRIS ODT 250MG TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About PHYTORAL TABLET

PHYTORAL TABLET contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used in adults to manage systemic fungal infections, chronic mucocutaneous and vaginal candidiasis, oral rush candiduric (fungal infection of mouth), etc.

Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving PHYTORAL TABLET management. Before taking PHYTORAL TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or adrenal problems.

PHYTORAL TABLET should be used during pregnancy only if the potential benefit justifies the potential risk to the baby. PHYTORAL TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women. PHYTORAL TABLET is not for use in children (especially under 2 years of age), so consult your doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of taking PHYTORAL TABLET are nausea, headache, diarrhoea, stomach pain, etc. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:

Manages

Systemic fungal infections
Candidiasis (chronic mucocutaneous and vaginal)
Oral rush candiduric
mechanismOfAction:
How PHYTORAL TABLET Works

PHYTORAL TABLET works by blocking the synthesis of ergosterol (a key component of the fungal cell membrane) thus weakening the structure and function of the fungal cell membrane.
usageDetails:
How to use PHYTORAL TABLET

Take PHYTORAL TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not crush or chew it. Swallow PHYTORAL TABLET as whole with a glass of water. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking PHYTORAL TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

Serious allergic reaction (rash, itching, hives, fever, swollen lips or tongue, chest pain, or trouble breathing)

warnings.details: PHYTORAL TABLET should be used during pregnancy only if the potential benefit justifies the potential risk to the baby. Consult your doctor before taking it.
PHYTORAL TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it can pass into the breastmilk. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy or sleepy after taking PHYTORAL TABLET.
Do not consume alcohol while taking PHYTORAL TABLET as it can lead to disulfiram-like reaction (a very uncomfortable reaction characterized by severe flushing). Consult your doctor for advice.
PHYTORAL TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take PHYTORAL TABLET if you are allergic to Ketoconazole or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

PHYTORAL TABLET should be used with caution if you or any of your family members had an abnormal heart rhythm tracing (ECG) or a heart problem called “congenital long QT syndrome”. Consult your doctor before taking it.
PHYTORAL TABLET is not recommended for use in children (especially under 2 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.
PHYTORAL TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients to avoid the risk of fracture. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

Before taking PHYTORAL TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have adrenal insufficiency

introduction:
Introduction About ITRAFUNG 100MG CAPSULE

ITRAFUNG 100MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRAFUNG 100MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITRAFUNG 100MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITRAFUNG 100MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITRAFUNG 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITRAFUNG 100MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITRAFUNG 100MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITRAFUNG 100MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITRAFUNG 100MG CAPSULE Works

ITRAFUNG 100MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ITRAFUNG 100MG CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ITRA RD 100MG CAPSULE

ITRA RD 100MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRA RD 100MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITRA RD 100MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITRA RD 100MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITRA RD 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITRA RD 100MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITRA RD 100MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITRA RD 100MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITRA RD 100MG CAPSULE Works

ITRA RD 100MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.
usageInstructions: Take this medicine as advised by your physician.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ITRA RD 100MG CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

warnings.details: ITRA RD 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor. You should use contraception to make sure that you do not become pregnant during management with this medicine.
ITRA RD 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women as a small amount of this medicine passes into breast milk.
Do not drive or handle heavy machines if you experience dizziness, blurred/double vision, or hearing loss while taking ITRA RD 100MG CAPSULE.
Consumption of alcohol is not recommended during management with ITRA RD 100MG CAPSULE.
ITRA RD 100MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems.
ITRA RD 100MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with liver problems such as jaundice.

ITRA RD 100MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with heart problems such as heart failure.
ITRA RD 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age. However, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases.
ITRA RD 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in elderly patients. However, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases.

Others

Have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS) or your immune system is not functioning well

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking ITRA RD 100MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage allergies or hay fever, Ex. terfenadine, astemizole, ebastine, mizolastine
Medicines used to lower blood cholesterol levels Ex. atorvastatin, lovastatin, simvastatin
Medicines used to manage irregular heartbeat Ex. quinidine, disopyramide, dronedarone, or dofetilide
Medicines used to manage chest pain and high blood pressure Ex. bepridil, lercanidipine, ivabradine, ranolazine, nisoldipine, aliskiren, nadolol, digoxin, cilostazol dihydropyridines such as amlodipine, felodipine, and verapamil
Medicines used to manage migraine headaches Ex. dihydroergotamine, eletriptan, ergotamine
Medicines used to manage drug abuse Ex. levacetylmethadol and methadone
Medicines used to manage digestive problems Ex. cisapride
Colchicine (used to manage gout)
Medicines used to manage fluid accumulation, Ex. Eplerenone
Medicines used after labour Ex. ergometrine, methylergometrine
Medicine used to manage malaria Ex. halofantrine
Medicines used to manage cancer Ex. irinotecan, bortezomib, busulphan, docetaxel, erlotinib, ixabepilone, trimetrexate, axitinib, dabrafenib, dasatinib, ibrutinib, lapatinib, nilotinib, sunitinib, and trabectedin
Medicines used as blood thinners Ex. dabigatran, ticagrelor, rivaroxaban, warfarin
Medicines used to manage mental illness Ex. quetiapine, pimozide, lurasidone, aripiprazole, haloperidol, perospirone, ramelteon, risperidone, reboxetine, and sertindole
Medicines used to manage urinary bladder disorders Ex. darifenacin, tamsulosin, fesoterodine, imidafenacin, solifenacin, and tolterodine
Medicines used to manage anxiety Ex. midazolam, triazolam, buspirone, alprazolam, brotizolam
Medicines used after an organ transplant Ex. everolimus, ciclesonide, temsirolimus, ciclosporin, tacrolimus, sirolimus
Medicines used to relive pain Ex. fentanyl, alfentanil, buprenorphine, oxycodone
Medicines used to manage inflammation or asthma Ex. salmeterol, methylprednisolone, fluticasone, budesonide, dexamethasone
Medicines used to manage erection problems Ex. vardenafil, sildenafil and tadalafil
Medicines used to manage indigestion, stomach ulcers, or heartburn Ex. Pantoprazole, omeprazole
Medicines used to manage HIV infection Ex. ritonavir, darunavir, indinavir, fosamprenavir, saquinivir
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections Ex. ciprofloxacin, clarithromycin, erythromycin
Medicines used to manage tuberculosis Ex. rifampicin, rifabutin, or isoniazid
Medicines used to manage epilepsy Ex. phenytoin, carbamazepine, or phenobarbital
St. John’s Wort (used to manage depression)
Medicines used to manage eczema Ex. alitretinoin
Medicines used to manage vomiting Ex. aprepitant, domperidone
Medicines used to manage excess thyroid hormone secretion Ex. cinacalcet
Medicines used to manage low sodium blood levels Ex. mozavaptan or tolvaptan
Medicines used to manage worms Ex. praziquantel
Medicines used to manage high blood sugar Ex. Repaglinide, saxagliptin
Medicines used to relive inflammation and pain Ex. meloxicam

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of ITRA RD 100MG CAPSULE, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital.

name: Kenozole 2% Shampoo 60ml
introduction:
Introduction About KENOZOLE 2% SHAMPOO

KENOZOLE 2% SHAMPOO contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used to manage fungal infections on scalp and body such as dandruff, seborrheic dermatitis (a dry or oily scaling of the scalp and other parts of the body) and tinea versicolor.

These conditions can be itchy and are caused by a fungus called Malassezia. Tinea versicolor is characterised by white to brown patches on the body that sometimes appear after exposure to the sun.

Before using KENOZOLE 2% SHAMPOO, inform your doctor if you have any liver problems or if you are using any steroids. KENOZOLE 2% SHAMPOO can be used by pregnant and breastfeeding women, but consult your doctor for advice. KENOZOLE 2% SHAMPOO should not be used in infants or children.

The most common side effects of using KENOZOLE 2% SHAMPOO are itching, stinging, and dryness at the site of application. Call your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KENOZOLE 2% SHAMPOO

Manages fungal infections like

Dandruff
Seborrheic dermatitis
Tinea versicolor
mechanismOfAction:
How KENOZOLE 2% SHAMPOO Works

KENOZOLE 2% SHAMPOO works by arresting growth in fungal cells thus, managing growth and spread of the fungus throughout your body.
usageDetails:
How to use KENOZOLE 2% SHAMPOO

Use KENOZOLE 2% SHAMPOO as advised by your physician. It is for use on hair and skin only. Wet your hair and scalp thoroughly with water, and apply a sufficient amount of soap to produce enough lather. Smoothly massage the lather over the entire scalp. Allow for 3-5 minutes before thoroughly washing off.

If KENOZOLE 2% SHAMPOO accidentally gets in your eye, gently rinse your eyes with cold water. Do not swallow it. Your doctor will determine the right dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight, and disease condition.
sideEffects: Itching, stinging and dryness on the site of application
Allergic reaction (swelling of the face, lips, mouth, tongue, or throat which may cause trouble in swallowing or breathing)
Severe irritation or reddening of the skin on the applied area
Peeling or blistering of the skin
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of KENOZOLE 2% SHAMPOO
Common
Itching, stinging and dryness on the site of application
Uncommon
Infection of the hair roots
Increased production of tears
Abnormal hair loss or thinning
Dry skin, rash, burning feeling
Your hair feeling different
Rare
Taste impairment
Irritation of the eyes
Acne
Flaking skin

Stop using KENOZOLE 2% SHAMPOO and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Allergic reaction (swelling of the face, lips, mouth, tongue, or throat which may cause trouble in swallowing or breathing)
Severe irritation or reddening of the skin on the applied area
Peeling or blistering of the skin

warnings.details: KENOZOLE 2% SHAMPOO can generally be used in pregnant women, however, consult your doctor before using it.
KENOZOLE 2% SHAMPOO can generally be used in breastfeeding women, however, consult your doctor before using it.
KENOZOLE 2% SHAMPOO is unlikely to affect your ability to drive or to use machinery.
KENOZOLE 2% SHAMPOO is not recommended for use in patients with acute or chronic liver disease. Consult your doctor before using it.
Do not use KENOZOLE 2% SHAMPOO if you are allergic to Ketoconazole or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.
KENOZOLE 2% SHAMPOO is not recommended for use in infants and children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.
KENOZOLE 2% SHAMPOO should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About ONECAN 50MG TABLET

ONECAN 50MG TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).      

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking ONECAN 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

ONECAN 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. ONECAN 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking ONECAN 50MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How ONECAN 50MG TABLET Works

ONECAN 50MG TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow ONECAN 50MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse ONECAN 50MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take ONECAN 50MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About CANDITRAL SB 65 CAPSULE

CANDITRAL SB 65 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use CANDITRAL SB 65 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with CANDITRAL SB 65 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with CANDITRAL SB 65 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. CANDITRAL SB 65 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

CANDITRAL SB 65 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking CANDITRAL SB 65 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CANDITRAL SB 65 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How CANDITRAL SB 65 CAPSULE Works

CANDITRAL SB 65 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About TERBITOTAL 250MG TABLET

TERBITOTAL 250MG TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take TERBITOTAL 250MG TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking TERBITOTAL 250MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take TERBITOTAL 250MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of TERBITOTAL 250MG TABLET
Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How TERBITOTAL 250MG TABLET Works

TERBITOTAL 250MG TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: Take TERBITOTAL 250MG TABLET as advised by your physician.
For Tablet: Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. But in children younger than 6 years, the medicine should be crushed before swallowing.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse TERBITOTAL 250MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ITRAGREAT SB 65 CAPSULE

ITRAGREAT SB 65 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRAGREAT SB 65 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITRAGREAT SB 65 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITRAGREAT SB 65 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITRAGREAT SB 65 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITRAGREAT SB 65 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITRAGREAT SB 65 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITRAGREAT SB 65 CAPSULE Works

ITRAGREAT SB 65 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About TERBINEXT 500MG TABLET

TERBINEXT 500MG TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take TERBINEXT 500MG TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking TERBINEXT 500MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take TERBINEXT 500MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of TERBINEXT 500MG TABLET
Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How TERBINEXT 500MG TABLET Works

TERBINEXT 500MG TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: Take TERBINEXT 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician.
For Tablet: Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. But in children younger than 6 years, the medicine should be crushed before swallowing.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse TERBINEXT 500MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ITRATUF SB 65 CAPSULE

ITRATUF SB 65 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRATUF SB 65 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITRATUF SB 65 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITRATUF SB 65 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITRATUF SB 65 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITRATUF SB 65 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITRATUF SB 65 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITRATUF SB 65 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITRATUF SB 65 CAPSULE Works

ITRATUF SB 65 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About NIZOCLIN 2% CREAM

NIZOCLIN 2% CREAM is used to manage fungal skin infections. It can be applied on your hands, feet, genital area, trunk, scalp, face and chest.

It contains an antifungal agent called Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. Use NIZOCLIN 2% CREAM as advised by your physician. Apply the required amount of the medicine to the affected skin areas.

Before applying NIZOCLIN 2% CREAM, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment or lotion that contains a steroid.

NIZOCLIN 2% CREAM can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice. NIZOCLIN 2% CREAM is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of applying NIZOCLIN 2% CREAM are burning sensation, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NIZOCLIN 2% CREAM
Management of fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How NIZOCLIN 2% CREAM Works

NIZOCLIN 2% CREAM contains Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. It blocks the production of a substance called ergosterol, which is essential for the fungi's cell membrane. Without ergosterol, the cell membrane becomes weak, causing the fungi to die and the infection to clear up.
usageDetails:
How to use NIZOCLIN 2% CREAM

Apply NIZOCLIN 2% CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well.  Apply it to the affected and immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using NIZOCLIN 2% CREAM in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Keep using NIZOCLIN 2% CREAM until a few days after all symptoms have completely disappeared. This is to manage your symptoms from recurring.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About NIOFINE 250MG TABLET

NIOFINE 250MG TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take NIOFINE 250MG TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking NIOFINE 250MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take NIOFINE 250MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of NIOFINE 250MG TABLET
Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How NIOFINE 250MG TABLET Works

NIOFINE 250MG TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About NOKVER 200MG CAPSULE

NOKVER 200MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use NOKVER 200MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with NOKVER 200MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with NOKVER 200MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. NOKVER 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

NOKVER 200MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking NOKVER 200MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NOKVER 200MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How NOKVER 200MG CAPSULE Works

NOKVER 200MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

Introduction About TERBINATOR

TERBINATOR is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take TERBINATOR for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking TERBINATOR inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take TERBINATOR without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of TERBINATOR
Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How TERBINATOR Works

TERBINATOR is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: Take TERBINATOR as advised by your physician.
For Tablet: Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. But in children younger than 6 years, the medicine should be crushed before swallowing.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse TERBINATOR in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: ITRALYN 200 Capsule 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ITRALYN 200 CAPSULE

ITRALYN 200 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRALYN 200 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITRALYN 200 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITRALYN 200 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITRALYN 200 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITRALYN 200 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITRALYN 200 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITRALYN 200 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITRALYN 200 CAPSULE Works

ITRALYN 200 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.
usageInstructions: Take this medicine as advised by your physician.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ITRALYN 200 CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ITRALYN 200 CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Tingling, numbness, and weakness in the limbs
Liver problems (singles include severe lack of appetite, nausea, vomiting, tiredness, stomach pain, muscle weakness, yellowing of skin and eyes (jaundice), dark urine, pale stools, and hair loss)

ITRALYN 200 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women as a small amount of this medicine passes into breast milk.
Do not drive or handle heavy machines if you experience dizziness, blurred/double vision, or hearing loss while taking ITRALYN 200 CAPSULE.

name: Ketocip Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About KETOCIP TABLET

KETOCIP TABLET contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used in adults to manage systemic fungal infections, chronic mucocutaneous and vaginal candidiasis, oral rush candiduric (fungal infection of mouth), etc.

Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving KETOCIP TABLET management. Before taking KETOCIP TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or adrenal problems.

KETOCIP TABLET should be used during pregnancy only if the potential benefit justifies the potential risk to the baby. KETOCIP TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women. KETOCIP TABLET is not for use in children (especially under 2 years of age), so consult your doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of taking KETOCIP TABLET are nausea, headache, diarrhoea, stomach pain, etc. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KETOCIP TABLET

Manages

Systemic fungal infections
Candidiasis (chronic mucocutaneous and vaginal)
Oral rush candiduric
mechanismOfAction:
How KETOCIP TABLET Works

KETOCIP TABLET works by blocking the synthesis of ergosterol (a key component of the fungal cell membrane) thus weakening the structure and function of the fungal cell membrane.
usageDetails:
How to use KETOCIP TABLET

Take KETOCIP TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not crush or chew it. Swallow KETOCIP TABLET as whole with a glass of water. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking KETOCIP TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.
sideEffects: Liver problems (loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, tiredness, yellow skin or whites of the eyes, dark urine, pale stools, fever, rash)
Changes in the electrical activity of your heart (feeling faint, lightheaded, dizzy, or your heart beating irregularly or fast)
Adrenal insufficiency (tiredness, dizziness, weakness, nausea, vomiting)
Serious allergic reaction (rash, itching, hives, fever, swollen lips or tongue, chest pain, or trouble breathing)
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of KETOCIP TABLET
Common
Nausea, diarrhoea, stomach pain
Headache
Abnormal liver function tests
Rare

Stop taking KETOCIP TABLET and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Liver problems (loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, tiredness, yellow skin or whites of the eyes, dark urine, pale stools, fever, rash)
Changes in the electrical activity of your heart (feeling faint, lightheaded, dizzy, or your heart beating irregularly or fast)
Adrenal insufficiency (tiredness, dizziness, weakness, nausea, vomiting)
Serious allergic reaction (rash, itching, hives, fever, swollen lips or tongue, chest pain, or trouble breathing)
Muscle problems

warnings.details: KETOCIP TABLET should be used during pregnancy only if the potential benefit justifies the potential risk to the baby. Consult your doctor before taking it.
KETOCIP TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it can pass into the breastmilk. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy or sleepy after taking KETOCIP TABLET.
Do not consume alcohol while taking KETOCIP TABLET as it can lead to disulfiram-like reaction (a very uncomfortable reaction characterized by severe flushing). Consult your doctor for advice.
KETOCIP TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take KETOCIP TABLET if you are allergic to Ketoconazole or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

KETOCIP TABLET should be used with caution if you or any of your family members had an abnormal heart rhythm tracing (ECG) or a heart problem called “congenital long QT syndrome”. Consult your doctor before taking it.
KETOCIP TABLET is not recommended for use in children (especially under 2 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.
KETOCIP TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients to avoid the risk of fracture. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

Before taking KETOCIP TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have adrenal insufficiency

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ZORITRAZ FORTE 200MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS).

introduction:
Introduction About ZOCON DT 50MG TABLET

ZOCON DT 50MG TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).      

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking ZOCON DT 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

ZOCON DT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. ZOCON DT 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking ZOCON DT 50MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

How ZOCON DT 50MG TABLET Works

ZOCON DT 50MG TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse ZOCON DT 50MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take ZOCON DT 50MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

Introduction About IBINATOR 200 CAPSULE

IBINATOR 200 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use IBINATOR 200 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with IBINATOR 200 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with IBINATOR 200 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. IBINATOR 200 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

IBINATOR 200 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking IBINATOR 200 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How IBINATOR 200 CAPSULE Works

IBINATOR 200 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

name: Zykt 2% Cream 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About ZYKT 2% CREAM

Zykt 2% Cream is used to control, manage fungal infections and yeast infections of skin such as tinea corporis, tinea cruris, and tinea versicolor. It contains Ketconazole as active ingredient.

Ketoconazole inhibits the synthesis of certain compounds that are essential components of the fungal cell membrane, resulting into increased cellular permeability that causes leaking of cellular contents. Moreover, it also impairs various important biological processes inside the fungal cell body required for its survival, thereby works against fungal cell bodies.

Use Zykt 2% Cream as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Avoid using it around your eyes, nose, or mouth. If contact occurs with eyes, rinse thoroughly with water. Discontinue use if irritation or inflammation develops. Do not stop using Zykt 2% Cream suddenly without informing your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About IKON 150MG CAPSULE

IKON 150MG CAPSULE contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking IKON 150MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

IKON 150MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. IKON 150MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking IKON 150MG CAPSULE are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

Are prone to develop severe skin reactions (itching, reddening of the skin or difficulty in breathing)
Have history of adrenal insufficiency

IKON 150MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). Consult child’s doctor for advice before administration of IKON 150MG CAPSULE to your child.

Use in Geriatrics:  

IKON 150MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment. Your doctor may adjust the dose depending upon kidney function. Consult your doctor for advice before taking IKON 150MG CAPSULE.

introduction:
Introduction About OLTEF VG SOFTGEL CAPSULE

OLTEF VG SOFTGEL CAPSULE is a combination of Clindamycin and Clotrimazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics and Antifungal agents respectively. It is used to manage vaginal (genital) infections (Ex. vaginal candidiasis, bacterial vaginosis and mixed vaginal infections). It can also be used to cleanse the genital tract prior to any gynecological procedures.

OLTEF VG SOFTGEL CAPSULE is meant for intravaginal use only. Carefully insert the medicine deep into the vagina as far as possible. Wash your hands before and after inserting the medicine. Closely follow the dose-related instructions given by your doctor to achieve better results. Skipping doses in between the therapy or stopping the therapy without consulting your doctor may not result in adequate infection control.

While using OLTEF VG SOFTGEL CAPSULE, do not engage in vaginal intercourse or use any vaginal products (such as tampons or douches). Before using OLTEF VG SOFTGEL CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any stomach problems (such as colitis). You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding or currently having periods before using OLTEF VG SOFTGEL CAPSULE as a precaution.

OLTEF VG SOFTGEL CAPSULE is generally safe and well tolerated with fewer side effects like mild vaginal itching or irritation, vaginal discharge and mild diarrhea. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Cleanses genital tract prior to gynaecological procedures
usesDetails:
Uses Of OLTEF VG SOFTGEL CAPSULE
Manage vaginal (genital) infections
Cleanses genital tract prior to gynaecological procedures
mechanismOfAction:
How OLTEF VG SOFTGEL CAPSULE Works

OLTEF VG SOFTGEL CAPSULE is effective in managing both bacterial and fungal genital infections. It works by killing the susceptible microorganism that causes infection within the body. It contains two medicines namely clindamycin and clotrimazole.

Clindamycin is an antibacterial agent. It blocks the production of certain bacterial proteins which is essential for the bacteria to survival. This action manages the further growth and multiplication of bacteria within the body

Clotrimazole is an antifungal agent. It blocks the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the fungal cell which is essential for its survival. This action kills the susceptible fungi and manages the further spread of infection.
usageDetails:
How to use OLTEF VG SOFTGEL CAPSULE

Use OLTEF VG SOFTGEL CAPSULE as directed by your physician. It is for intravaginal use only. Lie down on your back and place your legs wide apart. Carefully insert the medicine deep into the vagina. Do not move faster, run or stand immediately after inserting the medicine.

Wash your hands before and after inserting the medicine. Do not use this medicine while on your monthly periods. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you based on your age, body weight and health condition.

Do not stop using this medicine without consulting your doctor as it may not completely manage your infection.

introduction:
Introduction About BELITRA 200 CAPSULE

BELITRA 200 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use BELITRA 200 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with BELITRA 200 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with BELITRA 200 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. BELITRA 200 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

BELITRA 200 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking BELITRA 200 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How BELITRA 200 CAPSULE Works

BELITRA 200 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

name: LULIACT Spray 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About LULIACT SPRAY

LULIACT SPRAY is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection). Fungal infections can be contagious and spread from one person to another.

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal Agents. It works by inhibiting the growth of the fungus that causes these infections.

LULIACT SPRAY is not recommended for use among women who are pregnant and breastfeeding unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. LULIACT SPRAY should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above).

Avoid applying LULIACT SPRAY on the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LULIACT SPRAY

LULIACT SPRAY is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How LULIACT SPRAY Works

LULIACT SPRAY works by causing holes in the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and killing fungi. In this way, Luliconazole relieves discomfort, itching, and irritation on the skin.
usageInstructions: Spray this medicine as directed by your physician.
It is for topical use only.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, and vaginal area.
Spray this medicine on the affected area and its surrounding areas.
Wash your hands after use.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.

If the duration of the management with SUBITRAL DS 100 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. SUBITRAL DS 100 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

SUBITRAL DS 100 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking SUBITRAL DS 100 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About FINTRIX 250MG TABLET

FINTRIX 250MG TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take FINTRIX 250MG TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking FINTRIX 250MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take FINTRIX 250MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of FINTRIX 250MG TABLET
Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How FINTRIX 250MG TABLET Works

FINTRIX 250MG TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: Take FINTRIX 250MG TABLET as advised by your physician.
For Tablet: Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. But in children younger than 6 years, the medicine should be crushed before swallowing.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse FINTRIX 250MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About FUNZI IT 100MG CAPSULE

FUNZI IT 100MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use FUNZI IT 100MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with FUNZI IT 100MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with FUNZI IT 100MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. FUNZI IT 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

FUNZI IT 100MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking FUNZI IT 100MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of FUNZI IT 100MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How FUNZI IT 100MG CAPSULE Works

FUNZI IT 100MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

name: Tinibit L Cream 50gm
introduction:
Introduction About TINIBIT L CREAM

TINIBIT L CREAM is used in the management of various fungal infections such as tinea pedis (fungal infection between the toes), tinea cruris (red and itchy rash in the warm and moist areas of the body), and tinea corporis (ringworm fungal infection).

It contains a medicine called Luliconazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungal agents. It works by stopping the growth of the fungus causing these infections.

TINIBIT L CREAM is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in children 12 years of age and below unless clearly necessary. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older).

Avoid applying TINIBIT L CREAM to the eyes, mouth, or vaginal region. The most common side effects of this medicine are application site reactions such as irritation, itching, and stinging. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TINIBIT L CREAM

TINIBIT L CREAM is used to manage various fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea cruris (jock itch)
Tinea corporis (ringworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How TINIBIT L CREAM Works

TINIBIT L CREAM works by damaging the cell membranes of the fungus (essential for the survival of the fungus as they manage the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stop the leakage of cell contents) and works against the fungi. As a result, TINIBIT L CREAM relieves discomfort, itching and irritation on the skin.
usageInstructions: Apply this medicine as directed by your physician.
It is for external use only.
Clean and dry the skin to be managed.
Wash your hands with soap and water and apply a thin layer of the medicine to the affected area of the skin and rub it gently.
Avoid contact with the eyes, mouth, or vaginal area.
Do not cover, wrap, or bandage the skin unless directed by the doctor.
