introduction:
Introduction About ONECAN 200MG TABLET

ONECAN 200MG TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).   

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.

Before taking ONECAN 200MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.

ONECAN 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. ONECAN 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking ONECAN 200MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

Prevents fungal infection in immunocompromised patients
usesDetails:
Uses Of ONECAN 200MG TABLET
Manage various fungal infections (such as systemic candidiasis, mucosal candidiasis, cryptococcosis and vaginal candidiasis)

mechanismOfAction:
How ONECAN 200MG TABLET Works

ONECAN 200MG TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.

Rare hereditary problems of galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption

Have abnormal levels of potassium, calcium or magnesium in your blood
Are prone to develop severe skin reactions (itching, reddening of the skin or difficulty in breathing)
Have history of adrenal insufficiency
Have no improvement in fungal infection

ONECAN 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). Consult child’s doctor for advice before administration of ONECAN 200MG TABLET to your child.

ONECAN 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment. Your doctor may adjust the dose depending upon kidney function. Consult your doctor for advice before taking ONECAN 200MG TABLET.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking ONECAN 200MG TABLET, inform your doctor, if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage diabetes medicines (Ex. glyburide, tolbutamide, glipizide, chlorpropamide)
Medicines used to manage high blood pressure (Ex. hydrochlorothiazide, nifedipine, isradipine, amlodipine, felodipine and losartan)
Medicines used as blood thinners (Ex. warfarin)
Medicines used to use to manage rejection of organ transplants (Ex. cyclosporine, tacrolimus, sirolimus)
Rifampicin or rifabutin (used to manage tuberculosis)
Astemizole, terfenadine (used to manage certain type of allergies)
Medicines used to control seizures /fits (Ex. phenytoin or carbamazepine)
Theophylline (used to control asthma)
Cisapride (used to manage heartburn)
Medicines used to manage heart diseases (Ex. quinidine, amiodarone)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. amitriptyline, nortriptyline)
Pimozide (used to control motor or verbal tics)
Amphotericin B, voriconazole (medicine for managing various fungal infections)
Erythromycin (used for managing bacterial infections)
Cyclosphosphamide, medicines used for management of cancer (Ex. vincristine or vinblastine)
Alfentanil, fentanyl (used as general anesthetic)
Halofantrine (for managing malaria)
Medicines used to manage high cholesterol levels (Ex. atorvastatin, simvastatin and fluvastatin)
Medicines used to manage painful conditions with inflammation (Ex. celecoxib, ibuprofen and naproxen)
Prednisone (used to manage inflammatory disorders)
Antiviral medications used to manage HIV infection (Ex. saquinavir, zidovudine)
Tofacitinib (used to manage rheumatoid arthritis)
Ivacaftor (medicine used for managing cystic fibrosis)
Ibrutinib (used for managing blood cancer)
Midazolam, triazolam or similar medicines (used to induce sleep and manages anxiety)
Olaparib (used for managing ovarian cancer)
Methadone (used to manage chronic pain and also opioid dependance)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of ONECAN 200MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of ONECAN 200MG TABLET are hearing, seeing, feeling and thinking things that are not real (hallucination and paranoid behaviour).

introduction:
Introduction About FLUFUNG 150MG TABLET

FLUFUNG 150MG TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking FLUFUNG 150MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

FLUFUNG 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. FLUFUNG 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking FLUFUNG 150MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How FLUFUNG 150MG TABLET Works

FLUFUNG 150MG TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.

name: ALCROS SB 50 Capsule 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ALCROS SB 50 CAPSULE

ALCROS SB 50 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ALCROS SB 50 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ALCROS SB 50 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ALCROS SB 50 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ALCROS SB 50 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ALCROS SB 50 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ALCROS SB 50 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ALCROS SB 50 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ALCROS SB 50 CAPSULE Works

ALCROS SB 50 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.
usageInstructions: Take this medicine as advised by your physician.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ALCROS SB 50 CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

sideEffects: Tingling, numbness, and weakness in the limbs
Liver problems (singles include severe lack of appetite, nausea, vomiting, tiredness, stomach pain, muscle weakness, yellowing of skin and eyes (jaundice), dark urine, pale stools, and hair loss)
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of ALCROS SB 50 CAPSULE
Common Side Effects of ALCROS SB 50 CAPSULE:
Stomach pain, nausea
Headache

Stop taking ALCROS SB 50 CAPSULE and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Tingling, numbness, and weakness in the limbs
Liver problems (singles include severe lack of appetite, nausea, vomiting, tiredness, stomach pain, muscle weakness, yellowing of skin and eyes (jaundice), dark urine, pale stools, and hair loss)

warnings.details: ALCROS SB 50 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor. You should use contraception to make sure that you do not become pregnant during management with this medicine.
ALCROS SB 50 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women as a small amount of this medicine passes into breast milk.
Do not drive or handle heavy machines if you experience dizziness, blurred/double vision, or hearing loss while taking ALCROS SB 50 CAPSULE.
Consumption of alcohol is not recommended during management with ALCROS SB 50 CAPSULE.
ALCROS SB 50 CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems.
ALCROS SB 50 CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with liver problems such as jaundice.
Do not take ALCROS SB 50 CAPSULE if you are allergic to itraconazole or any other ingredients of this medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About TEBINA 250MG TABLET

TEBINA 250MG TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take TEBINA 250MG TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking TEBINA 250MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take TEBINA 250MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of TEBINA 250MG TABLET
Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How TEBINA 250MG TABLET Works

TEBINA 250MG TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: Take TEBINA 250MG TABLET as advised by your physician.
For Tablet: Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. But in children younger than 6 years, the medicine should be crushed before swallowing.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse TEBINA 250MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About I TYZA SB 100 CAPSULE

I TYZA SB 100 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use I TYZA SB 100 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with I TYZA SB 100 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with I TYZA SB 100 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. I TYZA SB 100 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

I TYZA SB 100 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking I TYZA SB 100 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of I TYZA SB 100 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How I TYZA SB 100 CAPSULE Works

I TYZA SB 100 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

name: ZYGTER Tablet 7's
introduction:
Introduction About ZYGTER TABLET

ZYGTER TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take ZYGTER TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking ZYGTER TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take ZYGTER TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZYGTER TABLET
Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How ZYGTER TABLET Works

ZYGTER TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: Take ZYGTER TABLET as advised by your physician.
For Tablet: Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. But in children younger than 6 years, the medicine should be crushed before swallowing.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse ZYGTER TABLET in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TINIWASH SOAP

TINIWASH SOAP contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used to manage various fungal infections of the skin such as ringworm, athlete’s foot and dermatitis associated with such infections.

TINIWASH SOAP can also be used to manage other fungal infections like candida paronychia (fungal infection around nails), cutaneous candidiasis (fungal infection of the skin), and pityriasis versicolor (characterized by the development of hyper-pigmented patches on the trunk that may/may not spread to arms and shoulders).

Before using TINIWASH SOAP, inform your doctor if you have any allergies or pre-existing conditions, or if you are taking any other medicines. TINIWASH SOAP should be used cautiously in pregnant and breastfeeding women. The safety and effectiveness of TINIWASH SOAP in children (less than 12 years of age) have not been established so, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

The most common side effects associated with TINIWASH SOAP are skin dryness, itching, redness or burning sensation. It is recommended to consult the doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

TINIWASH SOAP clears the infection by causing holes in the fungal cell membranes, thus killing the fungi.
usageDetails:
How to use TINIWASH SOAP

Always apply TINIWASH SOAP as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply TINIWASH SOAP on the affected area. It can be applied on the body and scalp. Wash and rinse thoroughly with water after applying TINIWASH SOAP. Avoid contact of TINIWASH SOAP with the nose, mouth or eyes.

If TINIWASH SOAP accidentally gets in your eye, gently rinse your eyes with cold water. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ONITRAZ SB 130 CAPSULE

ONITRAZ SB 130 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ONITRAZ SB 130 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ONITRAZ SB 130 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ONITRAZ SB 130 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ONITRAZ SB 130 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ONITRAZ SB 130 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ONITRAZ SB 130 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ONITRAZ SB 130 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ONITRAZ SB 130 CAPSULE Works

ONITRAZ SB 130 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About ITRAFORT 100 CAPSULE

ITRAFORT 100 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRAFORT 100 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITRAFORT 100 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITRAFORT 100 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITRAFORT 100 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITRAFORT 100 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITRAFORT 100 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITRAFORT 100 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITRAFORT 100 CAPSULE Works

ITRAFORT 100 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ITRAFORT 100 CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: TINIWASH SKIN Lotion 80ml
introduction:
Introduction About TINIWASH SKIN LOTION

TINIWASH SKIN LOTION contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used in adults to manage fungal and yeast infections which may appear on the skin of the hands, feet, genital area, trunk, groin, scalp, face, chest or back.

TINIWASH SKIN LOTION is not recommended for eye infections. Before applying TINIWASH SKIN LOTION, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment or lotion that contains a steroid.

TINIWASH SKIN LOTION can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice. TINIWASH SKIN LOTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of applying TINIWASH SKIN LOTION are burning sensation, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TINIWASH SKIN LOTION

Manages the fungal or yeast infections of skin appearing on:

Trunk, chest, back
Hands, feet
Scalp, face
Groin, genitals
mechanismOfAction:
How TINIWASH SKIN LOTION Works

TINIWASH SKIN LOTION reduces fungal infection by inhibiting the growth of the fungus by weakening the structure and function of the fungal cell membrane.
usageDetails:
How to use TINIWASH SKIN LOTION

Apply TINIWASH SKIN LOTION as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well.  Apply it to the affected and immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using TINIWASH SKIN LOTION in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Keep using TINIWASH SKIN LOTION until a few days after all symptoms have completely disappeared. This is to manage your symptoms from recurring.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About ONITRAZ 100MG CAPSULE

ONITRAZ 100MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ONITRAZ 100MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ONITRAZ 100MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ONITRAZ 100MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ONITRAZ 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ONITRAZ 100MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ONITRAZ 100MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ONITRAZ 100MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ONITRAZ 100MG CAPSULE Works

ONITRAZ 100MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.
usageInstructions: Take this medicine as advised by your physician.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ONITRAZ 100MG CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CEASTRA 100MG CAPSULE

CEASTRA 100MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use CEASTRA 100MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with CEASTRA 100MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with CEASTRA 100MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. CEASTRA 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

CEASTRA 100MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking CEASTRA 100MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CEASTRA 100MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How CEASTRA 100MG CAPSULE Works

CEASTRA 100MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of CEASTRA 100MG CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TRFY 250MG TABLET

TRFY 250MG TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take TRFY 250MG TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking TRFY 250MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take TRFY 250MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRFY 250MG TABLET
Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How TRFY 250MG TABLET Works

TRFY 250MG TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: Take TRFY 250MG TABLET as advised by your physician.
For Tablet: Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. But in children younger than 6 years, the medicine should be crushed before swallowing.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse TRFY 250MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ITRAGREAT SB 130 CAPSULE

ITRAGREAT SB 130 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRAGREAT SB 130 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITRAGREAT SB 130 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITRAGREAT SB 130 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITRAGREAT SB 130 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITRAGREAT SB 130 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITRAGREAT SB 130 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITRAGREAT SB 130 CAPSULE Works

ITRAGREAT SB 130 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

name: Zykt 2% Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About ZYKT 2% CREAM

ZyKT Cream is an antifungal agent, used for management of mild to moderate fungal skin infections such as athlete’s foot, thrush and ringworm. It contains Ketoconazole as the active ingredient that works by killing the fungus that causes infections.

Ketoconazole works by damaging the fungal cell membranes that are important for their survival as it manages the entry of unwanted substances into the cells and stops the leakage of cell contents, thus, it kills fungi and yeast. 

Use ZyKT Cream as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only, do not swallow ZyKT Cream. Avoid contact with eyes. Accidentally if it gets in touch with your eyes, wash it thoroughly. Along with the management regime follow proper hygiene.

introduction:
Introduction About I TYZA 200 CAPSULE

I TYZA 200 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use I TYZA 200 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with I TYZA 200 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with I TYZA 200 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. I TYZA 200 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

I TYZA 200 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking I TYZA 200 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of I TYZA 200 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How I TYZA 200 CAPSULE Works

I TYZA 200 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of I TYZA 200 CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: ECOVIN Suspension 120ml
introduction:
Introduction About ECOVIN SUSPENSION

ECOVIN SUSPENSION contains Griseofulvin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungals. It is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair or nails where topical therapy is not suitable or has failed to manage the condition.

Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with ECOVIN SUSPENSION, as it may cause nausea, vomiting or flushing. Before taking ECOVIN SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you have skin, liver or kidney problems or porphyria (which results from an increase in certain chemicals related to red blood cell proteins).

ECOVIN SUSPENSION is not recommended for pregnant women. It is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk in breastfeeding women; therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking ECOVIN SUSPENSION are skin conditions like rashes. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage fungal infections (ringworm) of skin, hair and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of ECOVIN SUSPENSION
Manage fungal infections (ringworm) of skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How ECOVIN SUSPENSION Works

ECOVIN SUSPENSION inhibits the growth of fungi by binding to a part of the fungus causing the infection in the body. This stops the fungus from multiplying. It also manages fungus from spreading to new cells. These actions cause the fungal infection to shed completely.
usageDetails:
How to use ECOVIN SUSPENSION

Take ECOVIN SUSPENSION as advised by your physician. Shake well before use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Hypersensitivity reactions like painless swelling under the skin and erythema multiforme (a skin condition)

Rare
Hypersensitivity reactions like painless swelling under the skin and erythema multiforme (a skin condition)
Excess protein in the urine

Leukopenia (lack of white blood cells)
Coagulopathy (impaired blood clotting)
Hepatitis (liver infection)
Increased levels of liver enzymes
Hyperbilirubinemia (raised blood levels of bilirubin)
Gastrointestinal bleeding

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ECOVIN SUSPENSION as it may cause nausea, vomiting, flushing, hast heartbeat or low blood pressure.
Periodic monitoring of kidney functions is required in patients taking ECOVIN SUSPENSION.
ECOVIN SUSPENSION is not recommended in patients with liver failure. Periodic monitoring of liver functions is required. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take ECOVIN SUSPENSION if you are allergic to Griseofulvin.

Others

ECOVIN SUSPENSION is not recommended for use if you:

Have porphyria (results from an increase in certain chemicals related to red blood cell proteins)

Before taking ECOVIN SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you:

Have Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (a rare painful skin and tissue disease)
Feel that your skin is becoming more sensitive to sunlight or ultraviolet (UV) light

Use in Paediatrics:

Safety of ECOVIN SUSPENSION in children (less than 2 years of age) has not been established. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About ZITRAN SB 130 CAPSULE

ZITRAN SB 130 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ZITRAN SB 130 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ZITRAN SB 130 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ZITRAN SB 130 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ZITRAN SB 130 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ZITRAN SB 130 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ZITRAN SB 130 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Introduction About MYCOCLEAR SB 65 CAPSULE

MYCOCLEAR SB 65 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use MYCOCLEAR SB 65 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with MYCOCLEAR SB 65 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with MYCOCLEAR SB 65 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. MYCOCLEAR SB 65 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

MYCOCLEAR SB 65 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking MYCOCLEAR SB 65 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How MYCOCLEAR SB 65 CAPSULE Works

MYCOCLEAR SB 65 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

name: AF 200mg Tablet 1'S
introduction:
Introduction About AF 200MG TABLET

AF 200MG TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).   

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.

Before taking AF 200MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.

AF 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. AF 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking AF 200MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How AF 200MG TABLET Works

AF 200MG TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.

Take AF 200MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow AF 200MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. The correct dose and duration for you will be decide by the doctor depending upon your age, body weight and type of infection.

AF 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart rhythm problems. Consult your doctor for advice before taking AF 200MG TABLET.

Others

AF 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Rare hereditary problems of galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption

Have abnormal levels of potassium, calcium or magnesium in your blood
Are prone to develop severe skin reactions (itching, reddening of the skin or difficulty in breathing)
Have history of adrenal insufficiency
Have no improvement in fungal infection

Use in Pediatrics:

AF 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). Consult child’s doctor for advice before administration of AF 200MG TABLET to your child.

Use in Geriatrics:

AF 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment. Your doctor may adjust the dose depending upon kidney function. Consult your doctor for advice before taking AF 200MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About LAMIFIN 125 DT TABLET

LAMIFIN 125 DT TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take LAMIFIN 125 DT TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking LAMIFIN 125 DT TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take LAMIFIN 125 DT TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of LAMIFIN 125 DT TABLET
Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How LAMIFIN 125 DT TABLET Works

LAMIFIN 125 DT TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: Take LAMIFIN 125 DT TABLET as advised by your physician.
For Tablet: Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. But in children younger than 6 years, the medicine should be crushed before swallowing.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse LAMIFIN 125 DT TABLET in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About KETOSCALP TABLET

KETOSCALP TABLET contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used in adults to manage systemic fungal infections, chronic mucocutaneous and vaginal candidiasis, oral rush candiduric (fungal infection of mouth), etc.

Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving KETOSCALP TABLET management. Before taking KETOSCALP TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or adrenal problems.

KETOSCALP TABLET should be used during pregnancy only if the potential benefit justifies the potential risk to the baby. KETOSCALP TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women. KETOSCALP TABLET is not for use in children (especially under 2 years of age), so consult your doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of taking KETOSCALP TABLET are nausea, headache, diarrhoea, stomach pain, etc. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.

mechanismOfAction:

KETOSCALP TABLET works by blocking the synthesis of ergosterol (a key component of the fungal cell membrane) thus weakening the structure and function of the fungal cell membrane.

Take KETOSCALP TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not crush or chew it. Swallow KETOSCALP TABLET as whole with a glass of water. Do not stop taking KETOSCALP TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About JIMLIG SB 130 CAPSULE

JIMLIG SB 130 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use JIMLIG SB 130 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with JIMLIG SB 130 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with JIMLIG SB 130 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. JIMLIG SB 130 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

JIMLIG SB 130 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking JIMLIG SB 130 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of JIMLIG SB 130 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How JIMLIG SB 130 CAPSULE Works

JIMLIG SB 130 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About FLUCOS DT 50MG TABLET

FLUCOS DT 50MG TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).      

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking FLUCOS DT 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

FLUCOS DT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. FLUCOS DT 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking FLUCOS DT 50MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

FLUCOS DT 50MG TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take FLUCOS DT 50MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About ITRAFORT 200 CAPSULE

ITRAFORT 200 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRAFORT 200 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITRAFORT 200 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITRAFORT 200 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITRAFORT 200 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITRAFORT 200 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITRAFORT 200 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITRAFORT 200 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITRAFORT 200 CAPSULE Works

ITRAFORT 200 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ITRAFORT 200 CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About LAMIFIN FORTE 500MG TABLET

LAMIFIN FORTE 500MG TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take LAMIFIN FORTE 500MG TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking LAMIFIN FORTE 500MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take LAMIFIN FORTE 500MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of LAMIFIN FORTE 500MG TABLET
Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How LAMIFIN FORTE 500MG TABLET Works

LAMIFIN FORTE 500MG TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: Take LAMIFIN FORTE 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician.
For Tablet: Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. But in children younger than 6 years, the medicine should be crushed before swallowing.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse LAMIFIN FORTE 500MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About FRESOCAN 200MG INJECTION

FRESOCAN 200MG INJECTION contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used in adults and children for the management fungal infections including candidiasis, mucosal thrush (infection affecting the lining of mouth, throat, esophagus, bronchuses and lungs) when oral management is not possible and cryptococcal meningitis (fungal infection in the brain).

FRESOCAN 200MG INJECTION is also used to manage candida fungal infections in patients having reduced amounts of white blood cells (neutropenia) following bone marrow transplants.

Before receiving FRESOCAN 200MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have kidney, liver or heart problems, AIDS or yeast infection. FRESOCAN 200MG INJECTION is not recommended to use among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding.

FRESOCAN 200MG INJECTION can be used in children and adolescents. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for your child, so consult with your child’s doctor. FRESOCAN 200MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of receiving FRESOCAN 200MG INJECTION are headache, rash, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain and diarrhea. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen or persists.

Candidiasis

mechanismOfAction:
How FRESOCAN 200MG INJECTION Works

FRESOCAN 200MG INJECTION helps in manage fungal infection where Fluconazole inhibits the synthesis of certain compounds (ergosterol) that are essential components of the fungal cell membrane, resulting into increased cellular permeability that causes leaking of cellular contents. Moreover, it also impairs various important biological processes inside the fungal cell body required for its survival, thereby killing the fungal cell bodies.

FRESOCAN 200MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion or a slow injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of FRESOCAN 200MG INJECTION for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About SPORAMIZ 100MG CAPSULE

SPORAMIZ 100MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use SPORAMIZ 100MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with SPORAMIZ 100MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with SPORAMIZ 100MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. SPORAMIZ 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

SPORAMIZ 100MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking SPORAMIZ 100MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SPORAMIZ 100MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How SPORAMIZ 100MG CAPSULE Works

SPORAMIZ 100MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of SPORAMIZ 100MG CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TERBEST POWDER

TERBEST POWDER is used topically to manage fungal skin infections. It contains Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

TERBEST POWDER is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas. Use for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2 weeks of therapy.

Do not use TERBEST POWDER if you are allergic to terbinafine. It is not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using TERBEST POWDER are skin peeling, itching, skin color changes and burning sensation at the side effects. These side effects are usually harmless.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TERBEST POWDER
Manage fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How TERBEST POWDER Works

TERBEST POWDER is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

Avoid contact of this medicine with your face, eyes, ears, nose or any other mucous membranes.
Wash your hands before and after application.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

APEXITRA SB 65 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use APEXITRA SB 65 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with APEXITRA SB 65 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with APEXITRA SB 65 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function.

mechanismOfAction:
How APEXITRA SB 65 CAPSULE Works

APEXITRA SB 65 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. name: EBERJEN SOL Cream 40gm
introduction:
Introduction About EBERJEN SOL CREAM

EBERJEN SOL CREAM contains Eberconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Antifungals. It is used in the management of dermatophytic fungal skin infections such as candidiasis (yeast infection), fungal infection of skin & skin folds, fungal infection in between fingers & fungal infection of the groin region which may include Tinea corporis (ringworm), Tinea cruris (Jock itch), and Tinea pedis (Athlete’s foot).

Fungal infection is a skin disease in which a fungus attacks the tissue and causes infection which may present as reddening of skin or a rash.

Your doctor may also advise you to follow personal hygiene habits such as not sharing used clothes and washing your hands before and after managing the infected area to manage the spread of infection to another area or to another person.

Before using EBERJEN SOL CREAM, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, lung or heart disease. Do not use EBERJEN SOL CREAM if you have had an allergic reaction to Eberconazole.

EBERJEN SOL CREAM should be used with caution among pregnant and breastfeeding women. There is no specific data available on the use of EBERJEN SOL CREAM in children, hence, consult the doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of using EBERJEN SOL CREAM are erythema and itching in the application area. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of EBERJEN SOL CREAM

It is used in the management of dermatophytic skin infections such as:

Tinea corporis (ringworm)
Tinea cruris (Jock itch)
Tinea pedis (Athlete’s foot)
Candidiasis
mechanismOfAction:
How EBERJEN SOL CREAM Works

EBERJEN SOL CREAM works by killing and stopping the growth of the fungi by destroying its cell membrane, thereby managing skin infection. As a result, it manages the fungal infection of the skin.
usageDetails:
How to use EBERJEN SOL CREAM

Always use EBERJEN SOL CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Dry the infected part of the skin before using EBERJEN SOL CREAM. Wash your hands before and after using this medicine. Do not apply in eyes or on mucous membranes. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration, and frequency of EBERJEN SOL CREAM for you depending on the existing conditions, etc.

Sensitization or irritation

introduction:
Introduction About ITRALASE 200 CAPSULE

ITRALASE 200 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRALASE 200 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITRALASE 200 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITRALASE 200 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITRALASE 200 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITRALASE 200 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITRALASE 200 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITRALASE 200 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITRALASE 200 CAPSULE Works

ITRALASE 200 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ITRALASE 200 CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: TEXIFORD Spray 55gm
introduction:
Introduction About TEXIFORD SPRAY

TEXIFORD SPRAY is used topically to manage fungal skin infections. It contains Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

TEXIFORD SPRAY is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas. Use for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2 weeks of therapy.

Do not use TEXIFORD SPRAY if you are allergic to terbinafine. It is not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using TEXIFORD SPRAY are skin peeling, itching, skin color changes and burning sensation at the side effects. These side effects are usually harmless.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TEXIFORD SPRAY
Manage fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How TEXIFORD SPRAY Works

TEXIFORD SPRAY is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: TEXIFORD SPRAY is for external use only.
Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas.
Avoid contact of this medicine with your face, eyes, ears, nose or any other mucous membranes.
Wash your hands before and after application.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the infection.
Do not stop using TEXIFORD SPRAY without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About FORCAN PLUS INFUSION

FORCAN PLUS INFUSION contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used in adults and children for the management fungal infections including candidiasis, mucosal thrush (infection affecting the lining of mouth, throat, esophagus, bronchuses and lungs) when oral management is not possible and cryptococcal meningitis (fungal infection in the brain).

FORCAN PLUS INFUSION is also used to manage candida fungal infections in patients having reduced amounts of white blood cells (neutropenia) following bone marrow transplants.

Before receiving FORCAN PLUS INFUSION inform your doctor if you have kidney, liver or heart problems, AIDS or yeast infection. FORCAN PLUS INFUSION is not recommended to use among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding.

FORCAN PLUS INFUSION can be used in children and adolescents. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for your child, so consult with your child’s doctor. FORCAN PLUS INFUSION should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of receiving FORCAN PLUS INFUSION are headache, rash, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain and diarrhea. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen or persists.

mechanismOfAction:
How FORCAN PLUS INFUSION Works

FORCAN PLUS INFUSION helps in manage fungal infection where Fluconazole inhibits the synthesis of certain compounds (ergosterol) that are essential components of the fungal cell membrane, resulting into increased cellular permeability that causes leaking of cellular contents. Moreover, it also impairs various important biological processes inside the fungal cell body required for its survival, thereby killing the fungal cell bodies.

FORCAN PLUS INFUSION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion or a slow injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of FORCAN PLUS INFUSION for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Yeast infection (cryptococcosis)
Other fungal infections

FORCAN PLUS INFUSION can be used in children and adolescents. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for your child, so consult with your child’s doctor.

Use in geriatrics:

FORCAN PLUS INFUSION should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years and above). Your doctor may consider adjusting your dose depending on your kidney function. Consult your doctor before receiving FORCAN PLUS INFUSION.

introduction:
Introduction About KETAFUNG TABLET

KETAFUNG TABLET contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used in adults to manage systemic fungal infections, chronic mucocutaneous and vaginal candidiasis, oral rush candiduric (fungal infection of mouth), etc.

Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving KETAFUNG TABLET management. Before taking KETAFUNG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or adrenal problems.

KETAFUNG TABLET should be used during pregnancy only if the potential benefit justifies the potential risk to the baby. KETAFUNG TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women. KETAFUNG TABLET is not for use in children (especially under 2 years of age), so consult your doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of taking KETAFUNG TABLET are nausea, headache, diarrhoea, stomach pain, etc. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KETAFUNG TABLET

Manages

Systemic fungal infections
Candidiasis (chronic mucocutaneous and vaginal)
Oral rush candiduric
mechanismOfAction:
How KETAFUNG TABLET Works

KETAFUNG TABLET works by blocking the synthesis of ergosterol (a key component of the fungal cell membrane) thus weakening the structure and function of the fungal cell membrane.
usageDetails:
How to use KETAFUNG TABLET

Take KETAFUNG TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not crush or chew it. Swallow KETAFUNG TABLET as whole with a glass of water. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking KETAFUNG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.
