KETAFUNG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it can pass into the breastmilk. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy or sleepy after taking KETAFUNG TABLET.
Do not consume alcohol while taking KETAFUNG TABLET as it can lead to disulfiram-like reaction (a very uncomfortable reaction characterized by severe flushing). Consult your doctor for advice.
KETAFUNG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About PANITRA 200 CAPSULE

PANITRA 200 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use PANITRA 200 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with PANITRA 200 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with PANITRA 200 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. PANITRA 200 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

PANITRA 200 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking PANITRA 200 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of PANITRA 200 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How PANITRA 200 CAPSULE Works

PANITRA 200 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.
usageInstructions: Take this medicine as advised by your physician.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of PANITRA 200 CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NIZOCLIN SX 2% LOTION

NIZOCLIN SX 2% LOTION contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used in adults to manage fungal and yeast infections which may appear on the skin of the hands, feet, genital area, trunk, groin, scalp, face, chest or back.

NIZOCLIN SX 2% LOTION is not recommended for eye infections. Before applying NIZOCLIN SX 2% LOTION, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment or lotion that contains a steroid.

NIZOCLIN SX 2% LOTION can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice. NIZOCLIN SX 2% LOTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of applying NIZOCLIN SX 2% LOTION are burning sensation, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NIZOCLIN SX 2% LOTION

Manages the fungal or yeast infections of skin appearing on:

Trunk, chest, back
Hands, feet
Scalp, face
Groin, genitals
mechanismOfAction:
How NIZOCLIN SX 2% LOTION Works

NIZOCLIN SX 2% LOTION reduces fungal infection by inhibiting the growth of the fungus by weakening the structure and function of the fungal cell membrane.
usageDetails:
How to use NIZOCLIN SX 2% LOTION

Apply NIZOCLIN SX 2% LOTION as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well.  Apply it to the affected and immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using NIZOCLIN SX 2% LOTION in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Keep using NIZOCLIN SX 2% LOTION until a few days after all symptoms have completely disappeared. This is to manage your symptoms from recurring.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About IFIN TABLET

IFIN TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take IFIN TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking IFIN TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take IFIN TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of IFIN TABLET
Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How IFIN TABLET Works

IFIN TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: Take IFIN TABLET as advised by your physician.
For Tablet: Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. But in children younger than 6 years, the medicine should be crushed before swallowing.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse IFIN TABLET in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ITRATUF SB 130 CAPSULE

ITRATUF SB 130 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRATUF SB 130 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITRATUF SB 130 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITRATUF SB 130 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITRATUF SB 130 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITRATUF SB 130 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITRATUF SB 130 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITRATUF SB 130 CAPSULE Works

ITRATUF SB 130 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About VORISURE 200 TABLET

VORISURE 200 TABLET contains Voriconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections (such as invasive aspergillosis, candidaemia, invasive Candida sp. infections) in both adults and in children (aged 2 years or above). It can also be used to manage fungal infections in high-risk bone marrow transplant recipients.

VORISURE 200 TABLET should be taken at least 1 hour before or after meals. It is highly intended for patients with worsening or life-threatening fungal infections. It is important to complete the full course of therapy with VORISURE 200 TABLET to achieve better control over infection.

Before taking VORISURE 200 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or heart problems. Do not take VORISURE 200 TABLET if you are pregnant or breast-feeding without consulting your doctor.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with VORISURE 200 TABLET. During management with VORISURE 200 TABLET, avoid exposing your skin towards direct sunlight. Wear protective loose-fitting clothes and apply sunscreen while going outdoors.

The most common side-effects of taking VORISURE 200 TABLET are visual impairment, fever, rash, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, headache, swelling of the extremities, stomach pain and breathing difficulties. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Manage and manage severe fungal infections
usesDetails:
Uses Of VORISURE 200 TABLET

It is used in adults and in children (aged 2 years or older) to:

Manage and manage severe fungal infections
mechanismOfAction:
How VORISURE 200 TABLET Works

VORISURE 200 TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageDetails:
How to use VORISURE 200 TABLET

Take VORISURE 200 TABLET 1 hour before or after meals or as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking VORISURE 200 TABLET without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About ALBIRID 200 CAPSULE

ALBIRID 200 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ALBIRID 200 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ALBIRID 200 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ALBIRID 200 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ALBIRID 200 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ALBIRID 200 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ALBIRID 200 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ALBIRID 200 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ALBIRID 200 CAPSULE Works

ALBIRID 200 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About SURFAZ O TABLET

SURFAZ O TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking SURFAZ O TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

SURFAZ O TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. SURFAZ O TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking SURFAZ O TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

introduction:
Introduction About VORITEK

VORITEK contains Voriconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections (such as invasive aspergillosis, candidaemia, invasive Candida sp. infections) in both adults and in children (aged 2 years or above). It can also be used to manage fungal infections in high-risk bone marrow transplant recipients.

VORITEK should be taken at least 1 hour before or after meals. It is highly intended for patients with worsening or life-threatening fungal infections. It is important to complete the full course of therapy with VORITEK to achieve better control over infection.

Before taking VORITEK inform your doctor if you have any liver or heart problems. Do not take VORITEK if you are pregnant or breast-feeding without consulting your doctor.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with VORITEK. During management with VORITEK, avoid exposing your skin towards direct sunlight. Wear protective loose-fitting clothes and apply sunscreen while going outdoors.

The most common side-effects of taking VORITEK are visual impairment, fever, rash, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, headache, swelling of the extremities, stomach pain and breathing difficulties. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Manage and manage severe fungal infections
usesDetails:
Uses Of VORITEK

It is used in adults and in children (aged 2 years or older) to:

Manage and manage severe fungal infections
mechanismOfAction:
How VORITEK Works

VORITEK is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

Take VORITEK 1 hour before or after meals or as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking VORITEK without consulting your doctor.

Do not take TERADERM 250MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About FLUCOZEST 2% DUSTING POWDER

FLUCOZEST 2% DUSTING POWDER contains Fluconazole that belong to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage, control, prevent, & manage fungal infections of skin such as tinea pedis (athlete's foot), tinea corporis (ring worm), tinea cruris (fungal sweat rash) and tinea versicolor.

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot) is a fungal infection that begins between toes generally in people whose feet remain sweaty. It is characterized by symptoms such as scaly rashes, itching, stinging and burning between toes. Tinea corporis (ring worm) is a fungal infection causing circular itchy rashes with clearer skin in the middle, resembling a ring.

Tinea cruris (fungal sweat rash) or jock itch is a fungal infection characterized by red and itchy rashes in the moist areas of the body such as groin. Tinea versicolor is a fungal infection that is characterized by abnormal skin pigmentation such as light and dark patches at the affected area.

Before using FLUCOZEST 2% DUSTING POWDER inform your doctor if you have any kidney, liver, heart or lung diseases. There is no information on the use of FLUCOZEST 2% DUSTING POWDER in pregnant or breastfeeding women and children. Ask for your doctor’s advice before using.

The most common side effects associated with the use of FLUCOZEST 2% DUSTING POWDER are itching, irritation and rashes. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of FLUCOZEST 2% DUSTING POWDER

It is used to manage fungal skin infections caused including:

Tinea pedis (athlete's foot)
Tinea corporis (ring worm)

Tinea versicolor
mechanismOfAction:
How FLUCOZEST 2% DUSTING POWDER Works

FLUCOZEST 2% DUSTING POWDER helps in manage fungal infection where Fluconazole inhibits the synthesis of certain compounds that are essential components of the fungal cell membrane. Moreover, it also impairs various important biological processes inside the fungal cell body required for its survival, thereby killing the killing the fungal cell bodies.

introduction:
Introduction About FUNGRIS DUSTING POWDER

FUNGRIS DUSTING POWDER contains Clotrimazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of skin infections such as athlete’s foot, jock itch, ringworm, and infections resulting from excessive sweating. It also relives symptoms such as burning, itching, skin cracking, and discomfort caused by the skin infections. Ringworm is a fungal infection affecting the skin, causing redness and itching. An athlete’s foot is a fungal infection affecting the spaces between the toes.

Clotrimazole works by blocking the fungal growth and managing the further occurrence of fungal infections. FUNGRIS DUSTING POWDER is intended to manage fungal skin infections; hence, it should not be used for other infections of internal organs. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids and mouth. Consult your doctor immediately if the infection does not recover within seven days of management with FUNGRIS DUSTING POWDER.

FUNGRIS DUSTING POWDER is not recommended for patients allergic to clotrimazole. FUNGRIS DUSTING POWDER is not recommended for use in deep wounds and severe burns. FUNGRIS DUSTING POWDER should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Before taking FUNGRIS DUSTING POWDER, inform your doctor if you’re under any medications.

FUNGRIS DUSTING POWDER works by managing the fungal growth. Clotrimazole works by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. It further manages the occurrence of fungal infections. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About SYNTRAN SB 65 CAPSULE

SYNTRAN SB 65 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use SYNTRAN SB 65 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with SYNTRAN SB 65 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with SYNTRAN SB 65 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. SYNTRAN SB 65 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

SYNTRAN SB 65 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking SYNTRAN SB 65 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SYNTRAN SB 65 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How SYNTRAN SB 65 CAPSULE Works

SYNTRAN SB 65 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.
usageInstructions: Take this medicine as advised by your physician.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of SYNTRAN SB 65 CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: TEXIFORD 250 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About TEXIFORD 250 TABLET

TEXIFORD 250 TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take TEXIFORD 250 TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking TEXIFORD 250 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take TEXIFORD 250 TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of TEXIFORD 250 TABLET
Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How TEXIFORD 250 TABLET Works

TEXIFORD 250 TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: Take TEXIFORD 250 TABLET as advised by your physician.
For Tablet: Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. But in children younger than 6 years, the medicine should be crushed before swallowing.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse TEXIFORD 250 TABLET in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ITROMED SB 65 CAPSULE

ITROMED SB 65 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITROMED SB 65 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITROMED SB 65 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITROMED SB 65 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITROMED SB 65 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITROMED SB 65 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITROMED SB 65 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITROMED SB 65 CAPSULE Works

ITROMED SB 65 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About FLUFUNG 150 TABLET

FLUFUNG 150 TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking FLUFUNG 150 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

FLUFUNG 150 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. FLUFUNG 150 TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking FLUFUNG 150 TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

Take TEBFIN 500 TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Do not take TEBFIN 500 TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About NIXITRAL ED 130 CAPSULE

NIXITRAL ED 130 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use NIXITRAL ED 130 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with NIXITRAL ED 130 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with NIXITRAL ED 130 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. NIXITRAL ED 130 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

NIXITRAL ED 130 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking NIXITRAL ED 130 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NIXITRAL ED 130 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How NIXITRAL ED 130 CAPSULE Works

NIXITRAL ED 130 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

name: NIZOCLIN 2% CREAM 30GM
introduction:
Introduction About NIZOCLIN 2% CREAM

NIZOCLIN 2% CREAM is used to manage fungal skin infections. It can be applied on your hands, feet, genital area, trunk, scalp, face and chest.

It contains an antifungal agent called Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. Use NIZOCLIN 2% CREAM as advised by your physician. Apply the required amount of the medicine to the affected skin areas.

Before applying NIZOCLIN 2% CREAM, inform your doctor if you are using a cream, ointment or lotion that contains a steroid.

NIZOCLIN 2% CREAM can be used if you are pregnant or breast-feeding, however, consult your doctor for advice. NIZOCLIN 2% CREAM is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of applying NIZOCLIN 2% CREAM are burning sensation, skin redness, or itching. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NIZOCLIN 2% CREAM
Management of fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How NIZOCLIN 2% CREAM Works

NIZOCLIN 2% CREAM contains Ketoconazole which works by stopping the growth of fungi. It blocks the production of a substance called ergosterol, which is essential for the fungi's cell membrane. Without ergosterol, the cell membrane becomes weak, causing the fungi to die and the infection to clear up.
usageDetails:
How to use NIZOCLIN 2% CREAM

Apply NIZOCLIN 2% CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash the infected area and dry it well.  Apply it to the affected and immediate surrounding area with clean fingers. Unless the affected skin is on your hands, wash your hands with soap and water after using NIZOCLIN 2% CREAM in order to stop you from spreading the infection to other parts of your body or to other people.

Keep using NIZOCLIN 2% CREAM until a few days after all symptoms have completely disappeared. This is to manage your symptoms from recurring.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Usually, you will see improvement after 4 weeks but if you don’t, talk to your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About MYCOCLEAR SB 130 CAPSULE

MYCOCLEAR SB 130 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use MYCOCLEAR SB 130 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with MYCOCLEAR SB 130 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with MYCOCLEAR SB 130 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. MYCOCLEAR SB 130 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

MYCOCLEAR SB 130 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking MYCOCLEAR SB 130 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MYCOCLEAR SB 130 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How MYCOCLEAR SB 130 CAPSULE Works

MYCOCLEAR SB 130 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.
usageInstructions: Take this medicine as advised by your physician.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of MYCOCLEAR SB 130 CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: ITRAGREAT 200mg Capsule 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ITRAGREAT 200MG CAPSULE

ITRAGREAT 200MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRAGREAT 200MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITRAGREAT 200MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITRAGREAT 200MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITRAGREAT 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITRAGREAT 200MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITRAGREAT 200MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITRAGREAT 200MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITRAGREAT 200MG CAPSULE Works

ITRAGREAT 200MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.
usageInstructions: Take this medicine as advised by your physician.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ITRAGREAT 200MG CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Medicines used to manage digestive problems Ex. cisapride
Colchicine (used to manage gout)
Medicines used to manage fluid accumulation, Ex. Eplerenone
Medicines used after labour Ex. ergometrine, methylergometrine
Medicine used to manage malaria Ex. halofantrine
Medicines used to manage cancer Ex. irinotecan, bortezomib, busulphan, docetaxel, erlotinib, ixabepilone, trimetrexate, axitinib, dabrafenib, dasatinib, ibrutinib, lapatinib, nilotinib, sunitinib, and trabectedin
Medicines used as blood thinners Ex. dabigatran, ticagrelor, rivaroxaban, warfarin
Medicines used to manage mental illness Ex. quetiapine, pimozide, lurasidone, aripiprazole, haloperidol, perospirone, ramelteon, risperidone, reboxetine, and sertindole
Medicines used to manage urinary bladder disorders Ex. darifenacin, tamsulosin, fesoterodine, imidafenacin, solifenacin, and tolterodine
Medicines used to manage anxiety Ex. midazolam, triazolam, buspirone, alprazolam, brotizolam
Medicines used after an organ transplant Ex. everolimus, ciclesonide, temsirolimus, ciclosporin, tacrolimus, sirolimus
Medicines used to relive pain Ex. fentanyl, alfentanil, buprenorphine, oxycodone
Medicines used to manage inflammation or asthma Ex. salmeterol, methylprednisolone, fluticasone, budesonide, dexamethasone
Medicines used to manage erection problems Ex. vardenafil, sildenafil and tadalafil
Medicines used to manage indigestion, stomach ulcers, or heartburn Ex. Pantoprazole, omeprazole
Medicines used to manage HIV infection Ex. ritonavir, darunavir, indinavir, fosamprenavir, saquinivir
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections Ex. ciprofloxacin, clarithromycin, erythromycin
Medicines used to manage tuberculosis Ex. rifampicin, rifabutin, or isoniazid
Medicines used to manage epilepsy Ex. phenytoin, carbamazepine, or phenobarbital
St. John’s Wort (used to manage depression)
Medicines used to manage eczema Ex. alitretinoin
Medicines used to manage vomiting Ex. aprepitant, domperidone
Medicines used to manage excess thyroid hormone secretion Ex. cinacalcet
Medicines used to manage low sodium blood levels Ex. mozavaptan or tolvaptan
Medicines used to manage worms Ex. praziquantel
Medicines used to manage high blood sugar Ex. Repaglinide, saxagliptin

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of ITRAGREAT 200MG CAPSULE, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital.

introduction:
Introduction About TERBOVAG 250 TABLET

TERBOVAG 250 TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take TERBOVAG 250 TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking TERBOVAG 250 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take TERBOVAG 250 TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of TERBOVAG 250 TABLET
Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How TERBOVAG 250 TABLET Works

TERBOVAG 250 TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: Take TERBOVAG 250 TABLET as advised by your physician.
For Tablet: Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. But in children younger than 6 years, the medicine should be crushed before swallowing.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse TERBOVAG 250 TABLET in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
usageDetails:
How to use TERBOVAG 250 TABLET
Take TERBOVAG 250 TABLET as advised by your physician.
For Tablet: Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. But in children younger than 6 years, the medicine should be crushed before swallowing.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse TERBOVAG 250 TABLET in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, indigestion, bloating
Signs of liver problems (such as unexplained persistent nausea, stomach problems, loss of appetite, unusual tiredness or weakness with yellowing of your skin or eyes, dark urine and pale faeces)
Inflammation of blood vessels causing purple spots under the skin
Inflammation of the pancreas causing severe stomach pain which radiates towards the back side
Signs of muscle breakdown (such as unexplained muscle weakness and dark or red urine)
Signs of low blood count (such as weakness, unusual bleeding, bruising, abnormal pale skin, unusual tiredness, or weakness or breathlessness on exertion or frequent infections)
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of TERBOVAG 250 TABLET
Common Side Effects of TERBOVAG 250 TABLET:
Headache
Nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, indigestion, bloating
Diarrhea
Muscle pain, joint pain
Skin rash, itching and swelling

Stop taking TERBOVAG 250 TABLET and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Signs of liver problems (such as unexplained persistent nausea, stomach problems, loss of appetite, unusual tiredness or weakness with yellowing of your skin or eyes, dark urine and pale faeces)
Inflammation of blood vessels causing purple spots under the skin
Inflammation of the pancreas causing severe stomach pain which radiates towards the back side
Signs of muscle breakdown (such as unexplained muscle weakness and dark or red urine)
Signs of low blood count (such as weakness, unusual bleeding, bruising, abnormal pale skin, unusual tiredness, or weakness or breathlessness on exertion or frequent infections)

warnings.details: Consult your doctor before taking TERBOVAG 250 TABLET if you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant.
TERBOVAG 250 TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience dizziness after taking TERBOVAG 250 TABLET.
TERBOVAG 250 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems.
TERBOVAG 250 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with an active or a previous history of liver problems.
Do not take TERBOVAG 250 TABLET if you are allergic to Terbinafine.
TERBOVAG 250 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years).
TERBOVAG 250 TABLET can be used with caution in elderly patients.

Others

Before taking TERBOVAG 250 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have psoriasis (scaly white patches on the skin)
Have systemic lupus erythematosus (a serious skin condition)
Have skin rashes or any other auto-immune skin condition

Pregnancy
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

Consult your doctor before taking TERBOVAG 250 TABLET if you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant.

Breastfeeding
CONTRAINDICATED

TERBOVAG 250 TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

Driving and Using Machines
USE WITH CAUTION

Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience dizziness after taking TERBOVAG 250 TABLET.

Kidney
USE WITH CAUTION

TERBOVAG 250 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems.

Liver
CONTRAINDICATED

TERBOVAG 250 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with an active or a previous history of liver problems.

Allergy
CONTRAINDICATED

Do not take TERBOVAG 250 TABLET if you are allergic to Terbinafine.

Use In Pediatrics
CONTRAINDICATED

TERBOVAG 250 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years).

Use In Geriatrics
USE WITH CAUTION

TERBOVAG 250 TABLET can be used with caution in elderly patients.

Others

Before taking TERBOVAG 250 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have psoriasis (scaly white patches on the skin)
Have systemic lupus erythematosus (a serious skin condition)
Have skin rashes or any other auto-immune skin condition

Interactions

A. Drug – Drug Interactions:

Before taking TERBOVAG 250 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Rifampicin (a medicine used to manage tuberculosis)
Cimetidine (a medicine used to manage stomach ulcers)
Oral contraceptives (birth control pills) such as ethinylestradiol
Warfarin (a medicine used for blood thinning)
Ciclosporin (a medicine used to manage graft rejection)

If you or anyone else accidentally took more TERBOVAG 250 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital.

name: Forcan Infusion 100ml
introduction:
Introduction About FORCAN INFUSION

FORCAN INFUSION contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used in adults and children for the management fungal infections including candidiasis, mucosal thrush (infection affecting the lining of mouth, throat, esophagus, bronchuses and lungs) when oral management is not possible and cryptococcal meningitis (fungal infection in the brain).

FORCAN INFUSION is also used to manage candida fungal infections in patients having reduced amounts of white blood cells (neutropenia) following bone marrow transplants.

Before receiving FORCAN INFUSION inform your doctor if you have kidney, liver or heart problems, AIDS or yeast infection. FORCAN INFUSION is not recommended to use among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding.

FORCAN INFUSION can be used in children and adolescents. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for your child, so consult with your child’s doctor. FORCAN INFUSION should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of receiving FORCAN INFUSION are headache, rash, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain and diarrhea. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen or persists.

mechanismOfAction:
How FORCAN INFUSION Works

FORCAN INFUSION helps in manage fungal infection where Fluconazole inhibits the synthesis of certain compounds (ergosterol) that are essential components of the fungal cell membrane, resulting into increased cellular permeability that causes leaking of cellular contents. Moreover, it also impairs various important biological processes inside the fungal cell body required for its survival, thereby killing the fungal cell bodies.
usageDetails:
How to use FORCAN INFUSION

FORCAN INFUSION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion or a slow injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of FORCAN INFUSION for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: FORCAN INFUSION is not recommended for use in pregnant women. If FORCAN INFUSION is received during first trimester, it may increase the risk of miscarriage or baby being born with birth defects affecting the bones and/or muscles Consult your doctor before receiving FORCAN INFUSION.
FORCAN INFUSION is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it passes through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before receiving it.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy or experience fits after receiving FORCAN INFUSION.

FORCAN INFUSION should be used with caution in patients with kidney disease. Your doctor may consider adjusting your dose depending on your kidney function. Consult your doctor before receiving FORCAN INFUSION.
FORCAN INFUSION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving it.
Do not receive FORCAN INFUSION if you are allergic to Fluconazole, other similar medicines such as ketoconazole and itraconazole or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.
FORCAN INFUSION should be used with caution in patients with heart disease. Consult your doctor before receiving it.

Others

Before receiving FORCAN INFUSION, inform your doctor if you have:

AIDS or infection that affects the whole body
Yeast infection (cryptococcosis)
Other fungal infections

Use in pediatrics:

FORCAN INFUSION can be used in children and adolescents. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for your child, so consult with your child’s doctor.

Use in geriatrics:

FORCAN INFUSION should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years and above). Your doctor may consider adjusting your dose depending on your kidney function. Consult your doctor before receiving FORCAN INFUSION.

introduction:
Introduction About ITRAKON 100MG CAPSULE

ITRAKON 100MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRAKON 100MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITRAKON 100MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITRAKON 100MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITRAKON 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITRAKON 100MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITRAKON 100MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITRAKON 100MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITRAKON 100MG CAPSULE Works

ITRAKON 100MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.
usageInstructions: Take this medicine as advised by your physician.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ITRAKON 100MG CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ITRALASE SB 65 CAPSULE

ITRALASE SB 65 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRALASE SB 65 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITRALASE SB 65 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITRALASE SB 65 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITRALASE SB 65 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITRALASE SB 65 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITRALASE SB 65 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

name: KETOFLY Dusting Powder 50gm
introduction:
Introduction About KETOFLY DUSTING POWDER

KETOFLY DUSTING POWDER contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used to topically manage fungal infections like tinea corporis (a skin infection of the trunk and extremities) and tinea cruris (infection of the proximal thighs and buttocks, also known as “jock itch”).

It can also be used to manage tinea pedis (also known as “athlete’s foot” and occurs in hot weather, with exposure to surface reservoirs and use of occlusive footwear) and cutaneous candidiasis (yeast infection of the skin).

Before applying KETOFLY DUSTING POWDER inform your doctor if you have any skin problems or allergies. There is no adequate data available for use of KETOFLY DUSTING POWDER in pregnancy. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women.

The safety and effectiveness of KETOFLY DUSTING POWDER in children have not been established. Contact your doctor if you experience any side effects or if any of the symptoms get worse.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KETOFLY DUSTING POWDER

Used for the topical management of:

Tinea corporis
Tinea cruris
Tinea pedis
Cutaneous candidiasis
mechanismOfAction:
How KETOFLY DUSTING POWDER Works

KETOFLY DUSTING POWDER reduces infection by disrupting the production of ergosterol (an important component of fungal cell membranes), thus disrupting the cell membrane of infecting fungus.
usageDetails:
How to use KETOFLY DUSTING POWDER

Apply KETOFLY DUSTING POWDER as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply KETOFLY DUSTING POWDER once daily to cover the affected and immediate surrounding area.

Use it only for the quantity and duration (preferably 2 weeks) specified by your doctor. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Worsening of the irritation at the application site
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of KETOFLY DUSTING POWDER
Rare

Stop using KETOFLY DUSTING POWDER and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Worsening of the condition
Worsening of the irritation at the application site

warnings.details: There is no data available for use of KETOFLY DUSTING POWDER in pregnancy. It should be used in pregnancy only if the potential benefit justifies the potential risk to the baby. Consult your doctor before applying it.

KETOFLY DUSTING POWDER should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. If used during breastfeeding and the medicine is applied on the chest, take caution to avoid accidental ingestion of the medicine by your baby. Consult your doctor before applying it.
Do not use KETOFLY DUSTING POWDER if you are allergic to Ketoconazole or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

Use in pediatrics:

The safety and effectiveness of KETOFLY DUSTING POWDER in children have not been established. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

introduction:
Introduction About TEXIFORD DUSTING POWDER

TEXIFORD DUSTING POWDER is used topically to manage fungal skin infections. It contains Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

TEXIFORD DUSTING POWDER is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas. Use for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2 weeks of therapy.

Do not use TEXIFORD DUSTING POWDER if you are allergic to terbinafine. It is not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using TEXIFORD DUSTING POWDER are skin peeling, itching, skin color changes and burning sensation at the side effects. These side effects are usually harmless.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TEXIFORD DUSTING POWDER
Manage fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How TEXIFORD DUSTING POWDER Works

TEXIFORD DUSTING POWDER is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: TEXIFORD DUSTING POWDER is for external use only.
Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas.
Avoid contact of this medicine with your face, eyes, ears, nose or any other mucous membranes.
Wash your hands before and after application.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the infection.
Do not stop using TEXIFORD DUSTING POWDER without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About SUBAWIN 50 CAPSULE

SUBAWIN 50 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use SUBAWIN 50 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with SUBAWIN 50 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with SUBAWIN 50 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. SUBAWIN 50 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

SUBAWIN 50 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking SUBAWIN 50 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SUBAWIN 50 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How SUBAWIN 50 CAPSULE Works

SUBAWIN 50 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.
usageInstructions: Take this medicine as advised by your physician.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of SUBAWIN 50 CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Medicines used to manage irregular heartbeat Ex. quinidine, disopyramide, dronedarone, or dofetilide

Medicines used to manage digestive problems Ex. cisapride

Medicines used to manage fluid accumulation, Ex. Eplerenone

Medicines used to manage tuberculosis Ex. rifampicin, rifabutin, or isoniazid
Medicines used to manage epilepsy Ex. phenytoin, carbamazepine, or phenobarbital

Medicines used to manage vomiting Ex. aprepitant, domperidone
Medicines used to manage excess thyroid hormone secretion Ex. cinacalcet
Medicines used to manage low sodium blood levels Ex. mozavaptan or tolvaptan
Medicines used to manage worms Ex. praziquantel
Medicines used to manage high blood sugar Ex. Repaglinide, saxagliptin

introduction:
Introduction About NIOFINE DUSTING POWDER

NIOFINE DUSTING POWDER is used topically to manage fungal skin infections. It contains Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

NIOFINE DUSTING POWDER is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas. Use for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2 weeks of therapy.

Do not use NIOFINE DUSTING POWDER if you are allergic to terbinafine. It is not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using NIOFINE DUSTING POWDER are skin peeling, itching, skin color changes and burning sensation at the side effects. These side effects are usually harmless.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NIOFINE DUSTING POWDER
Manage fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How NIOFINE DUSTING POWDER Works

NIOFINE DUSTING POWDER is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: NIOFINE DUSTING POWDER is for external use only.
Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas.
Avoid contact of this medicine with your face, eyes, ears, nose or any other mucous membranes.
Wash your hands before and after application.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the infection.
Do not stop using NIOFINE DUSTING POWDER without consulting your doctor.

Introduction About TERFUNG 250MG TABLET

TERFUNG 250MG TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take TERFUNG 250MG TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking TERFUNG 250MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take TERFUNG 250MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About NIXITRAL ED 65 CAPSULE

NIXITRAL ED 65 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use NIXITRAL ED 65 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with NIXITRAL ED 65 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with NIXITRAL ED 65 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. NIXITRAL ED 65 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

NIXITRAL ED 65 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking NIXITRAL ED 65 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NIXITRAL ED 65 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How NIXITRAL ED 65 CAPSULE Works

NIXITRAL ED 65 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About I WIN 200 CAPSULE

I WIN 200 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use I WIN 200 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with I WIN 200 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with I WIN 200 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. I WIN 200 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

I WIN 200 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking I WIN 200 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of I WIN 200 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How I WIN 200 CAPSULE Works

I WIN 200 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.
usageInstructions: Take this medicine as advised by your physician.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of I WIN 200 CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ITRAZEST 100MG CAPSULE

ITRAZEST 100MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRAZEST 100MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITRAZEST 100MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITRAZEST 100MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITRAZEST 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITRAZEST 100MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITRAZEST 100MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITRAZEST 100MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITRAZEST 100MG CAPSULE Works

ITRAZEST 100MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

name: TRIBEN F 150 Tablet 2's
introduction:
Introduction About TRIBEN F 150 TABLET

TRIBEN F 150 TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking TRIBEN F 150 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

TRIBEN F 150 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. TRIBEN F 150 TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking TRIBEN F 150 TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

How TRIBEN F 150 TABLET Works

TRIBEN F 150 TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.
