introduction:
Introduction About ITNA 100 CAPSULE

ITNA 100 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITNA 100 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITNA 100 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITNA 100 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITNA 100 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITNA 100 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITNA 100 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITNA 100 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITNA 100 CAPSULE Works

ITNA 100 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.
usageInstructions: Take this medicine as advised by your physician.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ITNA 100 CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About VORIZOL 200MG INJECTION

VORIZOL 200MG INJECTION contains Voriconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections (such as invasive aspergillosis, candidaemia, invasive Candida sp. infections) in both adults and in children (aged 2 years or above). It can also be used to manage fungal infections in high-risk bone marrow transplant recipients.

VORIZOL 200MG INJECTION is highly intended for patients with worsening or life-threatening fungal infections. It is important to complete the full course of therapy with VORIZOL 200MG INJECTION to achieve better control over infection.

Before receiving VORIZOL 200MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver or heart problems. Do not receive VORIZOL 200MG INJECTION if you are pregnant or breast-feeding without consulting your doctor.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with VORIZOL 200MG INJECTION. During management with VORIZOL 200MG INJECTION, avoid exposing your skin towards direct sunlight. Wear protective loose-fitting clothes and apply sunscreen while going outdoors.

The most common side-effects of receiving VORIZOL 200MG INJECTION are visual impairment, fever, rash, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, headache, swelling of the extremities, stomach pain and breathing difficulties. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Manage and manage severe fungal infections
usesDetails:
Uses Of VORIZOL 200MG INJECTION

It is used in adults and in children (aged 2 years or older) to:

Manage and manage severe fungal infections
mechanismOfAction:
How VORIZOL 200MG INJECTION Works

VORIZOL 200MG INJECTION is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageDetails:
How to use VORIZOL 200MG INJECTION

VORIZOL 200MG INJECTION will be administered to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously).

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not skip doses or stop therapy with VORIZOL 200MG INJECTION without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About FUCAN 150 TABLET

FUCAN 150 TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking FUCAN 150 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

FUCAN 150 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. FUCAN 150 TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking FUCAN 150 TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

How FUCAN 150 TABLET Works

FUCAN 150 TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.

Take FUCAN 150 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow FUCAN 150 TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. The correct dose and duration for you will be decide by the doctor depending upon your age, body weight and type of infection.

Introduction About TERBISON 250MG TABLET

TERBISON 250MG TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take TERBISON 250MG TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking TERBISON 250MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take TERBISON 250MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

How TERBISON 250MG TABLET Works

TERBISON 250MG TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE

ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Uses Of ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE Works

ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ITRANOX 200MG CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ITROMAC 100 CAPSULE

ITROMAC 100 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITROMAC 100 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITROMAC 100 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITROMAC 100 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITROMAC 100 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITROMAC 100 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITROMAC 100 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITROMAC 100 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITROMAC 100 CAPSULE Works

ITROMAC 100 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ITROMAC 100 CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRAFUNG 200MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS).

introduction:
Introduction About AF 200 TABLET

AF 200 TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).   

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.

Before taking AF 200 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.

AF 200 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. AF 200 TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking AF 200 TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

introduction:
Introduction About ITRANOX 100MG CAPSULE

ITRANOX 100MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRANOX 100MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITRANOX 100MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITRANOX 100MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITRANOX 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITRANOX 100MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITRANOX 100MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITRANOX 100MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITRANOX 100MG CAPSULE Works

ITRANOX 100MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ITRANOX 100MG CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ITRANOX 100MG CAPSULE

ITRANOX 100MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRANOX 100MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITRANOX 100MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITRANOX 100MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITRANOX 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITRANOX 100MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITRANOX 100MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITRANOX 100MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITRANOX 100MG CAPSULE Works

ITRANOX 100MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About TEXIFORD 500 TABLET

TEXIFORD 500 TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take TEXIFORD 500 TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking TEXIFORD 500 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take TEXIFORD 500 TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of TEXIFORD 500 TABLET
Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How TEXIFORD 500 TABLET Works

TEXIFORD 500 TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: Take TEXIFORD 500 TABLET as advised by your physician.
For Tablet: Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. But in children younger than 6 years, the medicine should be crushed before swallowing.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse TEXIFORD 500 TABLET in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ITRACOE 200MG CAPSULE

ITRACOE 200MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRACOE 200MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITRACOE 200MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITRACOE 200MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITRACOE 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITRACOE 200MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITRACOE 200MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITRACOE 200MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITRACOE 200MG CAPSULE Works

ITRACOE 200MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ITRACOE 200MG CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CRESEMBA 100MG CAPSULE

CRESEMBA 100MG CAPSULE is used in the management of fungal infections such as invasive aspergillosis and mucormycosis in patients for whom amphotericin B is inappropriate. It contains a powerful antifungal agent called Isavuconazole which works by stopping the production of ergosterol, a key component for fungal cell membranes. This action helps in eradication of the susceptible fungi.

Take CRESEMBA 100MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. Do not stop taking CRESEMBA 100MG CAPSULE or skip doses without consulting your doctor as it might reduce the effectiveness of this medicine and makes it difficult for faster recovery.

Before taking CRESEMBA 100MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you are allergic to Isavuconazole or other antifungal medicine. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant, breastfeeding or have any heart problems.

How CRESEMBA 100MG CAPSULE Works

CRESEMBA 100MG CAPSULE contains Isavuconazole which is an antifungal medication that works by inhibiting an enzyme called lanosterol 14α-demethylase, which is essential for producing ergosterol, a key component of fungal cell membranes. By blocking this enzyme, Isavuconazole prevents the fungus from creating a stable cell membrane, leading to its death. This action helps in management of fungal infections in the body.

introduction:
Introduction About MONOCAN 150MG TABLET

MONOCAN 150MG TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking MONOCAN 150MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

MONOCAN 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. MONOCAN 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking MONOCAN 150MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

introduction:
Introduction About FLU NZ 200 TABLET

FLU NZ 200 TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).   

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.

Before taking FLU NZ 200 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.

FLU NZ 200 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. FLU NZ 200 TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking FLU NZ 200 TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

How FLU NZ 200 TABLET Works

FLU NZ 200 TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.

Introduction About FUNGOTEK

FUNGOTEK is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take FUNGOTEK for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking FUNGOTEK inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take FUNGOTEK without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How FUNGOTEK Works

FUNGOTEK is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About MONOCAN 100MG CAPSULE

MONOCAN 100MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use MONOCAN 100MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with MONOCAN 100MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with MONOCAN 100MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. MONOCAN 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

MONOCAN 100MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking MONOCAN 100MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How MONOCAN 100MG CAPSULE Works

MONOCAN 100MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About MONOCAN 200MG CAPSULE

MONOCAN 200MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use MONOCAN 200MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with MONOCAN 200MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with MONOCAN 200MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. MONOCAN 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

MONOCAN 200MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking MONOCAN 200MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MONOCAN 200MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How MONOCAN 200MG CAPSULE Works

MONOCAN 200MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About CLOGEN TABLET

CLOGEN TABLET contains Clotrimazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used in the management of candidal vaginitis. Candidal vaginitis is an infection caused by a type of fungi called yeast that affects the female genital organs such as the vagina and vulva the outer region of the vagina.

Candidal vaginitis causes itching in the vagina and areas surrounding it, abnormally smelly discharge, pain during intercourse, and painful urination. Pregnant women, women using contraceptives, women with weakened immune systems recently managed with antibiotics, and diabetic women are highly susceptible to this infection. Do not use tampons, intravaginal douches, spermicides, or other vaginal products while using CLOGEN TABLET. Sexual intercourse should be avoided during the management.

CLOGEN TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with irregular vaginal bleeding, abnormal vaginal bleeding like a blood discharge, ulcers, blisters, or sores in the vagina, lower stomach pain, fever, shivering, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, a smell in the vaginal discharge, or a menstrual period. CLOGEN TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have had fungal infections twice in the last six months or who have ever had a sexually transmitted disease or had sexual contact with a patient who has a sexually transmitted disease.

In pregnant and breastfeeding women, CLOGEN TABLET should be used with caution. Kindly consult your doctor before using it. CLOGEN TABLET should not be used by children under the age of 16. In elderly patients over the age of 60, CLOGEN TABLET should be used with caution. The common side effects of CLOGEN TABLET are burning, stinging, swelling, and irritation sensations in the vagina.
usesDetails:

Manage candidal vaginitis
mechanismOfAction:
How CLOGEN TABLET Works

CLOGEN TABLET works by managing fungal growth. Clotrimazole works by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in the breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in the membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and the management of further fungal growth.
usageDetails:
How to use CLOGEN TABLET

Use CLOGEN TABLET as advised by your physician. It is for vaginal use only. Do not swallow the medicine. CLOGEN TABLET should be inserted into the vagina, as high as possible, using the applicator provided which is best achieved when lying back with legs bent up. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition. If you have any doubts regarding the doses, consult your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About TERBIMAX 250 TABLET

TERBIMAX 250 TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take TERBIMAX 250 TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking TERBIMAX 250 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take TERBIMAX 250 TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of TERBIMAX 250 TABLET
Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How TERBIMAX 250 TABLET Works

TERBIMAX 250 TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: Take TERBIMAX 250 TABLET as advised by your physician.
For Tablet: Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. But in children younger than 6 years, the medicine should be crushed before swallowing.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse TERBIMAX 250 TABLET in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About VORITROP 200MG TABLET

VORITROP 200MG TABLET contains Voriconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections (such as invasive aspergillosis, candidaemia, invasive Candida sp. infections) in both adults and in children (aged 2 years or above). It can also be used to manage fungal infections in high-risk bone marrow transplant recipients.

VORITROP 200MG TABLET should be taken at least 1 hour before or after meals. It is highly intended for patients with worsening or life-threatening fungal infections. It is important to complete the full course of therapy with VORITROP 200MG TABLET to achieve better control over infection.

Before taking VORITROP 200MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or heart problems. Do not take VORITROP 200MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breast-feeding without consulting your doctor.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with VORITROP 200MG TABLET. During management with VORITROP 200MG TABLET, avoid exposing your skin towards direct sunlight. Wear protective loose-fitting clothes and apply sunscreen while going outdoors.

The most common side-effects of taking VORITROP 200MG TABLET are visual impairment, fever, rash, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, headache, swelling of the extremities, stomach pain and breathing difficulties. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Manage and manage severe fungal infections
usesDetails:
Uses Of VORITROP 200MG TABLET

It is used in adults and in children (aged 2 years or older) to:

Manage and manage severe fungal infections
mechanismOfAction:
How VORITROP 200MG TABLET Works

VORITROP 200MG TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageDetails:
How to use VORITROP 200MG TABLET

Take VORITROP 200MG TABLET 1 hour before or after meals or as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking VORITROP 200MG TABLET without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About FLUCOS ITZ 100MG CAPSULE

FLUCOS ITZ 100MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use FLUCOS ITZ 100MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with FLUCOS ITZ 100MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with FLUCOS ITZ 100MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. FLUCOS ITZ 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

FLUCOS ITZ 100MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking FLUCOS ITZ 100MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:

Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How FLUCOS ITZ 100MG CAPSULE Works

FLUCOS ITZ 100MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

Introduction About KEVON TABLET

KEVON TABLET contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used in adults to manage systemic fungal infections, chronic mucocutaneous and vaginal candidiasis, oral rush candiduric (fungal infection of mouth), etc.

Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving KEVON TABLET management. Before taking KEVON TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or adrenal problems.

KEVON TABLET should be used during pregnancy only if the potential benefit justifies the potential risk to the baby. KEVON TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women. KEVON TABLET is not for use in children (especially under 2 years of age), so consult your doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of taking KEVON TABLET are nausea, headache, diarrhoea, stomach pain, etc. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About INTAWIN 400MG TABLET

INTAWIN 400MG TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).      

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking INTAWIN 400MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

INTAWIN 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. INTAWIN 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking INTAWIN 400MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

How INTAWIN 400MG TABLET Works

INTAWIN 400MG TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.

introduction:
Introduction About MITRAA 200MG CAPSULE

MITRAA 200MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use MITRAA 200MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with MITRAA 200MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with MITRAA 200MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. MITRAA 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

MITRAA 200MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking MITRAA 200MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MITRAA 200MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How MITRAA 200MG CAPSULE Works

MITRAA 200MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About KAIFLUK 400MG TABLET

KAIFLUK 400MG TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).      

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking KAIFLUK 400MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

KAIFLUK 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. KAIFLUK 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking KAIFLUK 400MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

How KAIFLUK 400MG TABLET Works

KAIFLUK 400MG TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.

introduction:
Introduction About CLOBEGO CREAM

CLOBEGO CREAM contains Clobetasol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical corticosteroids. It is used in adults and adolescents (aged 12 years or above) to manage inflammatory skin conditions such as psoriasis, eczema and dermatitis that have not responded to milder steroid creams or ointments.

Psoriasis is an immune-mediated skin disease that speeds up the growth cycle of skin cells, causing patches of thick red skin and silvery scales, typically on the elbows, knees, scalp, lower back, face, palms, and soles, but can affect other places also. Eczema (also called dermatitis) includes several different types of skin swelling, causing dry, itchy skin and rashes on the face, inside the elbows, behind the knees, and on the hands and feet. Scratching the skin can make it turn red, swell and itch even more.

CLOBEGO CREAM is not recommended for use in patients with other bacterial, fungal, or viral infections (such as herpes simplex, chicken pox and tuberculosis). Before using CLOBEGO CREAM, inform your doctor if you have a skin infection, diabetes, adrenal gland problem, scheduled surgery, acne, plaques around your mouth, underarms, anus, or genitals and liver diseases.

CLOBEGO CREAM should be used during pregnancy only if recommended by your doctor. CLOBEGO CREAM should be used with caution by breastfeeding women. CLOBEGO CREAM is not recommended for use by children under 12 years of age. The most common side effects of using CLOBEGO CREAM are thinning of the skin, widening of small veins in the skin, skin discomfort and dryness. Contact your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.

It acts by blocking the release of certain chemical mediators (prostaglandins, leukotrienes) in the body that causes pain, inflammation and swelling. introduction:
Introduction About IPHYTORAL 200MG CAPSULE

IPHYTORAL 200MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use IPHYTORAL 200MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with IPHYTORAL 200MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with IPHYTORAL 200MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. IPHYTORAL 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

IPHYTORAL 200MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking IPHYTORAL 200MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of IPHYTORAL 200MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How IPHYTORAL 200MG CAPSULE Works

IPHYTORAL 200MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About CRESEMBA 200MG INJECTION

CRESEMBA 200MG INJECTION is used in the management of fungal infections such as invasive aspergillosis and mucormycosis in patients for whom amphotericin B is inappropriate. It contains a powerful antifungal agent called Isavuconazole which works by stopping the production of ergosterol, a key component for fungal cell membranes. This action helps in eradication of the susceptible fungi.

CRESEMBA 200MG INJECTION should be used under medical supervision. Do not stop therapy with CRESEMBA 200MG INJECTION or skip doses without consulting your doctor as it might reduce the effectiveness of this medicine and makes it difficult for faster recovery.

Before receiving CRESEMBA 200MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you are allergic to Isavuconazole or other antifungal medicine. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant, breastfeeding or have any heart problems.

The most common side effects of receiving CRESEMBA 200MG INJECTION are low blood potassium levels, low RBC, WBC and platelet counts, dizziness, tiredness, fainting, taste changes, low appetite, indigestion, constipation, reduce sense to touch, tingling sensations or hair loss. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CRESEMBA 200MG INJECTION

Used in the management of fungal infections such as:

Invasive aspergillosis
Mucormycosis
mechanismOfAction:
How CRESEMBA 200MG INJECTION Works

CRESEMBA 200MG INJECTION contains Isavuconazole which is an antifungal medication that works by inhibiting an enzyme called lanosterol 14α-demethylase, which is essential for producing ergosterol, a key component of fungal cell membranes. By blocking this enzyme, Isavuconazole prevents the fungus from creating a stable cell membrane, leading to its death. This action helps in management of fungal infections in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use CRESEMBA 200MG INJECTION

CRESEMBA 200MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein as intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of the therapy based on your age, body weight, and health condition. Do not stop receiving CRESEMBA 200MG INJECTION or skip doses without consulting your doctor as it might reduce the effectiveness of this medicine and makes the fungi more resistant to the medicine which makes it difficult for faster recovery.

introduction:
Introduction About VORAZE 200MG TABLET

VORAZE 200MG TABLET contains Voriconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections (such as invasive aspergillosis, candidaemia, invasive Candida sp. infections) in both adults and in children (aged 2 years or above). It can also be used to manage fungal infections in high-risk bone marrow transplant recipients.

VORAZE 200MG TABLET should be taken at least 1 hour before or after meals. It is highly intended for patients with worsening or life-threatening fungal infections. It is important to complete the full course of therapy with VORAZE 200MG TABLET to achieve better control over infection.

Before taking VORAZE 200MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or heart problems. Do not take VORAZE 200MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breast-feeding without consulting your doctor.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with VORAZE 200MG TABLET. During management with VORAZE 200MG TABLET, avoid exposing your skin towards direct sunlight. Wear protective loose-fitting clothes and apply sunscreen while going outdoors.

The most common side-effects of taking VORAZE 200MG TABLET are visual impairment, fever, rash, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, headache, swelling of the extremities, stomach pain and breathing difficulties. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Manage and manage severe fungal infections
usesDetails:
Uses Of VORAZE 200MG TABLET

It is used in adults and in children (aged 2 years or older) to:

Manage and manage severe fungal infections
mechanismOfAction:
How VORAZE 200MG TABLET Works

VORAZE 200MG TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageDetails:
How to use VORAZE 200MG TABLET

Take VORAZE 200MG TABLET 1 hour before or after meals or as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking VORAZE 200MG TABLET without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About CONAFORCE SB 65 CAPSULE

CONAFORCE SB 65 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use CONAFORCE SB 65 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with CONAFORCE SB 65 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with CONAFORCE SB 65 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. CONAFORCE SB 65 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

CONAFORCE SB 65 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking CONAFORCE SB 65 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CONAFORCE SB 65 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How CONAFORCE SB 65 CAPSULE Works

CONAFORCE SB 65 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About VORIER 200MG TABLET

VORIER 200MG TABLET contains Voriconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections (such as invasive aspergillosis, candidaemia, invasive Candida sp. infections) in both adults and in children (aged 2 years or above). It can also be used to manage fungal infections in high-risk bone marrow transplant recipients.

VORIER 200MG TABLET should be taken at least 1 hour before or after meals. It is highly intended for patients with worsening or life-threatening fungal infections. It is important to complete the full course of therapy with VORIER 200MG TABLET to achieve better control over infection.

Before taking VORIER 200MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or heart problems. Do not take VORIER 200MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breast-feeding without consulting your doctor.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with VORIER 200MG TABLET. During management with VORIER 200MG TABLET, avoid exposing your skin towards direct sunlight. Wear protective loose-fitting clothes and apply sunscreen while going outdoors.

The most common side-effects of taking VORIER 200MG TABLET are visual impairment, fever, rash, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, headache, swelling of the extremities, stomach pain and breathing difficulties. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Manage and manage severe fungal infections
usesDetails:
Uses Of VORIER 200MG TABLET

It is used in adults and in children (aged 2 years or older) to:

Manage and manage severe fungal infections
mechanismOfAction:
How VORIER 200MG TABLET Works

VORIER 200MG TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageDetails:
How to use VORIER 200MG TABLET

Take VORIER 200MG TABLET 1 hour before or after meals or as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking VORIER 200MG TABLET without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About ITNA 200 CAPSULE

ITNA 200 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITNA 200 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITNA 200 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITNA 200 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITNA 200 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITNA 200 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITNA 200 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITNA 200 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITNA 200 CAPSULE Works

ITNA 200 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About SOLCAN 150 TABLET

SOLCAN 150 TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking SOLCAN 150 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

SOLCAN 150 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. SOLCAN 150 TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

introduction:
Introduction About MONOCAN 100MG CAPSULE

MONOCAN 100MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use MONOCAN 100MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with MONOCAN 100MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with MONOCAN 100MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. MONOCAN 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

MONOCAN 100MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking MONOCAN 100MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MONOCAN 100MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How MONOCAN 100MG CAPSULE Works

MONOCAN 100MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About TERGOSIL TABLET

TERGOSIL TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take TERGOSIL TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking TERGOSIL TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take TERGOSIL TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of TERGOSIL TABLET
Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How TERGOSIL TABLET Works

TERGOSIL TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

For Tablet: Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. But in children younger than 6 years, the medicine should be crushed before swallowing.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse TERGOSIL TABLET in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ITRABACT CAPSULE

ITRABACT CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRABACT CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITRABACT CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITRABACT CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITRABACT CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITRABACT CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITRABACT CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITRABACT CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITRABACT CAPSULE Works

ITRABACT CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

name: AMBILON 50mg Injection 1's
introduction:
Introduction About AMBILON 50MG INJECTION

AMBILON 50MG INJECTION contains Amphotericin B which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. AMBILON 50MG INJECTION is used to manage invasive fungal infections in patients who are resistant/intolerant to conventional Amphotericin B therapy.

AMBILON 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Amphotericin B. It is also not recommended for use in patients with common/superficial, clinically inapparent fungal infections (which are detectable only by positive skin/serologic tests).

Before receiving AMBILON 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are neutropenic, and/or have liver problems (such as hepatic impairment), and suffer from kidney problems/undergoing dialysis.

AMBILON 50MG INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women only if it is clearly necessary. It is also used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and in elders (aged above 65 years) after consulting with the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving AMBILON 50MG INJECTION are fever, chills, and/or rigors. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage invasive fungal infections in patients who are resistant/intolerant to conventional Amphotericin B therapy
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMBILON 50MG INJECTION
Manage invasive fungal infections in patients who are resistant/intolerant to conventional Amphotericin B therapy
mechanismOfAction:
How AMBILON 50MG INJECTION Works

AMBILON 50MG INJECTION binds to ergosterol (steroid present on the cell membranes of fungi) which leads to the formation of pores and ion leakage on the cell membrane resulting in fungal cell death thus managing invasive fungal infections in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use AMBILON 50MG INJECTION

AMBILON 50MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About VORIZOL 200MG TABLET

VORIZOL 200MG TABLET contains Voriconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections (such as invasive aspergillosis, candidaemia, invasive Candida sp. infections) in both adults and in children (aged 2 years or above). It can also be used to manage fungal infections in high-risk bone marrow transplant recipients.

VORIZOL 200MG TABLET should be taken at least 1 hour before or after meals. It is highly intended for patients with worsening or life-threatening fungal infections. It is important to complete the full course of therapy with VORIZOL 200MG TABLET to achieve better control over infection.

Before taking VORIZOL 200MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or heart problems. Do not take VORIZOL 200MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breast-feeding without consulting your doctor.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with VORIZOL 200MG TABLET. During management with VORIZOL 200MG TABLET, avoid exposing your skin towards direct sunlight. Wear protective loose-fitting clothes and apply sunscreen while going outdoors.

The most common side-effects of taking VORIZOL 200MG TABLET are visual impairment, fever, rash, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, headache, swelling of the extremities, stomach pain and breathing difficulties. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Manage and manage severe fungal infections
usesDetails:
Uses Of VORIZOL 200MG TABLET

It is used in adults and in children (aged 2 years or older) to:

Manage and manage severe fungal infections
mechanismOfAction:
How VORIZOL 200MG TABLET Works

VORIZOL 200MG TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageDetails:
How to use VORIZOL 200MG TABLET

Take VORIZOL 200MG TABLET 1 hour before or after meals or as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking VORIZOL 200MG TABLET without consulting your doctor.
