Introduction About VFEND 50MG TABLET

VFEND 50MG TABLET contains Voriconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections (such as invasive aspergillosis, candidaemia, invasive Candida sp. infections) in both adults and in children (aged 2 years or above). It can also be used to manage fungal infections in high-risk bone marrow transplant recipients.

VFEND 50MG TABLET should be taken at least 1 hour before or after meals. It is highly intended for patients with worsening or life-threatening fungal infections. It is important to complete the full course of therapy with VFEND 50MG TABLET to achieve better control over infection.

Before taking VFEND 50MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or heart problems. Do not take VFEND 50MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breast-feeding without consulting your doctor.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with VFEND 50MG TABLET. During management with VFEND 50MG TABLET, avoid exposing your skin towards direct sunlight. Wear protective loose-fitting clothes and apply sunscreen while going outdoors.

The most common side-effects of taking VFEND 50MG TABLET are visual impairment, fever, rash, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, headache, swelling of the extremities, stomach pain and breathing difficulties. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Manage and manage severe fungal infections

mechanismOfAction:
How VFEND 50MG TABLET Works

VFEND 50MG TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

How to use VFEND 50MG TABLET

Take VFEND 50MG TABLET 1 hour before or after meals or as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking VFEND 50MG TABLET without consulting your doctor.

Take TERBINATOR 500 TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking TERBINATOR 500 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take TERBINATOR 500 TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About ODCAN 200MG TABLET

ODCAN 200MG TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).   

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.

Before taking ODCAN 200MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.

ODCAN 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. ODCAN 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking ODCAN 200MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

How ODCAN 200MG TABLET Works

ODCAN 200MG TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.

introduction:
Introduction About IPHYTORAL 100MG CAPSULE

IPHYTORAL 100MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use IPHYTORAL 100MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with IPHYTORAL 100MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with IPHYTORAL 100MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. IPHYTORAL 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

IPHYTORAL 100MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking IPHYTORAL 100MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of IPHYTORAL 100MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How IPHYTORAL 100MG CAPSULE Works

IPHYTORAL 100MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.
usageInstructions: Take this medicine as advised by your physician.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of IPHYTORAL 100MG CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

If the duration of the management with MONOCAN 200MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. MONOCAN 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

MONOCAN 200MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking MONOCAN 200MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:

MONOCAN 200MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About NIZOCLIN 200MG TABLET

NIZOCLIN 200MG TABLET contains Ketoconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used in adults to manage systemic fungal infections, chronic mucocutaneous and vaginal candidiasis, oral rush candiduric (fungal infection of mouth), etc.

Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving NIZOCLIN 200MG TABLET management. Before taking NIZOCLIN 200MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or adrenal problems.

NIZOCLIN 200MG TABLET should be used during pregnancy only if the potential benefit justifies the potential risk to the baby. NIZOCLIN 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women. NIZOCLIN 200MG TABLET is not for use in children (especially under 2 years of age), so consult your doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of taking NIZOCLIN 200MG TABLET are nausea, headache, diarrhoea, stomach pain, etc. If any of the symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NIZOCLIN 200MG TABLET

Manages

Systemic fungal infections
Candidiasis (chronic mucocutaneous and vaginal)
Oral rush candiduric
mechanismOfAction:
How NIZOCLIN 200MG TABLET Works

NIZOCLIN 200MG TABLET works by blocking the synthesis of ergosterol (a key component of the fungal cell membrane) thus weakening the structure and function of the fungal cell membrane.
usageDetails:
How to use NIZOCLIN 200MG TABLET

Take NIZOCLIN 200MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not crush or chew it. Swallow NIZOCLIN 200MG TABLET as whole with a glass of water. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of therapy for you according to your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking NIZOCLIN 200MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

NIZOCLIN 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it can pass into the breastmilk. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy or sleepy after taking NIZOCLIN 200MG TABLET.
Do not consume alcohol while taking NIZOCLIN 200MG TABLET as it can lead to disulfiram-like reaction (a very uncomfortable reaction characterized by severe flushing). Consult your doctor for advice.
NIZOCLIN 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take NIZOCLIN 200MG TABLET if you are allergic to Ketoconazole or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

NIZOCLIN 200MG TABLET should be used with caution if you or any of your family members had an abnormal heart rhythm tracing (ECG) or a heart problem called “congenital long QT syndrome”. Consult your doctor before taking it.
NIZOCLIN 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (especially under 2 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.
NIZOCLIN 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients to avoid the risk of fracture. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

Before taking NIZOCLIN 200MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have adrenal insufficiency

introduction:
Introduction About GRISOJET 500MG TABLET

GRISOJET 500MG TABLET contains Griseofulvin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal drugs. It is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, scalp, hair, groin, feet, or nails where topical therapy is not suitable or has failed to manage the condition.

Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving GRISOJET 500MG TABLET management. Before taking GRISOJET 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have skin, liver, or kidney problems or porphyria (which results from an increase in certain chemicals related to red blood cell proteins).

GRISOJET 500MG TABLET is not recommended for pregnant or breastfeeding women; therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking GRISOJET 500MG TABLET are headache, diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, or stomach discomfort. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, scalp, hair, groin, feet, and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of GRISOJET 500MG TABLET
Manage fungal infections of the skin, scalp, hair, groin, feet, and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How GRISOJET 500MG TABLET Works

GRISOJET 500MG TABLET inhibits the growth of fungi by binding to a part of the fungus causing the infection in the body. This stops the fungus from multiplying. It also manages fungus from spreading to new cells. These actions cause the fungal infection to shed completely.
usageDetails:
How to use GRISOJET 500MG TABLET

Take GRISOJET 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Lack of appetite, changes in taste sensation
Blistering and peeling of the skin, lumpy skin (with or without an oozing liquid), redness and burning of the skin
Decrease in certain types of blood cells (increased minor infections, sore throat, tiredness, weakness)
Painful, swollen skin, and joints, butterfly rash, severe skin reactions (red, raised, itchy and painful skin rash)

GRISOJET 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any machines after taking GRISOJET 500MG TABLET as it may cause drowsiness, dizziness, confusion, and lack of coordination.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking GRISOJET 500MG TABLET as it may make alcohol affect you more (nausea, vomiting, blush, irregular heartbeat, chest pain or abdominal pain).
GRISOJET 500MG TABLET is not recommended in patients with severe liver disease. It should be used with caution if you have liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take GRISOJET 500MG TABLET if you are allergic to Griseofulvin.

Others

GRISOJET 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have a rare disease called porphyria
Have Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (a rare painful skin and tissue disease)

Before taking GRISOJET 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Are a man, planning for baby
Feel that your skin is getting easily affected due to sunlight or ultraviolet (UV) light

Use in pediatrics:

GRISOJET 500MG TABLET might need some dose adjustments in children. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About KAIFLUK 150MG TABLET

KAIFLUK 150MG TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking KAIFLUK 150MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

KAIFLUK 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. KAIFLUK 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking KAIFLUK 150MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How KAIFLUK 150MG TABLET Works

KAIFLUK 150MG TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.

Take KAIFLUK 150MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow KAIFLUK 150MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. The correct dose and duration for you will be decide by the doctor depending upon your age, body weight and type of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About ITRIBEN 100MG CAPSULE

ITRIBEN 100MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRIBEN 100MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITRIBEN 100MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITRIBEN 100MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITRIBEN 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITRIBEN 100MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITRIBEN 100MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITRIBEN 100MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITRIBEN 100MG CAPSULE Works

ITRIBEN 100MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

name: VORINZ 200 Tablet 4's
introduction:
Introduction About VORINZ 200 TABLET

VORINZ 200 TABLET contains Voriconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections (such as invasive aspergillosis, candidaemia, invasive Candida sp. infections) in both adults and in children (aged 2 years or above). It can also be used to manage fungal infections in high-risk bone marrow transplant recipients.

VORINZ 200 TABLET should be taken at least 1 hour before or after meals. It is highly intended for patients with worsening or life-threatening fungal infections. It is important to complete the full course of therapy with VORINZ 200 TABLET to achieve better control over infection.

Before taking VORINZ 200 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or heart problems. Do not take VORINZ 200 TABLET if you are pregnant or breast-feeding without consulting your doctor.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with VORINZ 200 TABLET. During management with VORINZ 200 TABLET, avoid exposing your skin towards direct sunlight. Wear protective loose-fitting clothes and apply sunscreen while going outdoors.

The most common side-effects of taking VORINZ 200 TABLET are visual impairment, fever, rash, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, headache, swelling of the extremities, stomach pain and breathing difficulties. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Manage and manage severe fungal infections
usesDetails:
Uses Of VORINZ 200 TABLET

It is used in adults and in children (aged 2 years or older) to:

Manage and manage severe fungal infections
mechanismOfAction:
How VORINZ 200 TABLET Works

VORINZ 200 TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageDetails:
How to use VORINZ 200 TABLET

Take VORINZ 200 TABLET 1 hour before or after meals or as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking VORINZ 200 TABLET without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About I PHYTORAL SB 65 CAPSULE

I PHYTORAL SB 65 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use I PHYTORAL SB 65 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with I PHYTORAL SB 65 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with I PHYTORAL SB 65 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. I PHYTORAL SB 65 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

I PHYTORAL SB 65 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking I PHYTORAL SB 65 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of I PHYTORAL SB 65 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How I PHYTORAL SB 65 CAPSULE Works

I PHYTORAL SB 65 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About LAMIFIN 125MG TABLET

LAMIFIN 125MG TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take LAMIFIN 125MG TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking LAMIFIN 125MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take LAMIFIN 125MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of LAMIFIN 125MG TABLET
Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How LAMIFIN 125MG TABLET Works

LAMIFIN 125MG TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: Take LAMIFIN 125MG TABLET as advised by your physician.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse LAMIFIN 125MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About IT MAC 400MG TABLET

IT MAC 400MG TABLET is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use IT MAC 400MG TABLET with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with IT MAC 400MG TABLET, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with IT MAC 400MG TABLET is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. IT MAC 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

IT MAC 400MG TABLET is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking IT MAC 400MG TABLET are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of IT MAC 400MG TABLET
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How IT MAC 400MG TABLET Works

IT MAC 400MG TABLET works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About OLYTERB TABLET

OLYTERB TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take OLYTERB TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking OLYTERB TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take OLYTERB TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of OLYTERB TABLET
Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How OLYTERB TABLET Works

OLYTERB TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: Take OLYTERB TABLET as advised by your physician.
For Tablet: Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. But in children younger than 6 years, the medicine should be crushed before swallowing.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse OLYTERB TABLET in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CAPSAIN 50MG INJECTION

CAPSAIN 50MG INJECTION contains Caspofungin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal Drugs. It is used to manage serious fungal infections of the blood, heart, brain, eyes, bones, nose, sinuses, lungs and other parts of the body (such as invasive candidiasis, invasive aspergillosis, etc.).

It can also be used to manage fungal infections during high-risk conditions such as after a surgery or chemotherapy and in patients who recently underwent an organ transplantation or having a weak immune system. It may be given to patients to reduce fever and chills that is suspected to be a fungal infection when management with antibiotics is not working appropriately.

CAPSAIN 50MG INJECTION should be used under careful medical supervision. It is suitable for use both in adults and in children. Talk to your doctor before receiving CAPSAIN 50MG INJECTION if you have any liver problems or taking immunosuppressants (such as ciclosporin or tacrolimus) as a precaution.

Inform your doctor before receiving CAPSAIN 50MG INJECTION if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to become pregnant. CAPSAIN 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of receiving CAPSAIN 50MG INJECTION are pain, swelling, irritation and redness at the site of injection, headache, fast heartbeat, flushing, fever, chills, shortness of breath, joint pain, leg pain, back pain, changes in taste, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage and manages serious fungal infections (such as invasive candidiasis, invasive aspergillosis, etc.)
usesDetails:
Uses Of CAPSAIN 50MG INJECTION
Manage and manages serious fungal infections (such as invasive candidiasis, invasive aspergillosis, etc.)
mechanismOfAction:
How CAPSAIN 50MG INJECTION Works

CAPSAIN 50MG INJECTION is an antifungal medication. It acts by disrupting the fungal cell wall by blocking the actions of certain cellular proteins (beta-glucan) which is essential for the fungal cell to maintain the rigid cell structure. As a result, it makes the fungal cells weak and fragile and eventually destroys them, thereby reducing the severity of infection and managing it from spreading further.
usageDetails:

CAPSAIN 50MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously). Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About ITRAFAB 200 CAPSULE

ITRAFAB 200 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRAFAB 200 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITRAFAB 200 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITRAFAB 200 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITRAFAB 200 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITRAFAB 200 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITRAFAB 200 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITRAFAB 200 CAPSULE Works

ITRAFAB 200 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About ITASPOR ORAL SOLUTION

ITASPOR ORAL SOLUTION contains Itraconazole which belongs to a group of medicines called Antifungals. It is used to manage fungal infections in patients (with poor immune systems), which include yeast infections of the mouth, throat, or gullet. It is also used to manage fungal infections in patients with poor immunity systems that occur due to major blood disorders or bone marrow transplantation.

Yeast infection is a type of fungal infection that occurs when excess yeast (fungi) grows on the skin or other areas. It is generally characterized by symptoms such as white patches on the tongue, redness, soreness, or difficulty swallowing. 

ITASPOR ORAL SOLUTION is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to Itraconazole. Before taking ITASPOR ORAL SOLUTION, inform your doctor if you have heart problems (including congestive heart failure), kidney disorders, or liver problems (such as jaundice).

ITASPOR ORAL SOLUTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless it is clearly advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) or elderly patients unless it is clearly advised by the doctor. 

The most common side effects of taking ITASPOR ORAL SOLUTION are headache, stomachache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, unpleasant taste, and rash. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

ITASPOR ORAL SOLUTION works by inhibiting ergosterol synthesis (an organic compound responsible for maintaining cell membrane integrity of fungi cells) that leads to fungal cell membrane abnormalities (marked with increased permeability and disruption of fungi cells), thus causing destruction to the fungi cell and managing the occurrence of fungal infections in affected individuals.

introduction:
Introduction About I PHYTE 200 CAPSULE

I PHYTE 200 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use I PHYTE 200 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with I PHYTE 200 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with I PHYTE 200 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. I PHYTE 200 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

I PHYTE 200 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking I PHYTE 200 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How I PHYTE 200 CAPSULE Works

I PHYTE 200 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About FLUBIT TABLET

FLUBIT TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.  

Before taking FLUBIT TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.  

FLUBIT TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. FLUBIT TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking FLUBIT TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

introduction:
Introduction About ALBEFLUCO 150 TABLET

ALBEFLUCO 150 TABLET is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis, mucosal candidiasis, cryptococcosis and vaginal candidiasis. Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant. It contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. ALBEFLUCO 150 TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability.

Before taking ALBEFLUCO 150 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium, or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions or have a history of adrenal insufficiency. ALBEFLUCO 150 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor.

ALBEFLUCO 150 TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). ALBEFLUCO 150 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment. The most common side effects of taking ALBEFLUCO 150 TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

name: PAMORIA Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About PAMORIA CREAM

PAMORIA CREAM contains Amorolfine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical Anti-fungals. It is used in the management of fungal infections of the skin such as tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, and tinea manuum. It is also used for managing cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor.

A fungal infection also called mycosis is caused by a fungus. Some fungal infections occur when an invading fungus takes over an area of the body and is too much for the immune system to handle. The symptoms of a fungal infection will depend on the type, but common symptoms include the following skin changes, including cracking or peeling skin and itching.

PAMORIA CREAM is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before applying it.

PAMORIA CREAM is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known if this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before applying it.

PAMORIA CREAM is generally not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before applying.

Always wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Avoid direct contact with the medicine. In case of direct contact, wash your eyes with water and seek medical attention.

The most common side effects of applying PAMORIA CREAM are burning, itching, erythema, skin dryness, and scaling. Consult your doctor for advice if the above symptoms get worse.
uses: Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
usesDetails:
Uses Of PAMORIA CREAM

It is used to manage fungal infections such as:

Tinea pedis, tinea cruris, tinea corporis, tinea manuum
Cutaneous candidiasis and pityriasis versicolor
mechanismOfAction:
How PAMORIA CREAM Works

PAMORIA CREAM works against the fungi by inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Therefore, leading to alternation in fungal cell membrane permeability and disruption of key fungal metabolic processes, causing cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use PAMORIA CREAM

Apply PAMORIA CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands with soap and water before and after using PAMORIA CREAM.

Apply a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area and rub it gently into the skin. Avoid applying this medicine to the mouth and nostrils. Your doctor will give the right dose depending on your age, body weight, and severity of the infection.

introduction:
Introduction About VFEND 200MG INJECTION

VFEND 200MG INJECTION contains Voriconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections (such as invasive aspergillosis, candidaemia, invasive Candida sp. infections) in both adults and in children (aged 2 years or above). It can also be used to manage fungal infections in high-risk bone marrow transplant recipients.

VFEND 200MG INJECTION is highly intended for patients with worsening or life-threatening fungal infections. It is important to complete the full course of therapy with VFEND 200MG INJECTION to achieve better control over infection.

Before receiving VFEND 200MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver or heart problems. Do not receive VFEND 200MG INJECTION if you are pregnant or breast-feeding without consulting your doctor.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with VFEND 200MG INJECTION. During management with VFEND 200MG INJECTION, avoid exposing your skin towards direct sunlight. Wear protective loose-fitting clothes and apply sunscreen while going outdoors.

The most common side-effects of receiving VFEND 200MG INJECTION are visual impairment, fever, rash, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, headache, swelling of the extremities, stomach pain and breathing difficulties. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.

How VFEND 200MG INJECTION Works

VFEND 200MG INJECTION is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageDetails:

VFEND 200MG INJECTION will be administered to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously).

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not skip doses or stop therapy with VFEND 200MG INJECTION without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About LAMBIN LYOPHILISED 50 MG INJECTION

LAMBIN LYOPHILISED 50 MG INJECTION contains Amphotericin B which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. LAMBIN LYOPHILISED 50 MG INJECTION is used to manage invasive fungal infections in patients who are resistant/intolerant to conventional Amphotericin B therapy.

LAMBIN LYOPHILISED 50 MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Amphotericin B. It is also not recommended for use in patients with common/superficial, clinically inapparent fungal infections (which are detectable only by positive skin/serologic tests).

Before receiving LAMBIN LYOPHILISED 50 MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are neutropenic, and/or have liver problems (such as hepatic impairment), and suffer from kidney problems/undergoing dialysis.

LAMBIN LYOPHILISED 50 MG INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women only if it is clearly necessary. It is also used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and in elders (aged above 65 years) after consulting with the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving LAMBIN LYOPHILISED 50 MG INJECTION are fever, chills, and/or rigors. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

LAMBIN LYOPHILISED 50 MG INJECTION binds to ergosterol (steroid present on the cell membranes of fungi) which leads to the formation of pores and ion leakage on the cell membrane resulting in fungal cell death thus managing invasive fungal infections in affected individuals.

introduction:
Introduction About CRESEMBA 100MG CAPSULE

CRESEMBA 100MG CAPSULE is used in the management of fungal infections such as invasive aspergillosis and mucormycosis in patients for whom amphotericin B is inappropriate. It contains a powerful antifungal agent called Isavuconazole which works by stopping the production of ergosterol, a key component for fungal cell membranes. This action helps in eradication of the susceptible fungi.

Take CRESEMBA 100MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. Do not stop taking CRESEMBA 100MG CAPSULE or skip doses without consulting your doctor as it might reduce the effectiveness of this medicine and makes it difficult for faster recovery.

Before taking CRESEMBA 100MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you are allergic to Isavuconazole or other antifungal medicine. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant, breastfeeding or have any heart problems.

The most common side effects of taking CRESEMBA 100MG CAPSULE are low blood potassium levels, low RBC, WBC and platelet counts, dizziness, tiredness, fainting, taste changes, low appetite, indigestion, constipation, reduce sense to touch, tingling sensations or hair loss. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CRESEMBA 100MG CAPSULE

Used in the management of fungal infections such as:

Invasive aspergillosis
Mucormycosis
mechanismOfAction:
How CRESEMBA 100MG CAPSULE Works

CRESEMBA 100MG CAPSULE contains Isavuconazole which is an antifungal medication that works by inhibiting an enzyme called lanosterol 14α-demethylase, which is essential for producing ergosterol, a key component of fungal cell membranes. By blocking this enzyme, Isavuconazole prevents the fungus from creating a stable cell membrane, leading to its death. This action helps in management of fungal infections in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use CRESEMBA 100MG CAPSULE

Take CRESEMBA 100MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of the therapy based on your age, body weight, and health condition. Do not stop taking CRESEMBA 100MG CAPSULE or skip doses without consulting your doctor as it might reduce the effectiveness of this medicine and makes the fungi more resistant to the medicine which makes it difficult for faster recovery.

name: ITRAZLEM 200 Capsule 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ITRAZLEM 200 CAPSULE

ITRAZLEM 200 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRAZLEM 200 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITRAZLEM 200 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITRAZLEM 200 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITRAZLEM 200 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITRAZLEM 200 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITRAZLEM 200 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITRAZLEM 200 CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITRAZLEM 200 CAPSULE Works

ITRAZLEM 200 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.
usageInstructions: Take this medicine as advised by your physician.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About FLUKONA 200 TABLET

FLUKONA 200 TABLET contains Fluconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. It is used to manage various fungal infections such as systemic candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the blood, brain, heart, eyes or other parts of the body), mucosal candidiasis (fungal infection affecting the mouth, throat or denture sore mouth), cryptococcosis (fungal infection mainly affecting the lungs and brain), vaginal candidiasis (fungal infection of the vagina and tissues at the opening of vagina (vulva)).   

Also, it manages fungal infections in immunocompromised patients considered at risk as a consequence of HIV infection or low white blood cell count after cytotoxic chemotherapy, radiotherapy or bone marrow transplant.

Before taking FLUKONA 200 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, abnormal levels of potassium, calcium or magnesium in your blood, are prone to develop severe skin reactions and have a history of adrenal insufficiency.

FLUKONA 200 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor. FLUKONA 200 TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from birth to 17 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with renal impairment.

The most common side effects of taking FLUKONA 200 TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting diarrhea, abdominal pain and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect gets worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How FLUKONA 200 TABLET Works

FLUKONA 200 TABLET works by stopping the action of an enzyme called ergosterol, which is an integral part of the fungal cell membrane to increase its cellular permeability. Thereby, making the cell membrane more permeable and stops the fungal growth. This type of action is useful in managing and managing various fungal infections.

introduction:
Introduction About TEBFIN CREAM

TEBFIN CREAM is used topically to manage fungal skin infections. It contains Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

TEBFIN CREAM is for external use only. Take the required quantity of the medicine and apply on the affected skin areas. Use for the stipulated duration instructed by your physician to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control. Also, inform your doctor if you don’t see any improvement in your condition after 2 weeks of therapy.

Do not use TEBFIN CREAM if you are allergic to terbinafine. It is not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using TEBFIN CREAM are skin peeling, itching, skin color changes and burning sensation at the side effects. These side effects are usually harmless.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TEBFIN CREAM
Manage fungal skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How TEBFIN CREAM Works

TEBFIN CREAM is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About SPORAZ 200 CAPSULE

SPORAZ 200 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use SPORAZ 200 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with SPORAZ 200 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with SPORAZ 200 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. SPORAZ 200 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

SPORAZ 200 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking SPORAZ 200 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

name: Amfy V Gel(Topical) 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About AMFY V GEL(TOPICAL)

AMFY V GEL(TOPICAL) contains Amphotericin B which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal agents. AMFY V GEL(TOPICAL) is used to manage acute, chronic & recurrent fungal infections, vaginal candidiasis, diaper rash, and bed sores in affected individuals.

AMFY V GEL(TOPICAL) is also used in dressing after wound debridement and burns which is also applied around tube and catheters during intubation in intensive care unit.

AMFY V GEL(TOPICAL) is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Amphotericin B. Before applying AMFY V GEL(TOPICAL), inform your doctor if you have kidney problems (such as renal impairment).

AMFY V GEL(TOPICAL) should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. The medicine is also advised to be used with caution in children & adolescents (aged below 18 years) and in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side-effects of applying AMFY V GEL(TOPICAL) are ulceration and induration (thickened and hardened skin), scarring, and/or swelling at the applied site. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

Applied around tube and catheters during intubation in intensive care unit

mechanismOfAction:
How AMFY V GEL(TOPICAL) Works

AMFY V GEL(TOPICAL) binds to ergosterol (steroid present on the cell membranes of fungi) which leads to the formation of pores and ion leakage on the cell membrane resulting in fungal cell death thus managing invasive fungal infections in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use AMFY V GEL(TOPICAL)

Always apply AMFY V GEL(TOPICAL) as directed by your physician. Clean and dry the affected area before application of AMFY V GEL(TOPICAL). It is for external use only. A thin layer of medicine has to be applied on the affected area. Managed areas need not be covered with a plaster/bandage. Wash hands before and after the application AMFY V GEL(TOPICAL). Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids, nose, and mouth.

introduction:
Introduction About ITANOL 100 CAPSULE

ITANOL 100 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITANOL 100 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITANOL 100 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITANOL 100 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITANOL 100 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITANOL 100 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITANOL 100 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About ITRATUF SB CAPSULE

ITRATUF SB CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use ITRATUF SB CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with ITRATUF SB CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with ITRATUF SB CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ITRATUF SB CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

ITRATUF SB CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking ITRATUF SB CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ITRATUF SB CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How ITRATUF SB CAPSULE Works

ITRATUF SB CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ITRATUF SB CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: Tebisure 250mg Tablet 7'S
introduction:
Introduction About TEBISURE

TEBISURE is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take TEBISURE for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking TEBISURE inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take TEBISURE without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of TEBISURE
Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How TEBISURE Works

TEBISURE is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: Take TEBISURE as advised by your physician.
For Tablet: Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. But in children younger than 6 years, the medicine should be crushed before swallowing.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse TEBISURE in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Signs of liver problems (such as unexplained persistent nausea, stomach problems, loss of appetite, unusual tiredness or weakness with yellowing of your skin or eyes, dark urine and pale faeces)
Inflammation of blood vessels causing purple spots under the skin
Inflammation of the pancreas causing severe stomach pain which radiates towards the back side
Signs of muscle breakdown (such as unexplained muscle weakness and dark or red urine)
Signs of low blood count (such as weakness, unusual bleeding, bruising, abnormal pale skin, unusual tiredness, or weakness or breathlessness on exertion or frequent infections)
sideEffectsDetails:

Common Side Effects of TEBISURE:
Headache
Nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, indigestion, bloating
Diarrhea
Muscle pain, joint pain
Skin rash, itching and swelling

Stop taking TEBISURE and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Signs of liver problems (such as unexplained persistent nausea, stomach problems, loss of appetite, unusual tiredness or weakness with yellowing of your skin or eyes, dark urine and pale faeces)
Inflammation of blood vessels causing purple spots under the skin
Inflammation of the pancreas causing severe stomach pain which radiates towards the back side
Signs of muscle breakdown (such as unexplained muscle weakness and dark or red urine)
Signs of low blood count (such as weakness, unusual bleeding, bruising, abnormal pale skin, unusual tiredness, or weakness or breathlessness on exertion or frequent infections)

TEBISURE is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience dizziness after taking TEBISURE.
TEBISURE should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems.
TEBISURE is not recommended for use in patients with an active or a previous history of liver problems.
Do not take TEBISURE if you are allergic to Terbinafine.
TEBISURE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years).
TEBISURE can be used with caution in elderly patients.

Others

Before taking TEBISURE, inform your doctor if you:

Have psoriasis (scaly white patches on the skin)
Have systemic lupus erythematosus (a serious skin condition)
Have skin rashes or any other auto-immune skin condition

introduction:
Introduction About AXTRA 100 CAPSULE

AXTRA 100 CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use AXTRA 100 CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with AXTRA 100 CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with AXTRA 100 CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. AXTRA 100 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

AXTRA 100 CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking AXTRA 100 CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:

Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How AXTRA 100 CAPSULE Works

AXTRA 100 CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

introduction:
Introduction About GRISURE TABLET

GRISURE TABLET contains Griseofulvin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-fungal drugs. It is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, scalp, hair, groin, feet, or nails where topical therapy is not suitable or has failed to manage the condition.

Avoid drinking alcohol while receiving GRISURE TABLET management. Before taking GRISURE TABLET, inform your doctor if you have skin, liver, or kidney problems or porphyria (which results from an increase in certain chemicals related to red blood cell proteins).

GRISURE TABLET is not recommended for pregnant or breastfeeding women; therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking GRISURE TABLET are headache, diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, or stomach discomfort. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

Manage fungal infections of the skin, scalp, hair, groin, feet, and nails

How GRISURE TABLET Works

GRISURE TABLET inhibits the growth of fungi by binding to a part of the fungus causing the infection in the body. This stops the fungus from multiplying. It also manages fungus from spreading to new cells. These actions cause the fungal infection to shed completely.

introduction:
Introduction About CAPSAIN 70MG INJECTION

CAPSAIN 70MG INJECTION contains Caspofungin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal Drugs. It is used to manage serious fungal infections of the blood, heart, brain, eyes, bones, nose, sinuses, lungs and other parts of the body (such as invasive candidiasis, invasive aspergillosis, etc.).

It can also be used to manage fungal infections during high-risk conditions such as after a surgery or chemotherapy and in patients who recently underwent an organ transplantation or having a weak immune system. It may be given to patients to reduce fever and chills that is suspected to be a fungal infection when management with antibiotics is not working appropriately.

CAPSAIN 70MG INJECTION should be used under careful medical supervision. It is suitable for use both in adults and in children. Talk to your doctor before receiving CAPSAIN 70MG INJECTION if you have any liver problems or taking immunosuppressants (such as ciclosporin or tacrolimus) as a precaution.

Inform your doctor before receiving CAPSAIN 70MG INJECTION if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to become pregnant. CAPSAIN 70MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of receiving CAPSAIN 70MG INJECTION are pain, swelling, irritation and redness at the site of injection, headache, fast heartbeat, flushing, fever, chills, shortness of breath, joint pain, leg pain, back pain, changes in taste, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage and manages serious fungal infections (such as invasive candidiasis, invasive aspergillosis, etc.)
usesDetails:
Uses Of CAPSAIN 70MG INJECTION
Manage and manages serious fungal infections (such as invasive candidiasis, invasive aspergillosis, etc.)
mechanismOfAction:
How CAPSAIN 70MG INJECTION Works

CAPSAIN 70MG INJECTION is an antifungal medication. It acts by disrupting the fungal cell wall by blocking the actions of certain cellular proteins (beta-glucan) which is essential for the fungal cell to maintain the rigid cell structure. As a result, it makes the fungal cells weak and fragile and eventually destroys them, thereby reducing the severity of infection and managing it from spreading further.

CAPSAIN 70MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously). Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of infection.

Introduction About ERBINOX TABLET

ERBINOX TABLET is used to manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails. It contains a medicine called Terbinafine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungal agents.

Take ERBINOX TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Failing to do so may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking ERBINOX TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have psoriasis, skin rashes or any other autoimmune skin conditions (such as systemic lupus erythematosus) as a precaution.

Do not take ERBINOX TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach pain, muscle pain, joint pain and taste disturbances. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
usesDetails:
Uses Of ERBINOX TABLET
Manage fungal infections of the skin, hair and nails
mechanismOfAction:
How ERBINOX TABLET Works

ERBINOX TABLET is an antifungal medication. It effectively controls fungal infections within the body. It disrupts the fungal cell membrane by blocking the production of certain chemicals (ergosterol) within the cell which is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the fungal cell from multiplication, thereby managing the further spread of infection.
usageInstructions: Take ERBINOX TABLET as advised by your physician.
For Tablet: Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. But in children younger than 6 years, the medicine should be crushed before swallowing.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse ERBINOX TABLET in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: SPORAMIZ 200mg Capsule 8's
introduction:
Introduction About SPORAMIZ 200MG CAPSULE

SPORAMIZ 200MG CAPSULE is used to manage fungal infections in the body. It contains a medicine called Itraconazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifungals. It works by stopping the growth of fungus that causes these infections.

Fungal infections, also known as mycosis, is a disease caused by fungus that can affect people of all age groups. People with injuries and a suppressed immune system are more susceptible to fungal infections. 

Patients with kidney or liver problems and heart problems such as heart failure should use SPORAMIZ 200MG CAPSULE with caution. It is not recommended for use in patients when the immune system is not functioning well, or they have acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). 

Do not take any medicine without consulting your doctor while on management with SPORAMIZ 200MG CAPSULE, especially medicines given to manage indigestion or stomach ulcers. If the duration of the management with SPORAMIZ 200MG CAPSULE is more than a month, your doctor will advise you to take some blood tests to monitor your liver function. 

This medicine is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. SPORAMIZ 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children less than 12 years of age; however, your child’s doctor may advise them in special cases. 

SPORAMIZ 200MG CAPSULE is normally not recommended for use in elderly patients; however, your doctor may prescribe them in special cases. The common side effects of taking SPORAMIZ 200MG CAPSULE are stomach pain, nausea, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SPORAMIZ 200MG CAPSULE
Fungal infections of the body
mechanismOfAction:
How SPORAMIZ 200MG CAPSULE Works

SPORAMIZ 200MG CAPSULE works by managing the fungal growth by blocking the production of enzymes responsible for the growth of fungal cells. This inhibition results in breakage of cell membranes and fungal cell abnormalities, finally leading to alterations in membrane-based activity of fungus. These lead to fungal cell death and management of further fungal growth.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of SPORAMIZ 200MG CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.
